description: More than 40 artists are coming together on the Main Stage of Sziget Festival on August 9th to celebrate the extraordinary legacy of one of Hungary’s most defining songwriters and composers, János Bródy. For decades, Bródy’s songs have stood for freedom, humanity, and solidarity, values that have shaped generations and remained an enduring part of Hungarian music and culture since long before the democratic transition. This unique event brings together artists from multiple generations for a once-in-a-lifetime celebration on the Island of Freedom. They are about to bring this monumental body of work to life with fresh energy in an unprecedented, mind-blowing show. List of performers in alphabetical order: Azahriah, Bagossy Brothers Company, Beton.Hofi, Blahalouisiana, Carson Coma, Charlie, Csemer Boglárka, Csík zenekar, Deák Bill Gyula, Döbrösi Laura, Dzsúdló, Feke Pál, Földes László Hobo, Fullajtár Andrea, Gerendás Péter, Gubik Petra, Gypsy JamMAL, Halász Judit, Hernádi Judit, Hiperkarma, Hrutka Róbert, az Ivan & the Parazol, Járai Márk, Kiss Tibor, Koncz Zsuzsa, Lábas Viki, Lovasi András, Müller Péter Sziámi, az Örkény Színház színészei, Palya Bea, Péter Bence, Péterfy Bori, Presser Gábor, Radnay Csilla, Sena, Columbo (Irie Maffia), Superar gyerekkórus, Szörényi Levente, Tarján Zsófia, Tolcsvay László, Törőcsik Franciska, Wellhello.

artist: Goran Bregovic with his Wedding & Funeral Orchestra

description: For over 30 years, Morcheeba—founded after a chance meeting between Ross Godfrey and Skye—has remained a defining force in trip-hop, blending soulful vocals with rich electronic and organic sounds. With over 10 million albums sold and countless tours, their music has resonated across generations, often praised for its calming, healing quality. Their 11th album, Escape The Chaos, continues this legacy with 12 tracks exploring connection, emotion, and resilience. Featuring collaborations with family, friends, and artists like Oscar #Worldpeace, the record combines warm production with Skye’s unmistakable voice. In uncertain times, Morcheeba offers a space of reflection and comfort—music as both escape and therapy.

After eight years, Faithless return to the stage, reigniting their legacy as one of electronic music’s most iconic acts. With over 25 years of success—10 Top 10 singles, multiple chart-topping albums, and more than 20 million records sold—their influence remains undeniable. Following their 2020 album All Blessed, released during the pandemic, the band faced the loss of legendary frontman Maxi Jazz in 2022. His impact continues to shape their music and message of consciousness, unity, and emotion. Now, with new material on the way, Faithless return to live performances as a celebration of their sound, their journey, and Maxi’s legacy—bringing a renewed, uplifting energy to audiences worldwide.

Stefani is a professional breaker from Ukraine, currently based in London. She represented Ukraine at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games and is known for her strong power sets, clean rounds, and world-class battle presence. At The Cypher, she will join the battles and lead a breaking workshop together with Hiro 10.

The band Membrán was formed in October 2024 in Szeged, Hungary. The members of the group are: András Fabula (vocals), Balázs Ferenczi (rhythm guitar), Miklós Máté Kóbor (drums), Albert Rigó (lead guitar), Ákos Süli (keyboards), and Gergő Tátrai (bass guitar). They primarily play alternative rock, blending modern and classic indie influences. For them, the Red Hot Chili Peppers are just as influential as Quimby—and who doesn’t listen to Arctic Monkeys? They have already appeared several times among the performers at the SZIN Festival, and this spring they took the stage as the opening act for Pál Utcai Fiúk at Dürer Kert.

Originally from Turin and now based in Milan, GINEVRA — who graduated in vocal studies at the CPM Music Institute and holds a degree in Communication and Society from the University of Milan — followed the release of her EPs RUINS (2019) and METROPOLI (2020) with a period of intense artistic development. Alongside collaborations and songwriting work — including “Glicine,” performed by Noemi at the 2021 Sanremo Music Festival — she dedicated herself to research and experimentation, while building an extensive live career. Her performances range from major events such as the May Day Concert and MI AMI Festival to the stage of the Teatro Ariston in Sanremo, where she appeared in 2022 as a guest of La Rappresentante di Lista, as well as a series of shows accompanying the release of her debut album DIAMANTI, released on October 14, 2022. Characterized by a more electronic and ethereal sound, DIAMANTI paved the way for her next project, which embraces a warmer, more folk-inspired and analog aesthetic. On November 15, 2024, she released the single “my baby!”, the first preview of her new album FEMINA, released on January 24, 2025. The vinyl edition of the album was presented through “Piccoli appuntamenti con amplificatori,” a series of intimate events with fans in Turin, Milan, and Rome. In the summer of 2025, GINEVRA embarked on an extended tour, culminating at the end of the year with four club shows.

Giulia Mei is an Italian singer-songwriter and pianist from Palermo, now based in Milan. With a background in classical piano, her music blends Italian songwriting traditions with indie pop and electronic influences, creating a sharp, contemporary art-pop sound. She gained recognition through major competitions and released her debut album Diventeremo Adulti (2019), a Tenco finalist. In 2021, she won Genova per Voi, leading to a Universal Music Publishing deal. Her single Bandiera (2023) became a viral success, earning critical acclaim, awards, and placements in film and live events. Her 2025 album Io della musica non ci ho capito niente further solidified her reputation, followed by an extensive Italian tour with over 60 shows.

The bastard child of a Ramones/Strokes one night stand, Bad Nerves play ferociously fast distorted pop songs. Their self-made debut and second album Still Nervous put them in the hearts and minds of the cream of the alternative crop; including rock legends such as Green Day’s Billie Joe Armstrong, Pearl Jam’s Stone Gossard, and Iggy Pop. Drawing comparisons to Supergrass, The Hives and Jay Reatard, they proactively seek to make the type of in-your-face, infectious rock music that the genre was built on. After a whirlwind three years, going from playing tiny sweaty rooms, to commanding stadium audiences, Bad Nerves has deservedly enamoured new fans across the world with their captivating 200mph live shows. Emerging as one of rock’n’roll’s most electrifying new exports, the band is currently working on their much anticipated third album.

BenKane is an active figure in Budapest’s underground house scene and a member of the Back To Basics collective. Since 2020, he has been a constant presence in the nightlife, performing at numerous clubs both in Hungary and abroad, as well as at major domestic festivals such as Balaton Sound, EFOTT, and Strand Festival etc. His DJ sets are characterized by playful, groovy, and occasionally tight sounds, always responding to the energy of the crowd.BenKane has been producing music since 2021–22, focusing on a warmer, sexier deep house sound.

artist: The New Era of Queer Hungary
description: Hungary is pulsing with new energy and the promise of a new beginning when it comes to LGBTQ rights. The work has already begun: we all want to live in a better world, but to build it, we first need to understand the world around us. This year, Mirror Talks helps us do exactly that, as experts, artists, and activists — led by András Ádám Kanicsár — explore the present and sketch out the future. We will talk about what happens to love in the age of situationships and to sex as it becomes increasingly embedded in the world of drugs, about the future of gender, fashion, and culture in the middle of an everyday gender revolution, and about how queer activism is finding new forms through a new generation and new digital spaces. The week begins with the portrait of a new queer Hungary — and closes at the dawn of a new era of queer revolution.

He first came into the spotlight through a talent show in 2024, but the impact of his performance has gone far beyond the boundaries of such formats. With his personal, at times melancholic sound and head-nodding beats, he has become one of the most exciting rising names in the Hungarian hip-hop scene. His music blurs the lines between old school and new school, day and night, joy and sorrow.

“Expect the unexpected.” Tomi Ungerer’s motto, enfant terrible of Strasbourg, seems to have been written for Pales. The band blows up any genre classification with a raw and visceral style where Indus, Noise, and Pop collide in a sonic battle. The stage is a playground where trance becomes irrepressible, breathless, constantly brushing against the boundaries of chaos. The sound hits, hypnotizes, triggers spasms, awakens the smells of acid, cosmetics, and burnt rubber. Pales choreographs shadows and romances of a new sonic youth that gets inside your mind and never leaves. Their latest EP ‘CRUSH’ came out in February 2025.

"I can walk into those rooms full of established male musicians and not apologise for being there. Fuck that!" At 23 years of age, Scottish newcomer Brooke Combe is ready to call time on the accepted order of things, interrupting indie with an unapologetic attitude and a formidable roster of songs. A collection she has honed through a year of relentless gigging, each track on her mixtape has its heart in a long lineage of funk and soul, a retro sound that has earnt her endorsement from the likes of the BBC, Rolling Stone UK, The Skinny and NME. It's a style that could easily come across as mere pastiche but from the very first note of her rich vocal, there is no doubt that Brooke is carving her own path. 'Black Is The New Gold' allows her to work through her own understanding of race and identity, reflecting on reading she had been doing about histories of slavery and institutional oppression. Writing the lyrics almost in a state of unconsciousness it was only when she finished that she realised how close she had cut to personal bone.

Lekvárherceg doesn’t want to — and perhaps couldn’t — pretend to be anything other than what he is: a simple country boy with no inhibitions left, someone life abandoned by the roadside, and beyond physical pleasures, nothing else remained for him. He could have stepped straight out of Zsigmond Móricz’s short story Tragedy. His only ambition is to fill his stomach and f***. In his hopeless situation, at least let him have that small joy.” Papp Olivér’s debut album Lekvárherceg was released on 26 September 2025.

Kiras is the project launched in 2019 by Daniele Sgroi, DJ and producer since 2003. Over the years, he has performed on major national and international stages, including Esperanzah Festival in Brussels in 2024 and Sziget Festival in Budapest in 2025, among the most relevant in EuropeDuring the 2025/2026 winter season, from December to April, he is resident DJ at Camanel in Livigno, performing in an international setting and actively taking part during the Milano-Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics period. Among his releases are “Everybody Be Somebody” on Spinnin’ Records (Heartfeldt), in collaboration with Hawk and Jude & Frank; “I Need A Miracle” on Hexagon, Don Diablo’s label, in collaboration with Albert Neve and Gian Nobilee; and “Not This Time” on Black Hole Recordings (GameRoom), Tiësto’s label.With the single “My Mind,” released by Elephant House Records in 2022, he reached #1 on the Beatport Top 100 Hype Mainstage chart. Kiras has currently reached the milestone of half a million streams on Spotify, with support from top DJs worldwide including Martin Garrix, Don Diablo, Blasterjaxx, Sam Feldt, Fedde Le Grand, Nora En Pure, Sultan + Shepard, Merk & Kremont and many others.

Bibi Seck’s thrilling energy and mixing skills have taken Belgium by storm, and she is now conquering Europe. Bibi is the perfect example of a self-made star in the world of electronic music.Her talent and passion are undeniable, her back catalogue is diverse and often surprising and she has a unique ability to connect with the crowd. As a multidisciplinary creative, she blends various influences of electronic music to create a high-energy atmosphere. Her performances are always about fun, celebrating life, love and the uplifting power of music.

Ill at ease is a physical and mental journey — a shifting state of being. It questions how a body can transform itself to embody a single idea It follows a dynamic trio under the pressure of falling, merging with the floor, and returning to the roots beneath them. Their journey teaches them how they can move through levels seamlessly and to embrace their fall and collapses rather than fear it. choreographer : Sarah Green Performers: Eva Palandjian, Sara Sandvik Arnestad, Sarah Green  Light designer : Kata Dézsi SUB LAB PRO CO-PRODUCTION

artist: Hargitai Anikó - Fodor Lilla - Purger Anna
description: Our piece is inspired by the movement language of French choreographer Angelin Preljocaj. We captured both the fragility and the dynamism of the movements. Our performance explores the vulnerability of wildlife, the tensions created by hierarchy, and the power of rising above.

“As long as it lives, it struggles to its feet, sometimes resting along the way.” Permaflux is a solo dance performance with live electronic music, performed by Emese Kovács and Dávid Gerlei. The project examines burnout as a universal condition, not just as a personal challenge, but as an attribute characteristic of all living beings. Permaflux is built on the notion that exhaustion is an everyday experience, known to the masses – but this does not make it any easier to suffer from.

North London quartet Wolf Alice emerged in 2013 with My Love Is Cool and the Grammy-nominated “Moaning Lisa Smile.” Visions Of A Life (2018) won the Mercury Prize, followed by 2022’s UK #1 Blue Weekend and a Brit Award for Best Group. Their fourth album, The Clearing (2025), recorded with Greg Kurstin, delivers confident, timeless pop/rock songs, cementing their cultural and musical significance.

Ana Frango Elétrico is a singer-songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, producer, and visual artist. Hailing from Rio de Janeiro’s vibrant independent scene,  award-winning she is known for her genre-bending sound that defies easy labels. Her music expertly fuses Brazilian traditions—like bossa nova, MPB, samba, and Tropicália—with a modern mix of indie pop, funk, post-punk, and jazz. The result is a style that is both playful and sophisticated. Her spectacular concerts are wild and sensitive, showcasing music at the highest level. This eclectic approach has captivated critics and cemented her reputation as a true innovator in modern Brazilian music.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Irie Maffia is a true supergroup made up of some of Hungary’s most colorful musical personalities. Among its front figures is Sena, of Ghanaian origin, who portrayed Mary in a performance held during the Pope’s visit, appeared in the revived version of the rock opera István, a király, and performed duets at Gábor Presser’s sold-out Arena concert. Columbo’s distinctive voice may also be familiar from the band Brains, while MC Busa (known from Zuboly) and Caribbean-born MC Kemon (of Random Trip) have each performed on nearly every major stage across Hungary in their own right. The band’s uniqueness lies in its musical diversity: with numerous radio hits behind them, they are capable of delivering high-energy concerts in any setting, regardless of the audience’s age. From major festival main stages to intimate club venues, Irie Maffia brings an authentic Caribbean vibe wherever they perform. This autumn, they return to the studio to mark their anniversary with the release of several brand-new songs.

Jahson The Scientist is a London- and Montserrat-raised spoken word artist, MC, musician, and educator whose work bridges hip-hop, jazz, soul, science, and spirituality. Alongside his artistic career, he has a background in quantum chemistry and education, teaching physical sciences through workshops while exploring themes of consciousness and non-materiality. As a performer, Jahson has fronted projects such as Sketches On Duality and Scattah Brain, appearing at festivals across Europe, Taiwan, and Costa Rica. His debut solo album Inner Heights was released in 2025, further establishing his unique fusion of music, poetry, and intellectual exploration. Recognized both as an artist and educator, Jahson continues to connect music, culture, science, and human experience through performances, lectures, and creative workshops.

KOIKOI is a Belgrade-based band that blends raw energy, emotional depth, and genre-defying music, bridging indie rock, electronica, and post-punk. With their debut album "Pozivi u stranu/Calls aside", they achieved remarkable success, performing over 130 concerts across 16 European countries and laying the foundation for their growing international recognition. They were nominated for the Music Moves Europe Award 2023 at Eurosonic, where they also performed at the renowned Vera Club. They have since appeared at major European festivals, including Reeperbahn Festival,EuropaVox, and Fusion Festival, as well as regional festivals such as InMusic, Exit, and Arsenal Fest. In 2025, KOIKOI performed at showcases Waves Vienna, SoAlive, and SHIP Festival, steadily building their international profile. This summer, they opened for Fontaines D.C. in Belgrade, further affirming their reputation as one of the region’s most exciting live acts. Rolling Stone UK described them as “Serbian psych-rockers whose sonic power is tangible, with an electrifying sound and fully-charged concert volume.” In 2025, they released two singles, the latest of which was featured on KEXP Radio, ahead of their upcoming album “On Happiness in Dreams”. The album was released on November 14, 2025, and received two awards for Album of the Year in the Western Balkans.

Tom Marshall, known as Marsh, is one of the standout names of the melodic house scene and a fan favourite on Anjunadeep. Since emerging in the mid-2010s, he has developed a warm, emotional sound inspired by early 2000s trance and melodic drum & bass.With three albums – Life On The Shore (2017), Lailonie (2020), and Endless (2023) – Marsh has built a catalogue of widely supported tracks with millions of streams, releasing on labels like Spectrum, Cercle and Warner. Alongside his success as a producer, he has become a sought-after DJ, performing at iconic venues such as Printworks London, Brooklyn Mirage, and Red Rocks, as well as selling out headline shows worldwide.Now based in North America, Marsh continues to connect with fans through global touring and livestreams from unique locations, maintaining a deeply emotional and dedicated approach to his craft.

artist: Dóri Czakó, Forró Budapest: Forró Workshop
description: This workshop introduces the joyful Brazilian partner dance Forró. It focuses on connection, improvisation, and community through movement and rhythm. Participants are guided through the basics of Forró in an accessible and welcoming way, leading into a social dance experience that creates an inclusive and energetic atmosphere for dancers of all levels. Workshop facilitator: Dóri Czakó , Assistant: Alberto Eloy Rodriguez

Ivo Dimchev is a theatre maker, choreographer, visual artist, singer-songwriter, and queer activist from Bulgaria. His work is an extreme and colorful mix of performance art, dance, theater, music, painting, and photography. He is the author of more than 40 stage performances and has received numerous international awards for dance and theater. Most of his stage performances are inluded in his book Stage Works 2002-2016. He has also written more than 100 original songs all included in his Songbook. His work has been presented throughout Europe, South and North America, and Asia. During the pandemic Ivo wrote a lot of food, alcohol and sex related original folk songs in Bulgarian. He simply  wanted to cheer up his audience and himself  in those dark pandemic and post pandemic times. Some of those songs are Banitsa, Vodka, Pushkin, Skembe Corba, Halal, Pheromones and many others. Ivo Dimchev Band is focused mainly on this repertoire of Ivo but also some of his “classics” and heart-warming ballads in English.

Robert White is back on tour with a brand-new show; catch his unmistakable blend of musical comedy, chaos, and razor-sharp wit across the UK this October, November, and December.  “Very funny, fantastic oddball” - Time OutBest known for his breakout appearances on Britain’s Got Talent in 2018, where he came second, Robert has amassed a combined social media fan base approaching half a million followers and views in the millions.  His offbeat style, part musical genius, part joyful mayhem, has become instantly recognisable. In this latest show, Robert leans fully into the absurd songs audiences love about him, whilst also exploring more personal and unexpected territory with sharp observational comedy.  Robert explores the struggle of “invisibility” that comes from trying to connect with people when unable to read social cues with his signature silliness and musical invention. Each chaotic show is unique with a large part built in the moment. The audience is invited into the performance through improvised musical comedy, pop quizzes and more. It’s this unpredictability, combined with a genuine attempt to better understand the people around him, that makes each night one of a kind. “... souped-up risqué keyboard-based songs, waspish asides and neurotically charged camperie from a hyperactive man-child who is among the most original” - Telegraph Expect surreal props aplenty - ranging from vegetables to a knight costume - and songs that are at once revealing and ridiculous in equal measure. Whether you’ve followed him from the beginning or you’re just now realising that he’s ‘THAT’ gay, autistic, keyboard, tanktop, comedy guy you’ve seen on TikTok, this is a show that packs a lot of punches… and then keeps going. “You're very unique, you're very quirky, very funny, very naughty, Robert, which we like!”  - Simon Cowell

Szabikeyz (Szabolcs Barnabás Fodor) is an emerging Hungarian artist and producer whose solo project is gaining increasing recognition within the local music scene. Many may also know him as the keyboard player of the band Mehringer. Together with Zoli Juhász, he won the 2025 edition of Sávlekötő Camp by OTP Junior, opening new professional opportunities and giving fresh momentum to his career. His most popular track, “Részeg”, has accumulated more than 250,000 streams across platforms. Drawing inspiration from the synth-driven sounds of the ’80s, ’90s, and the carefree early 2000s, Szabikeyz blends nostalgic influences with the freshness of modern pop production. His songs are distinctive, evocative, and contemporary, representing a unique and much-needed direction in today’s Hungarian music landscape.

Miss Kaninna is a First Nations artist from Tasmania whose fearless blend of hip-hop, R&B, rock, and pop has made her one of Australia’s most exciting new voices. Her debut single Blak Britney became a breakthrough success in 2024, earning multiple ARIA nominations, topping triple j, and gaining international attention through Netflix’s Heartbreak High. Her debut EP KANINNA received critical acclaim and major independent music awards, while her explosive live performances took her across sold-out UK and European tours alongside Kneecap. She has also shared stages with artists such as Stormzy, M.I.A., Steve Lacy, and Raye. Beyond music, Miss Kaninna is a strong advocate for Indigenous, LGBTQI+, immigrant, and women’s rights, using her platform to drive cultural change and community empowerment.

Midnight Sun is Zara Larsson’s fourth international studio album, created with a close-knit team led by longtime collaborator MNEK. The album captures confidence, vulnerability, and artistic growth, drawing inspiration from Swedish summer nights where the sun never sets. Blending pop bangers with introspective tracks, it reflects Zara’s journey, ambition, self-acceptance, and evolving perspective at 27. She describes it as her most authentic work yet—fun, honest, emotional, and unmistakably her.

Lambrini Girls have released their long-awaited debut album Who Let The Dogs Out via City Slang. With their record in-stores starting today, most of which are sold-out, and a UK April headline tour, which are also almost sold-out, they have now announced their return to the US to follow after. Already gracing the covers of DIY, NME, Kerrang! Magazine, NOTION, and features with the likes of Variety, The Line Of Best Fit, BBC Radio 1, and more to come, the Brighton-based duo of Phoebe Lunny (vocals/guitar) and Selin Macieira (bass) have spent the last few years on a tear in more ways than one. Who Let The Dogs Out bottles everything wrong with the modern world and shakes it up. If peppering political songs with humour is like sticking a sparkler in some bread, then their debut is like a fireworks display in the factory itself: strange, dangerous, exciting, and it rips through a laundry list of social ills. “You know how Fleetwood Mac almost dedicated Rumours to their cocaine dealer? I think we should dedicate this album to all the booze we bought at Tesco.”

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Mehringer is a Fonogram Award–nominated artist and a leading figure in Hungary’s new wave pop scene. Breaking through in 2025 with SZAR AZ ÉLET, he has sold out clubs, become a festival regular, and will headline his first solo show on July 16, 2026. With over 80 million streams, 240,000+ monthly Spotify listeners, and trending YouTube releases, Mehringer—collaborating closely with producer Illés Ferenc—continues to expand his influence ahead of his second full-length album in spring 2026.

AVRALIZE fuse multiple worlds into a high-impact blend of vibe, technique, and raw creativity. Hailing from southern Germany, the four-piece balance crushing deathcore breakdowns with provoking guitar riffs, massive production, and grooves built to move bodies as much as minds. Guided by the idea of “perception through sound,” their music uses futuristic textures and immersive melodies to pull listeners into distant, otherworldly realms—brutal, hypnotic, and unmistakably their own.

Zsiga Bernáthy is an iconic figure of the Hungarian electronic music scene. He began performing live acts in the 1990s together with his father under the name BERNATH/Y & SON, and since 2012 he has continued as a solo act called BERNATHY LIVE. Twisting knobs on a thousand different, both new and ancient machines, he hypnotizes audiences with his distinctive acid-house sets. He pops up everywhere from major festivals to secret raves. His passion and love for music are everlasting.

Curtisy’s ascent feels like the natural next chapter in Ireland’s ongoing cultural purple patch. His trajectory has been swift but deliberate: an RTÉ Choice Prize nomination for his debut album “What Was The Question”, a BBC Radio 1Xtra debut with Caskkid, a widely-circulated Dazed profile that labelled him “one of the best rappers to ever come out of Ireland,” and a growing catalogue that doubles as a personal diary — candid, witty, self-deprecating, and bracingly honest.His music lives in the cracks between sharp humour and quiet melancholy, drawing comparisons to Earl Sweatshirt and MIKE but refusing to lose its Irish vernacular. Each track reads less like a performance and more like a conversation overheard, rooted in the working-class surroundings that shaped him.

Up and coming Norwegian producer oskar med k crafts a sound where chill, melodic house meets infectious, masterful songwriting. His immersive productions blend club centric beats, infectious melodies, and ethereal vocals, showcasing an emotional depth that has been catching the ears of many in the industry. Oskar’s talent and distinct style have propelled him onto the electronic music scene in a matter of months. His latest single, a collaboration with acclaimed Chill House producer Avaion, has received numerous Spotify editorial placements, garnering over a million streams in its first two weeks. With each release, he continues to push boundaries, crafting soundscapes that transport listeners into a new world of emotion and rhythm.

The curtain rises for Siegfried & Joy: With glowing energy and golden euphoria, the king tigers of the magic scene storm the stage to enchant everyone! With fabulous tricks, wild stories and, above all, charm, humour and a great love of magic, the two Berlin disco magicians are now coming to us. Hardly anyone has been able to escape the magic of the two new superstars of magic in recent years - whether on the Internet or in theatres around the world: When Siegfried & Joy float across the stage or spread out their magical golden cloth, they destroy all magic show clichés and not only make the disco balls go crazy. With sensational illusions, captivating interaction and just the right amount of self-irony, the two magicians are among the funniest things to see. Their award-winning debut show not only earned them acclaim in countless theatres and at festivals, also the press also agrees after their meteoric rise: ‘Who needs Las Vegas?’ Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K9k9HIYX42w https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uL4Fmx8PYT0

In the coming period, kristoaf is placing a stronger focus on his personal creative process, offering the most complete insight yet into his artistic vision and way of thinking. As part of this new chapter, every aspect of the music — from songwriting to production — is crafted entirely by the artist himself. The pursuit of “going higher” lies at the heart of this era: a journey toward artistic fulfillment, liberation, and self-realization. Drawing on Platonic ideals and embracing an intentionally over-romanticized perspective, kristoaf explores themes of aspiration, transcendence, and emotional depth. Blending balance, indie-inspired soundscapes, and guitar-driven textures, his music creates a distinctive atmosphere where introspection meets ambition.

Dorota is a Budapest-based DJ and founder of ETEM (Expressing Through Electronic Music), an event series launched in 2023 to create intimate and conscious electronic music experiences.Her sound is rooted in hypnotic, raw textures, often infused with deep, atmospheric and minimalist elements.For her, music is a healing vibration — a force that evokes profound connection through resonance.As both a DJ and curator, her intention is to create safe spaces where bare souls can drift through time and tone. What moves her is not the noise of the scene, but the quiet transformation that music can inspire.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker

description: With 13 years of career, three albums to their name, and international tours that have brought them to prestigious stages (Quai Branly, Mela Festival, Fuerteventura en Música, Festival du Bout du Monde, Fiest’A Sète, Sfinks Festival…), Calle Mambo has established as one of the committed bands leading the renewal of Latin music.Their strength lies in rich and bold compositions that blend around ten traditional Latin American instruments (charango, tiple, quena, zampoña, ronroco, toyos, cuatro…) with electronic, urban sounds and popular rhythms(huayno, timba, caporal, cumbia…). A powerful alchemy of modernity and tradition!On stage, a true whirlwind: a unique musical universe and a captivating immersion into Latin American music!New album: Retumba La Tierra (June 2025)

A New York City-native raised on the Lower East Side, sombr—born Shane Boose—started making music in his bedroom while studying classical music as a student at the prestigious public school, LaGuardia High School. His breakout hit “Caroline” (2022) took the internet by storm, and he has since released a series of EPs and singles - all self-written and co-produced by the artist himself - that has propelled him to 500 million monthly streams across platforms. In August of 2025, he released his debut full-length album I Barely Know Her [Warner Records] which landed at #1 in Spotify’s Global Albums Chart and features the three Billboard Hot 100 hits “back to friends,” “undressed” and “12 to 12.” “undressed” took the #1 spot at Alternative Radio faster than any new artist of the last decade, while “back to friends” has crossed 1 BILLION streams and earned sombr his first Video Music Award for “Best Alternative.” With “12 to 12” following in the same footsteps, sombr took the #1 spot on the Hot 100 Songwriters Chart for 5 straight weeks. Now based in Los Angeles, sombr is currently on his sold-out world tour, playing his first arena shows and upgraded venues to accommodate demand, winding across North America before he heads to Australia in December and Europe and the U.K. in the spring of 2026.

SYREETA is a fearless, genre-defying British DJ and producer whose global career continues to soar. Known for her eclectic house and techno sets, she has performed at top clubs and festivals worldwide, including Coachella, Time Warp, and Ibiza’s DC10, and shared stages with major artists like Carl Cox, Honey Dijon, and Marco Carola. In 2024, she won Beatport’s People’s Choice Award and was named Carl Cox’s DJ/Producer of the Year, while her productions and remixes have gained widespread acclaim. SYREETA’s dynamic energy, crowd-reading ability, and boundary-pushing artistry make her one of dance music’s most exciting talents in 2025.

Surfacing from the flesh-eating diseases and torrential wildfires of Australia, Kim Dracula has arrived to create turbulent, creative art that mirrors the chaotic world around us. On the track “Make Me Famous”, we reach a gluttonous feast of violence, chaos and satire. In addition to being extreme and multi-faceted lyrically and visually, “Make Me Famous” dwarfs Dracula’s previous musical output by abrasively combining multiple styles, composed instrumentally by Kim Dracula themselves, including metal, industrial, jazz, trap and Latin music in a single song without flying off the rails. Dracula’s latest release “Drown” is a more melodic song that packs the same eclectic punch they’re making a name for, fusing styles such as post hardcore with synthwave, industrial, edm and metal. Between their musical composition, extreme visuals, and lack of desire to fit into any specific box, Dracula is earning a devoted following in all different communities, changing the future of music as we know it.

ISU (István Kántor) is a key figure in Hungary’s underground electronic music scene, active since the early 1990s. Starting as a cassette DJ and organizer, he became known for his dedication to music discovery and community building. His long-running radio show Eat da Beat on Tilos Rádió and the founding of Minimalheadz helped introduce electro and techno to local audiences.As the founder of AktRecords and co-creator of influential series like Lick the Click! and Technokunst, ISU has brought leading international artists to Budapest. Today, he remains a central force as a DJ, curator, and record store owner, shaping the scene with authenticity and innovation.

Journalist, radio host, and DJ. On-air presenter at Radio Bari, bringing new music every day. Resident Italian DJ of the Sziget Festival. Founder and director of RKO Radio and head of the newspaper Quotidiano Italiano Nazionale. DJ since 1989, he has performed across Europe alongside international artists. He is also a stage host and curator of music showcases.

As the most streamed female DJ globally, Dublin’s Jazzy is the most exciting artist in Ireland right now and a trailblazer for her homegrown music scene. The BRIT and Ivor Novello nominee has released a string of wide-ranging collaborations with global dance contemporaries, offering her infectious blend of unforgettable melodies and resonant lyrics to tracks with Rossi. (‘High On Me’), Ankhoï (‘Closer to the Floor’) KILIMANJARO (‘No Bad Vibes’) and Sonny Fodera & D.O.D (top 5 hit ‘Somedays’). A bonafide hitmaker, Jazzy has two number one singles in Ireland, as well as three top ten singles in the UK. With each new release further establishing her name within the dance music canon, Jazzy has been equally active on the live scene, with an incredible festival run with performances in 2025.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Manuel is one of the most successful and influential Hungarian artists of today. With his raw honesty and generation-defining songs, he quickly rose to the forefront of the Hungarian music scene. He began his musical journey in Budapest’s 10th district and gained nationwide recognition through X-Faktor, where his distinctive voice and strong character immediately captured a wide audience. In 2023, he released his debut album Idegen, which has since generated more than 250 million streams, making Manuel one of the strongest Hungarian streaming artists of the digital era. In the same year, he also appeared as a coach on The Voice Hungary, further strengthening his position as a key figure in the local music industry. His single Torz became one of the most outstanding Hungarian releases of 2024, while his early 2025 project Orgonabokor revealed his most personal side to date, openly reflecting on the hardships of his childhood. On the live front, Manuel consistently performs at the highest level. In 2024, he sold out his second headline show at Budapest Park, followed by a sold-out concert at the MVM Dome in February 2025. Demand remains exceptionally high: tickets for his 2025 Budapest Park show sold out in advance, and he is set to play two nights at the venue in 2026. Over the past few years, Manuel has become one of the most defining artists in Hungarian music, with hundreds of millions of streams and concerts where generations sing along to the stories that have shaped his career.

WAVY is a Budapest-based music and art collective founded in January 2022. The 19-member group—comprising rappers, DJs, producers, visual artists, and creatives—operates at the intersection of alternative and experimental hip-hop, lo-fi, garage, and house. Their motto “Lo and Slo” reflects their philosophy of slow, organic growth within Hungary’s music and creative scene.Their debut album BABEL surpassed 2 million Spotify streams and was named one of the best debut releases of 2023 by Telex. In 2024, they released their second album Y (¥), which they presented with a sold-out show at Dürer Kert in Budapest. Later that year they followed with the Menni Mixtape, showcasing a more experimental side of their sound. In spring 2025, WAVY embarked on an eight-city Hungarian tour, culminating in a final show at Dürer Kert in Budapest.

Vince Varga + Gábor Keresztes OUROBOROS la montée, la descente, on repeat The groove repeats itself. The rhythm dissolves, makes room for something else, returns, changes shape. It makes you sweat, freezes you, starts you over. Future memories pass through its gaps. Nothing disappears completely. Nothing returns unchanged. The circle closes, the circle begins again. It gives birth to itself. Careful, it bites. Vince Varga is an interdisciplinary artist, theatre maker and VJ. His work has been seen from Lisbon through Ozora to Novosibirsk, at the Grand Théâtre de Genève, the Hungarian State Opera, Deutsches Schauspielhaus Hamburg and Schauspiel Stuttgart. He returns to Sziget this year after a decade away. His work explores transformation through repetition, inherited patterns and the limits of free will. In spaces built from sound, light and moving image, he examines how we treat ourselves, each other and what we call nature — which is to say, our true, whole selves. Gábor Keresztes is a Junior Prima Award-winning composer and sound designer working across theatre and film. A long-time sound designer for Viktor Bodó’s productions, he has created work for theatre and dance productions in Hungary and internationally. He is also a member of the band Freakin’ Disco. His film credits include Comrade Drakulich, Mastergame and — with Kristóf Kelemen — Silent Friend. He received the International Cinephile Society Award for Best Original Score for Preparations to Be Together for an Unknown Period of Time.Concept and design: Vince Varga Music and sound design: Gábor Keresztes

artist: Stacey Clare and Keri Gold ELSC Productions CIC
description: Ever wondered what strippers eat for breakfast? Favourite song to dance to? Ever dated a customer? Or what really happens in the VIP room? Stacey Clare and Keri Gold make their Budapest debut, straight from Edinburgh Fringe, to answer all your urgent questions with their hit show “Ask A Stripper”. Don’t miss the chance to satisfy your curiosity as these two UK legends take to the stage with their raw, hilarious, unpredictable, and unapologetically honest live audience Q&A. Their side-splitting stories, razor-sharp humour and unexpected asides will leave you speechless, whilst questioning everything you thought you knew about the sex industry.

Mollywood is one of the fastest-rising figures in the Hungarian underground hip-hop scene, building significant attention around himself in a short period of time through his distinctive visual and musical style. He currently reaches nearly 300,000 monthly listeners on Spotify, with his most-streamed tracks including “AFTERPARTY” (a collaboration with Bruno), as well as “PASSENGER PRINCESS” and “Inuyasha”. His music combines modern trap aesthetics, a direct style of expression, and a readily recognizable artistic attitude, giving him an increasingly prominent position within the new wave of Hungarian rap.

Perturbator, the alias of James Kent, is a visionary force in retro-electronic music, redefining synthwave with dark, dystopian intensity. Since 2012, releases like Night Driving Avenger, TERROR 404, and I Am the Night established him as a genre-defining artist, with subsequent albums Dangerous Days (2014) and The Uncanny Valley (2016) pushing darker, cinematic boundaries. Moving beyond neon nostalgia with New Model (2017) and Lustful Sacraments, Kent explores humanity’s self-destruction through shadowy, precision-cut electronic textures. After global tours alongside HEALTH and Carpenter Brut, 2025 sees him join Nuclear Blast Records and headline a European tour with Gost and Kaelan Mikla, continuing to push the limits of electronic music.

BIIA is an eletronic music artist who brings an emotional curiosity that is so mirrored in her creative process.She creates a journey of self-expression that blends different approaches of techno. These are energetic and hard-hitting stories that can combine raw, hard, 90's beats and peculiar sounds with different genres occasionally popping. Her productions express music, without boundaries that oozes trippy elements with screaming kicks and sectionally her provocative and conceptual vocal.BIIA, disruptive and unappreciative of labels, is a talent that stays true to her artitic vision.

Dijon Duenas (simply known as Dijon) is an American alternative/R&B singer-songwriter and producer, also known as the former vocalist of the R&B duo Abhi//Dijon. After the duo released two projects respectively in 2015 and 2016, Dijon began to step into his own in 2017, releasing a string of solo singles, including "Skin" and "Nico's Red Truck". His debut EP Sci Fi 1 was released in 2019 under the Warner-supported label R&R Digital, and was shortly followed by How Do You Feel About Getting Married the following year. He eventually released his debut album Absolutely on November 5, 2021, which included the single "Many Times".

Hazetomika is one of the notable rising artists of Hungary’s new-wave hip-hop and trap scene. With his short, hard-hitting tracks and instinctive, direct delivery, he has quickly built a loyal and growing fanbase. He currently has nearly 60,000 monthly listeners on Spotify, with his most popular tracks including “Shao Leng Leng” with ekhoe and Grasa, “Ha Ha Ha”, and “#mindennapom” featuring Patyi. His sound combines raw energy, a laid-back street attitude, and the signature elements of new-generation trap, giving him a distinctive identity within the Hungarian scene.

Strahil Velchev is an electronic music artist from Sofia, Bulgaria. Known for his projects KiNK and Kirilik, he pushes the boundaries of live performance, blending various styles with innovative technology and unconventional instrument use. In 2025, Strahil will celebrate 15 years of international touring as KiNK, having performed at top festivals such as Glastonbury, Exit, Tomorrowland, and Awakenings, as well as iconic clubs like Berghain, Fabric, and Amnesia. In the 2020s, Strahil composed experimental music for a light installation by Christopher Bauder, showcased at light art festivals in the Middle East and Las Vegas. A passionate advocate for technology, he collaborates with leading manufacturers of music instruments and DJ equipment. In the coming year, Strahil plans to develop an immersive visual show for KiNK, in collaboration with Sofia’s Elektrick Me, and revive his Kirilik alias, focusing on exploratory techno. Velchev continues to push the boundaries of cutting-edge music with his label Sofia, alongside his partner Konstantin Petrov, and is making waves with his high-energy sets with fellow Bulgarian Raredub. Their most recent video recording is from their set at the Stone Techno Festival in Germany."

Frakk from Budapest’s 16th district first appeared on the map in 2019 after the release of his album Brokaz. Since then, he has released six more albums, numerous successful collaborations, a carefully groomed moustache, and a series of space-bending chaotic adventures. Over the years, the rapper has grown closer to thirty, closer to himself, and closer to all of you as well. His new album, “There’s Still a Tomorrow After the Happy Ending” (Happy End Után Is Van Másnap), marks the beginning of a new era — painted in blue tones, together with Matyi Doór and a full live band. Levi Lengyel on guitar, Csicsi Muzslai on saxophone, and Frakk close to the microphone. The result is shared choreographies, mantras, emotional processing, and endless good vibes.

The Joker himself hosts a late-night circus cabaret where anything can happen. Magician, fakir, sword swallower, hair hanger and ghost of the venue, he guides audiences through a series of explosive circus acts: acrobatics, comedy, sexy juggling, fake magic, real magic, flying bicycles, punk clowns, muscular aerialists and hairy men with big pink balls. High-energy, surprising, grotesque and wildly entertaining — with a different line-up every night.

Coco & Breezy are Producers & DJs and the fiercely stylish twins behind their multifaceted brand. Their musical journey was influenced by their family and grew into a deep passion for dance music culture. Post moving to New York to launch their eyewear company, C&B submerged themselves into changing the face of dance music and what it means to be a technically accomplished Afro-Latina women DJs and producers.

Born in 1992, today Indira Paganotto is one of Spain’s most prominent figures in the world of music. Her sets are full of energy and undeniable danceability. In the last 13 years she has changed the dance music industry, being the driving force behind a new sound, psy-techno. At the age of just 17 she signed a total of 3 vinyl releases to Ian Pooley’s label Pooled Music, after he discovered her during a warm-up set she played in Gran Canaria. Soon after, she moved to Madrid where she could focus on producing and DJ’ing at a bigger scale. Her debut collaboration with Nina Kraviz in 2023 for ‘White Horse’ on Trip, also came with the launch of her label ARTCORE with her EP ‘Guns & Horses’. Today, ARTCORE is spearheading the ‘psy-techno’ movement, a genre the label has effectively crafted itself over its last 15 releases. They charge into 2025 with ARTCORE curated stages at the world’s biggest festivals. Indira’s rise has been unstoppable, from remixing Depeche Mode’s ‘People Are Good’ to headlining all major clubs and events, with upcoming performances at Coachella, Tomorrowland, EXIT, Sonar, Awakenings and Mysteryland. But it’s at Monegros she’ll make history as the first women to ever close the main stage in July and will be taking over Ibiza with her brand-new residency at Hi Ibiza, over 14 weeks of the summer. Although 2025 looks to be ger biggest year yet, also with a debut album release, she remains humble and dedicated to her work, with infectious energy and a smile as bright as her fue.

Soft Loft is a Switzerland-based collective fronted by singer and songwriter Jorina Stamm, creating emotionally open indie music that blends ecstasy and melancholy. Their sound—playfully described as “indie-something-something”—moves effortlessly between intimate club shows and large festival stages, building a space where vulnerability and connection are at the center.Within a short time, they self-released the EP In Case You Still Get Lonely and the album The Party And The Mess, produced by Grammy-nominated Gianluca Buccellati (Lana Del Rey, Arlo Parks). The album gained international attention with airplay on KEXP, BBC 6, and FluxFM, leading to headline shows and festival appearances at The Great Escape, Reeperbahn Festival, MS Dockville, Montreux Jazz Festival, and more.In 2025, Soft Loft signed with [PIAS] and released their self-produced EP Modern Roses. Their single Dorm has already become a fan favorite and marks the beginning of their first major UK and European headline tour, with more new music expected in 2026.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: As co-founders of Budai House Clique – Hungary’s first collective dedicated to afro and melodic house – Colbora and Hoffmann have become defining figures of the country’s electronic music scene. Their performances have resonated at major festivals including Sziget, BÓNUSZ, B my Lake, Balaton Sound, Snowattack, and Strand,, and they have also been featured multiple times on Radio 1 Hungary.In 2025, their presence reached new heights. They hosted a successful Budai House Clique night at Playa Padre Marbella, filling one of Spain’s most renowned beach clubs with their signature sound and international guests. Following that, they performed at the Lamborghini showcase, played at Sushi Samba London, and appeared after Hot Since 82 and DJ Levi at Vajdahunyad Castle.

Stemin is an Amsterdam-based queer pop artist blending sensual pop, soul and electronic elements into an empowering live show. Think The Weeknd meets Dua Lipa with the playful wink of Sabrina Carpenter. Tales of a Gay Romance is a journey through desire, identity and liberation, driven by powerful vocals and dancefloor energy. At Sziget Stemin will present new music from his upcoming project Sinners & Lovers, a darker and more seductive chapter: pop bangers where desire, darkness and self-expression collide.

Karyuu is a Budapest-based electronic music producer who has been building his unique artistic world on both the Hungarian and international scene since 2020. His music blends innovative sounds with influences from different cultures, creating the distinctive atmosphere that has become his trademark. Winner of the special prize at Telekom SZELEKTOR 2026, Karyuu has always considered the creative fusion of genres essential to his work. This sense of freedom and experimentation defines both his music and the continuously evolving project he has been actively developing since its launch. He releases new music almost every month, attracting the attention of several international labels in recent years. Alongside his solo project, he is also part of the producer duo toldyuuso.

Underworld are Rick Smith and Karl Hyde. Over 30 years since their peerless first album, dubnobasswithmyheadman, and their generation-defining euphoric hit, ‘Born Slippy (Nuxx)’, they are going from strength to strength. 2025 marks a modern renaissance for the group, which already has over 40 years of experience. Their Boiler Room debut this summer saw over one million views in the first five days, and upon the recent re-reissue of their first seven studio albums, all seven went straight to the top of the album charts - a feat never before achieved by a single artist. With a sold-out 2025 USA tour, countless festival headlining slots, and continuous collaborations with seminal talents such as Brutalisimus3000, KETTAMA, and KI/KI, Underworld’s consistent artistry and visceral live shows cement their place in both electronic music’s history and its future.

Budapest-born DJ, producer, and modular live performer with over 20 years of experience in the electronic music scene. Known for fast-paced, groovy, analog-driven techno infused with melancholic and futuristic elements. He has released on respected labels such as Secession, BCCO, Illegal Alien, Warok, Diffuse Reality, Gordo Trax, PRX Records, BRVTAL, and Postdynamic.In recent years, he has focused on improvised, hardware-only modular live sets — both as a solo act and in collaboration with BIZMUTH. He is also the founder of Nonverbal Language, a Budapest-based label with releases and remixes by artists including Temudo, Eric Fetcher, Alarico, Peder Mannerfelt, Franz Jäger, and Measure Divide.

MËSTIZA is the perfect combination of music, fashion, and female empowerment. This Spanish duo has known how to perfectly mix electronic music with the best flamenco. After several years of friendship, in 2021, these two DJs and producers decided to join forces to delve into their roots and discover a world of traditional Spanish sounds that fuse music, aesthetics, and fashion.

Sara Landry is a leading force in hard techno, known for her dark, high-energy sound and ritualistic, feminine aesthetic. A self-taught DJ, producer, and founder of the HEKATE label, she has rapidly risen to global prominence with viral performances, sold-out tours, and major festival appearances, including Tomorrowland. Often called the “High Priestess of Hard Techno,” Landry blends underground intensity with spiritual, immersive experiences while championing inclusivity and innovation in electronic music.

Mike Trotter emerged from New York City’s underground in 2014. made his international debut at Mysteryland in 2015 under the Big Top. Praised by The New York Times, he has shared lineups with global tastemakers. His sets channel queer dancefloor energy, blending nostalgic house, risqué techno, and deep melodic textures with driving percussion. Now based in Miami, his sound pushes fluid basslines and body moving rhythms that blur intimacy and release.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: How can electronic music be a soul music? The founder DJs of Pure Lust Daniel Santiago and Daniel Ban from Budapest, know exactly this. The secret of their success is to find a mixture of styles that blend organic / downtempo, indie, dark disco, house, little bit of rock, and more spirited folk motifs, on house and electronic basis. This mixture results in a deep yet dancefloor friendly sounds. The secret component is the appropriate proportion of styles. They always tell something through music and give a dynamic and fresh experience to the people. The team has been a guest of many international performers: Acid Pauli, Christian Löffler, Satori, Kerala Dust, Rampue, Stimming, NU, Parra For Cuva, Viken Arman, Mira, Hraach, Just Emma, Be Svendsen, Rodrigo Gallardo, MoM, Britta Arnold, Jacob Groening, Billy Caso, Zigan Aldi to mention a few. They organise events in local infamous clubs, such as TOLDI, Turbina, Akvárium, A38, PONTOON, Budapest Park and play at many other venues and festivals, like DAAD, O.Z.O.R.A, Kolorádó. The guys continuously work or collaborate with local musicians, djs, artists, and collectives doing A&R and this became so important for them that they named the project "Hazai Nyitás", which is also a name for a monthly event series at TOLDI. Wonder why the collective's name is Pure Lust? Make sure to be there enchanted!

Indirect Movement, a 24-year-old DJ / producer from the vibrant country of Hungary. As a skilled producer, Indirect Movement's unique style is characterized by a blend of fast-paced grooves, hypnotic synths, and rough breaks that instantly captivate the listener. His music is a true reflection of the modern techno scene, with each track exuding electric energy that simply cannot be ignored. Despite his relatively young age, Indirect Movement has already achieved a remarkable amount of success in his career. He has released music on some of the most respected labels in the industry, such as Diffraction, BRVTAL, Nice, and Blackrod, garnering critical acclaim from fans and industry professionals alike.

TRYM, born Martin Drack in 1997, is a French DJ and producer who has rapidly become one of the most prominent figures in the modern techno scene. Known for his unique sound that blends HardDance and HardTrance, Trym delivers high-energy sets that captivate audiences worldwide.

Vintage Culture is a Brazilian electronic music powerhouse, rising from a small town to over 1.5 billion Spotify streams and multiple Diamond, Platinum, and Gold certifications. His 2024 debut album Promised Land featured collaborations with The Temper Trap and Maverick Sabre, alongside remix contributions from Solomun and Camelphat. Known for residencies at Hï Ibiza and Wynn Las Vegas, he also launched Vintage Is A Festival, selling out stadiums across Brazil. In 2025, he continues his global ascent with headline performances worldwide.

The Wolves is a traveling street theater show with live music that follows 4 Wall Street brokers on stilts, fusing funk, dance and a quirky workday. The street becomes a stage, while the public accompanies these wolves in an urban jungle of consumption and power. Inspired by the wolf as a symbol, this show reclaims the street as a space for action, turning the viewer into its prey.ACTORS:Santi MartínezVíctor SegarraJuanan LucenaXavi CastellóMarta MartínSergi Heredia ARTISTIC ADVISORY: Sergi EstebanellDRAMATURGY: Antoni Castelló, Anna Dobón, and Sergi HerediaCHOREOGRAPHY: Carmen EsquivelMUSICAL COMPOSITION: Manu ChabreraCOSTUME AND SCENOGRAPHY DESIGN: Sara Recatalà, César Marín, and Beatriz IbáñezMOBILE STRUCTURE: de FerroAUDIOVISUALS AND PHOTOGRAPHY: Nerea Coll and Xavier LlopVIDEO: Lluerna Producció AudiovisualGRAPHIC AND WEB DESIGN: Eclectick StudioADMINISTRATION: Sara Broch

"Kids don’t smoke is the moniker of Vienna based Jan Brunner. He released his first single “Headlights” in early 2025, followed by “Black Out” shortly after. Both songs spread across the internet and accumulated millions of streams. What began as a sidestep passion evolved into a full blown brand, with thousands of people all over the world connecting to the music and first live shows across Europe. His music revolves around what is said in between our words - things you can not describe but only feel when you are young.“

Remi Toin is a young professional Hip-Hop dancer from Bulgaria, known for his unbeatable energy, unexpected moves, and nonstop joy. His style is powerful, playful, and impossible to ignore — and you will probably catch him smiling every time you see him. At The Cypher, he will lead a Hip-Hop workshop and join selected battles throughout the week.

Based between Liège and Ghent, Eosine are a quartet of young twenty- somethings knocking firmly on the door of an international breakthrough, widely tipped as one of Europe’s most exciting new indie acts. Their music sits at the crossroads of post-punk, indie rock, emo and neo-psych, held together by the intoxicating voice of Elena Lacroix. In late 2024, the band released the EP Liminal, culminating in live favourite and closing track ‘Digitaline’ — a perfect distillation of what Eosine stand for: surrender, urgent guitars and drums, sharp tempo shifts and dreamlike vocal lines that demand the volume knob be turned up. Over the past year, Eosine have built an impressive, almost sacred live reputation, with standout performances at Dour, Lokerse Feesten and Into The Great Wide Open, alongside an extensive Dutch support tour with Australian garage-rock outfit Psychedelic Porn Crumpets.In 2026, the band translate that live intensity into new music, paving the way for even more immersive shows and their debut album. First single ‘And Now It Shows’ offers an early glimpse: dreamy vocals colliding with raw emotion, wrapped in addictive post-punk and emo, with a touch of glam drama. Lacroix explains: “As soon as I wrote it, the song immediately asserted itself as the lead single. It’s an ode to intensity and a rejection of the taboo surrounding hypersensitivity. Just under three minutes long and clocking in at 210 bpm — that’s all it takes to hit repeat.”

Bolero is an ‘open rehearsal’ themed presentation in which a Bolero-named duet is practiced and prepared. Two dancers specialised in acrobatics and floorwork have become tools for the classical artist's genius; but inspiration is running low and the choreography is not progressing. The work atmosphere is tense, the humour is dark, and the dance is dangerous. This uniquely designed performance features a combination of black comedy, skilled, fast-paced dance, and a showcase of techniques from different acrobatic disciplines.​ Choreographer Jarkko Mandelin’s latest creation was recently featured at the 2025 Assembly Edinburgh Fringe Festival.  Choreography: Jarkko Mandelin and performers Performers: Jarkko Mandelin, Luca Bologna and Hugo Sellam Sound design and composition: Janne Hast Production: Kinetic Orchestra

How do we stare, sexualize, and objectify bodies? This solo unfolds as a slow-burn asexual romance and invites the audience to experience a gaze that lingers without devouring. Drawing inspiration from flashy 90’s and 00’s pop music videos, sultry dance routines emerge, only to be stripped down and recontextualized, allowing the body to move, sweat, and exist without being an object of desire. Flóra Boros desexualizes choreographies one hair flip at a time, eroding lustful gestures through repetition. Gently teasing, she perpetually challenges the viewers’ perspective: the ace gaze becomes a filter, a mirror, and a queer mode of looking back.

Emma Nolde is a highly talented singer-songwriter and musician. She finds her fullest expression in live performance—being on stage is her true craft. She loves poetry.She has released three albums, and with her latest, NUOVOSPAZIOTEMPO, she received widespread acclaim from both audiences and critics, becoming a finalist at the Targhe Tenco for the second time (2020 for Best Debut Album; 2025 for Best Overall Album), despite being only 25 years old.

Over the past few years, Giant Rooks have successfully hit one milestone after another – selling out shows in Germany, North and South America and Europe, performing on the world’s biggest festival stages, and amassing hundreds of millions of streams. Since forming the band in 2015, Frederik Rabe (vocals), Finn Schwieters (guitar), Luca Göttner (bass), Jonathan Wischniowski (keyboard) and Finn Thomas (drums), have taken the indie scene by storm with hits like “Wild Stare” and “Morning Blue.” Their debut album, “Rookery” (2020) has over 220 million streams and reached #3 on the German album charts. About four years after their internationally successful debut, Giant Rooks released their long-awaited follow-up album “How Have You Been?“ on February 2nd, 2024, which even surpassed the success of their debut album and reached #1 in the German album charts. The album is a musical odyssey that navigates vivid and emotional landscapes, full of domestic minutiae and existential reckoning, much like the pages of a diary that are shamelessly honest, cutting, and from that deep place that is only known by the heart. "How have you been?" is a collection of songs that really define for the listener what Giant Rooks is all about. And as with “Rookery“, the feeling remains that this is by no means the end of the story. In 2025 the band ́s main focus is on writing and producing new songs. Only at the end of the summer will they play a few selected shows, including their long-awaited homecoming shows in their hometown of Hamm, Germany.

ROSE MAY is a Hungarian singer, songwriter, and producer blending pop, hip-hop, and R&B with a sound that is all her own – raw, emotional, and real. Her songs are personal stories about vulnerability, inner battles, and rebirth. As a producer, she is all about breaking the rules and chasing sounds that do not fit into boxes – just like her. With bold, unapologetic rap lyrics ROSE MAY does not follow the crowd, she creates her own lane. She’s already lit up stages like Akvárium, Veszprém Aréna, Pontoon, and is set to perform at Sziget Festival this August.

PLAYWORK is a study of choreography and how it operates. Within defined conditions, four dancers engage one another in a practice of sustained attention. Subtle action is the result of a highly charged, game-like atmosphere. Set to the music of Belgian composer Liesa van der Aa, the piece emerges from rigorous practice and the essential need of being in relation to others.

artist: The New Era of Love and Sex
description: Sex is no longer a taboo — but have we truly become more liberated? As conversations around desire, trauma, and intimacy grow more open, entirely new relationship models and emotional dynamics are emerging around us. Situationships, polyamory, and intentional singlehood are no longer fringe concepts, but part of a new generation’s understanding of love and connection. Where do the new boundaries lie, and how are social media, pop culture, and constant self-expression reshaping the way we experience modern relationships?

Grandmas House, Bristol’s finest and loudest 4 piece, have been busy honing their grunge and post-punk influenced sound, citing influences that range from Idles and The Raincoats to Nirvana and boygenius; Yasmin, Poppy, Zoë and Polly are a genuinely unique proposition. Refusing to be pigeon holed, they are here to shake up perceptions with their intelligent, stylish and raucous take on rock music and a live show to remember.

cibi, born Dávid Czibulka in 1996, is a Slovak-Hungarian artist whose path has ranged from water polo and martial arts to graphic design and economics before discovering songwriting during the COVID era. His debut album “EDM trip” (2025) surpassed 1 million streams, while the single “pocahontass” achieved gold certification the same year. Shortly after, he released his next EP, “KRÉZI PLANET EARTH”. Alongside a busy live schedule of more than 20 shows in 2025, including festival appearances, support for Bëlga, and headline concerts at Turbina and Akvárium, cibi also launched a 10-date club tour with Mikee Mykanic. Blending drum & bass, house, Balkan pop, and philosophical themes into a futuristic sound, cibi creates music that resists categorization. His performances combine immersive visuals, live drums, and high-energy storytelling, aiming not only to entertain but also to inspire a more conscious and thoughtful society.

Winners of the 2025 MOBO Award for Best Alternative Music Act, ALT BLK ERA are UK sister duo Nyrobi (21) and Chaya (18). Their debut album Rave Immortal - a UK Rock & Metal No.1 - is a genre-smashing blend of Electronic sounds fused with Rock and DnB, proving their ability to bring underground club energy into alternative spaces. As well as lighting up Spotify editorial playlists and UK radio, the sisters have also showcased their sound on major UK platforms, performing live on Later… with Jools Holland and Channel 4’s Sunday Brunch, cementing their reputation as one of the most exciting new forces in genre-fluid music. BBC Introducing hailed them as Ones to Watch in 2025 before they represented the UK at SXSW, Texas showcasing at The British Music Embassy. They have also delivered standout performances at iconic UK and EU festivals, where their raw energy leave audiences in no doubt that ALT BLK ERA are redefining what alternative, electronic and rock music can be. Press acclaim has come from NME, REVOLVER and Kerrang!, with the Brit Awards calling their sound “break the repeat button.” Beyond the music, the sisters advocate for hidden disability awareness and inclusivity in the industry, inspired by Nyrobi’s personal journey - a theme woven through Rave Immortal. With a growing international profile, ALT BLK ERA are proving themselves as one of the most forward-thinking acts shaping the future of alternative sound.

Techno DJ from Turin, Italy, returning to Sziget Festival for the fourth consecutive year. Over the years he has built a strong presence in Turin’s techno scene and is also the founder of the Reconnection project. His path has led him to perform in different cities, up to his residency in Barcelona with Pandemonium since 2024. His sound is fast, raw and physical: blending techno, fast groove and acid with the power of hard house, with touches of schranz and hard trance. Relentless grooves, dirty basslines and driving rhythms shape a visceral journey, direct and uncompromising, where the focus is not the genre, but the energy and impact on the dancefloor.

As DJ Buck once said... “this party just got good. ” Los Angeles native and Stüssy tribe member, Hank, has DJ’d in just about every environment you can think of and traveled the world doing so. His own label Kopa Records, founded a couple years back, is a creative vehicle and ode to the early 2000’s west coast house movement. Hank, being closely tied to the late Virgil Abloh’s world of culture, music, and movement, his work lives at the intersection of underground club music and broader creative spaces. From Glastonbury Festival, to Pacha Ibiza, and Club Space, Hank’s sets move with a steady pulse, shaped by feel rather than flash. He’s shared the booth with Seth Troxler, Jamie Jones, tINI, Chris Stussy, Paramida, Damian Lazarus, Quest, Chloe Calliet, Skepta, and Blond:ish—while his presence continues to surface in unexpected places, from Lot Radio to the Louis Vuitton runway, Coachella, or DJing in your kitchen. Recent releases on 8Bit Records and his own imprint Kopa Records reflect a refined approach. With multiple releases lined up, new label collaborations, and an active touring schedule, 2026 shapes up as a pivotal year, where the sound, vision, and momentum fully align.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Singer and actress Bori Péterfy began her career in the early 1990s in Budapest, where she was an active figure in the flourishing alternative theatre scene before later becoming a member of the National Theatre. Her musical journey started in 2007 with Péterfy Bori & Love Band, a project conceived by Ambrus Tövisházi, and their breakthrough song “Hajolj bele a hajamba,” which brought nationwide recognition to both Bori and the band. Their debut album—an eclectic blend of chanson, alternative rock and psychedelic pop—firmly placed Love Band on the Hungarian music map. Apart from a short break during Bori’s pregnancy, the band has been continuously touring ever since. Their tenth anniversary release, Bori X, was launched in an unconventional format as a free downloadable mobile game app. Their latest, eighth studio album, Medúza, was released in October 2024. Now approaching two decades together, the band regularly tours across Hungary, delivering joyful and high-energy performances in clubs, theatre halls and on festival stages alike.

There is spirit and fire in the music of The Zawose Queens. There's the vibrations of the ancestors, coming through on traditional instruments — soaring chizeze fiddle, buzzing illimba thumb piano, ngoma drums that chatter and thunder — and voices that go deep, high and out there. There's the connection to nature, to ceremony and ritual, in their dance-inspired fusion, their blend of the organic, harmonic and modern-day electronic. There are lyrics that tell, in their native kigogo, of the passion for music, the wonders of life. Of pride in environment, in tradition. In their East African roots.Pendo and Leah Zawose showcase the fluid polyrhythms and rapturous polyphonic singing of the Gogo (aka Wagogo) people of the arid, hilly Dodoma region of central Tanzania. The most famous exponent of this musical tradition is the late, great Dr Hukwe Zawose (Pendo’s father and Leah’s grandfather).Maisha, the debut album by The Zawose Queens, marks the first time that women from this famous musical family take their place as lead vocalists and performers. Emboldened by workshops in songwriting and music production with visiting UK-based producers Oli Barton-Wood (Jordan Rakei, Obongjayar, Nilufer Yanya) and Tom Excell (Nubiyan Twist, Onipa), The Zawose Queens began writing their first ever songs. The resulting collection of songs range from the stripped back and traditional-sounding to those treated with subtle electronic elements, with beats and drops and found sounds and switch-ups.

Prélude Out is a vibrant "all-terrain" performance by Kader Attou and Cie Accrorap, designed specifically for public spaces. In this condensed 35-minute version, nine virtuoso dancers from diverse backgrounds explore a raw, collective dance that celebrates the power of movement and shared emotion. Set to Romain Dubois’s intense electroacoustic score, the choreography becomes a physical and poetic metaphor for human struggle and solidarity. It is an urgent, joyful invitation to connect through the vital impulse of breath. Performers / Dancers: Alexis de Saint Jean, Jikay, Damien Bourletsis, Aline Lopes, Margaux Senechault, Yann Miettaux, Azdine Bouncer, Nabjibe Said, Simon Hernandez. Choreography: Kader Attou Artistic direction: Kader Attou Music (Musical composition): Romain Dubois. Lighting Design: Cécile Giovansili-Vissière. roduction: Cie Accrorap. The capacity to stay with oneself during a fall. How “holding oneself” during moments of vulnerability and uncertainty is possible. This dance unfolds through fragmented scenes of emotional collapse, confrontation, surrender, and intimate encounters. Through movement, it fosters curiosity to gently embrace every emotional state without fragmenting parts of ourselves. It asks how surrender can become an act of strength in times of collapse.

girlhood is an all-female band that sings mostly about heartbreak, casual relationships, the struggles of growing up, life’s challenges, and mental health – blending playful synths with bursts of punky guitars.

Two powerful dancers with distinct personal worlds meet in this intense duet where contemporary dance and hip-hop collide. Coming from different backgrounds, they search for a shared language through movement, rhythm, and presence. Raw, intimate, and constantly shifting, the performance explores attraction, tension, individuality, and connection. A vibrant physical dialogue about how two people can stay true to themselves while creating a real encounter together.

Biffy Clyro are one of the UK's most successful rock bands, they have released 3 UK number 1 albums to date and performed numerous headline sets at the likes of Reading & Leeds, Download, TRNSMT and Isle of Wight. Their highly anticipated new album ‘Futique’ is set to release on 26th September, featuring new single ‘A Little Love’, which debuted as Hottest Record in the world on BBC Radio One. Following highly celebrated sets headlining this year’s TRNSMT Festival and on the Pyramid Stage at Glastonbury Festival, the band have received high praise from the likes of The Guardian: ‘an absolutely triumphant reminder that they… have a formidable greatest hits set when they need it’ and Kerrang!: ‘a masterclass in joy and professionalism, with every element finely tuned’ and are now set to embark on their next UK & European headline tour in 2026. To celebrate the release of their previous album - UK number 1 ‘A Celebration of Endings’ - the band performed the record in full on their ground-breaking livestream from Glasgow’s Barrowland Ballroom in 2020. They later won Best Entertainment at the BAFTA Scotland Awards for this livestream performance. Biffy have received countless awards, including: four NME Awards (2 x Best British Band, Best Live Band and Best Music Video); five Kerrang! Awards (2 x Best British Band, Classic Songwriter, Best Album and Best Music Video); and two Q Awards (Best Live Band and Best Album). They’ve also been nominated for three BRIT Awards (all for Best British Group, most recently in 2021) and a Mercury Prize.

Cypher Town Battle is one of the most exciting programs of The Cypher stage. Festival-goers will witness showcase battles at a level usually only seen at the world’s top competitions. Every day, world-renowned dancers, DJs, and hosts come together to deliver awesome showcase battles in an unforgettable atmosphere. The battles feature three styles: breaking, hip-hop, and house. And the judges? It’s you — the crowd decides who wins!

What is LavaLava? - One of Budapest's oldest party series, which has been bringing together Hungary's most open-minded audiences on a monthly basis since 2008. - A promoter team who have hosted and introduced over a hundred international acts to Hungarian audiences, from the biggest legends to the most exciting breakthrough acts and some personal heroes like Kevin Saunderson, Juan Atkins, Josh Wink, Tiga, Gerd Janson, KINK and many more…    - A fresh label that wants to showcase itself and Hungary's talented house/techno producers to the world.  - Two brothers who are as different as they are similar, not only in appearance but also in their taste of music.  - Polynesian skirt-like unisex wear. - The title of a Boys Noize song from 2007, which inspired the choice of the team's name during the good old electro craze.

Houston-born and LA-based singer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, and producer DE’WAYNE has amassed tens of millions of streams across STAINS (2021), My Favorite Blue Jeans (2022), and I WANT YOU MORE THAN ANYBODY WANTS YOU EP (2024). Following the latter, UPSET put him on its cover, while KERRANG! hailed him as “one of the most electrifying new performers in the alt. world today.” Equally at home collaborating with Chase Atlantic, Masego, IDKHOW, Waterparks, grandson, WILLOW, Good Charlotte, and Tom Morello, DE’WAYNE channels influences from Lenny Kravitz to Nina Simone. His latest work embraces the divine feminine with new openness, showcasing his growth as a proud Black man, son, friend, leader, artist, and lover.
