stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Ivan & The Parazol, the MTV EMA-winning alternative rock band from Budapest, is in their Golden Era with their most original album yet: Belle Époque. With massive stadium rock- esque choruses, razor sharp grooves, and powerful riffs homageing the Golden Age of guitar music, this record marks the moment of truth: they truly found themselves and their unique sound. Their single Breeze made history as the first Hungarian track from a Budapest band to premiere on BBC Radio 1, proving that IATP is making waves far beyond their home country.

Golden Hours, based in Berlin and Brussels, are a band of seasoned musicians with roots in acts like Gang Of Four, The Brian Jonestown Massacre, and Tricky. Their new album Beyond Wires, written and recorded across both cities, blends fuzz, noise, and strong melodies, even embracing electrical interference as part of its sound. With dual lead vocals, interwoven guitars, and a tight yet explosive rhythm section, the band crafts a distinctive sonic identity through instinct, experience, and raw experimentation.

artist: DIANA SALLES: DELUSIONAL I Killed a Man
description: DELUSIONAL I Killed a Man is a contemporary circus solo show that embarks on a trans woman´s journey.  The show explores the haunting feeling of having murdered one’s former self, a common experience for many trans women when leaving their assigned gender behind.  Through a multidisciplinary repertoire of circus disciplines such as aerials, dance, singing, and physical theatre, Diana Salles invites us to reflect on the physical and emotional strength it takes to honor one’s deepest truth. The show highlights the inherent connection between death and rebirth. Performer: Diana Salles  Authors: Diana Salles Firenza Guidi Direction: Firenza Guidi  Light creation: Firenza Guidi & Boy Den Boer Sound creation: Lukas Thielecke Costumes: Alexander Michael Arnold Production & Booking: Quartier Libre Productions

Get to know some of the most exciting faces of Dumaszínház at Sziget! Fresh, irreverent and thought-provoking stand-up performances by some of the most talented young comedians of the new generation. Performers: Rudolf Forgács, Juli Jancsik, Zoárd Nényei, Gábor Ress and Gábor Siklósi.

artist: Nóra Horváth/Balázs Oláh: BÁL - Hungarian Mulatós dance workshop
description: Discover the world of mulatós dance! In our workshop, you will learn the most important basic steps and figures step by step. Whether you are a absolute beginner or already have some experience, you will definitely find your place with us. You can dance to the best mulatós hits in our class, and a great atmosphere is guaranteed!  Nóri and Balázs first met in 2015, and have shared a close personal and professional relationship ever since. They began their research into mulatós culture in 2021, aiming to uncover and archive the true value of mulatós music and dance. Balázs Oláh - Dancer Nóra Horváth - Dancer János R. Szabó - DJ

WXLFLESS has evolved over the years from a bedroom project into a solo rap act, and today his live performances are best described as a fusion of pop-punk and rap. In 2025, he performed at nearly every major festival in Hungary and released his third studio album, featuring collaborations with artists such as Sisi, Beton.Hofi, and Co Lee. After an extended creative break, WXLFLESS is excited to return to the Sziget Festival, where he debuted his live band last year.

WILD WILD WOMEN (WWW) is India's first all-female hip-hop collective, a revolutionary, multi-disciplinary ensemble hailing from Mumbai. Founded in 2021 by rappers Krantinaari (Ashwini Hiremath), HashtagPreeti (Preeti N Sutar), MC Mahila (Shruti Raut), JQueen (Jacquilin Lucas), and Pratika (Pratika E. Prabhune), the collective is celebrated for flipping the script on the male-dominated Indian hip-hop scene.Their sound is a powerful fusion of English, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, and Kannada lyrics, tackling themes from women's empowerment and mental health to challenging patriarchy and social biases. Known for their electrifying, unapologetic live shows - often featuring B-girls, a graffiti artist, and a skateboarder - Wild Wild Women is a vital force, having quickly amassed a strong following, performed across India's biggest stages, and recently made their international debut in Germany. They are more than a band; they are a movement.

Renowned multi-instrumentalist, singer, songwriter, and producer Tash Sultana is making their long-awaited return to the EU/UK in March 2026. These will be Tash’s first shows in the region since 2023, and they’re back by high demand, marking the biggest headline performances of their career in this market to date. The Return to the Roots EU/UK 2026 Tour follows the release of Tash’s most recent body of work and promises fans a powerful new live experience. From beloved fan favourites to unreleased material, this tour will showcase a completely reimagined production and stage show—an evolution of the raw, electrifying performances Tash is globally celebrated for. The release of Return to the Roots EP is the beginning of an exciting new chapter for Tash. a raw and fearless six-track EP that peels back the layers of fame and expectation to reconnect with the core of their artistry. From rural Victoria to the global stage, CC:DISCO! has built her career around one core idea: music first. From radio host to headliner, she has stayed true to her warm, uplifting and playful sound, connecting with audiences through emotion and movement rather than ego.She has performed worldwide, from intimate clubs to major festivals like Glastonbury, Sonar, Kala and Pitch, while also appearing on platforms such as Boiler Room, NTS, Rinse FM and BBC Essential Mix. As a producer, she has released music on Phantasy Sound and her own label Miami Daddy, showcasing her signature blend of Balearic, percussion-driven grooves and femme energy.Deeply connected to local scenes, especially in Lisbon and Australia, CC:DISCO! continues to build community through her music, parties and collaborations.

Natasha Bedingfield rose to global fame in the early 2000s with her empowering anthem “Unwritten,” a Grammy-nominated hit that became a defining pop classic and cultural staple. Around its 20th anniversary, the song experienced a major revival, going viral on TikTok and re-entering the charts after being featured in the hit rom-com Anyone But You, eventually reaching the Billboard Global 200.Other hits such as “Pocketful of Sunshine,” “Love Like This,” “Soulmate,” and “These Words” have also found renewed life across social media platforms. Her music continues to resonate across generations, appearing everywhere from sports celebrations to viral online moments.In recent years, Natasha has toured festivals worldwide as her catalog surpassed one billion Spotify streams. Alongside her music career, she actively supports causes focused on women, children, environmental protection, and the LGBTQ+ community. With new music on the horizon, Bedingfield is entering a fresh creative chapter while continuing to deliver powerful and uplifting live performances.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: The collaboration between Bohemian Betyars and Parno Graszt has become one of the most exciting musical fusions on the Hungarian scene in recent years. The meeting of speed-folk-punk energy and traditional Roma folk music creates a unique, dynamic, and authentic sound that appeals to both lovers of tradition and fans of contemporary music. From their very first meeting, there was an undeniable chemistry between the two bands, which quickly grew into a lasting artistic and personal partnership. They have performed numerous joint concerts across the country, including several sold-out shows at Budapest Park. Their performances are defined by a liberated, joyful atmosphere and explosive stage presence that captivates audiences every time. Their joint releases — including the 2024 single “A falu rossza” — have further strengthened the success of their collaboration. In January 2025, they crowned their shared journey with a spectacular concert at the Budapest Arena, delivering an unforgettable celebration.

Chadia Rodriguez is an Italian rapper and singer-songwriter, born in Almería (Spain) on November 6, 1998, and raised in Turin. Charismatic and outspoken, she has become one of the most recognizable female voices in the Italian urban scene thanks to a provocative style, explicit lyrics, and a powerful image that blends female empowerment, sensuality, and street attitude. Chadia moves between rap, trap, and urban pop with a raw, unfiltered language. Her lyrics speak about independence, sexual freedom, ambition, and personal redemption, making her a divisive yet extremely impactful figure in the Italian music landscape. She is widely considered a pioneer of explicit mainstream female rap in Italy. She began releasing music in 2018, immediately gaining attention through viral singles and high- impact music videos. Success came quickly, leading her to collaborate with major artists and perform in top Italian clubs and festivals. Over the years, she has strengthened her artistic brand through fashion, social media, and image, becoming a pop-urban icon especially followed by younger generations.

HEALTH’s RAT WARS is the band’s most intense and emotionally exposed album to date, blending brutal industrial aggression with personal vulnerability and dark humor. Drawing from their long, unconventional career and pandemic-era collaborations, the record pushes the boundaries between metal, electronic and pop while speaking directly to a young, online-driven subculture. Fierce, ambitious and uncompromising, RAT WARS stands as HEALTH’s boldest statement yet on the chaos of contemporary life.

THIRD 2HIFT is a crucial member of the DEAD END crew  He already played in France or Berlin and nowadays you can hear him playing almost every weekend in the largest clubs of Budapest. In his sets, he strives to remain diverse and always try to adapt to the given lineup even if its harder techno or a trancy one. His tracks have been played worldwide by huge names in the techno scene, such as Parfait, LeeAnn Roberts, Rouge, Callush, Bours, SWART or Charlie Sparks.

Gabriella Lester is a 22-year-old, internationally award-winning magician. Known for her quick wit and sardonic charm, she has quickly become one of the fastest-growing names in the industry. Gabriella is one of the youngest performers ever to attempt Houdini’s daring suspended straitjacket escape (at the age of 14). She has performed on some of the biggest stages in Vegas, appeared on Penn and Teller’s hit show Fool Us, been featured in The New York Times, and is known for her world-renowned TEDx Talk titled “The Magic of Pursuing Your Passion.” Most recently, she toured Australia and Singapore as part of Now You See Me Live, produced by Lionsgate, notably selling out the Sydney Opera House. This July, she will take the show to London’s West End before coming to showcase her skills at SZIGET.

Hungarian alt-pop artist Saya Noé emerged into the Eastern European music scene region early thanks to her characteristic songs, molding a perfect fusion of Alt Pop and Electronic, performed both as a solo artist and with a live band. After having performed at every major festival in Hungary, (Sziget, Volt, Campus, Szin, ect..), she is now expanding her audience in countries such as Poland, Czech Republic and Slovakia. Since 2020, she has consistently ranked among the top 10 ar/sts on HOTS, the Hungarian music export agency, posi/oning herself as one of the most promising domes/c acts capable of making an impact on the interna/onal scene. In 2022, she received the Artisjus Award as Pop Music Songwriter and Creator of the Year. In 2023, Saya Noé became an ambassador for Spotify's EQUAL campaign as an independent ar/st. Her album “Jupiter” was released in late September 2023 and went on to win the Fonogram Prize for Best Electronic Album of 2024. Her latest EP, “Venus”, was released in the spring of 2024.

Rising electronic producer and DJ ATRIP returns with his highly anticipated mixtape TANZPARTEI II, marking a bold evolution of his sound. Building on the success of the first instalment, the project expands his creative vision through collaborations with artists like KAM-BU, TeaMarrr, Bawo, and Poté, blending electronic music with rap and vocal-driven elements.Defined by its dynamic energy — from euphoric club moments to introspective moods — the mixtape reflects ATRIP’s commitment to pushing boundaries while staying true to his vibrant, dancefloor-ready style. Tracks like “Friday (Alone Right Now)” have already become staples in his DJ sets, supported by names such as Barry Can’t Swim and Disclosure.With major shows alongside Disclosure and a North American tour, ATRIP continues to build momentum, establishing himself as one of the UK’s most exciting new electronic artists.

Her love for music started at a very young age when she attended dance classes. Later, she went to art school to learn photography and her friends introduced her techno, but something was always missing for her: she realized she wanted to learn to play and express herself her own way. However, music was not her priority at this point and her plans to make music were put aside for some time until 2020, when she had her first gig as Paralich (‘Paralysis ‘in Russian). That was the life changing experience that finally put her on the path of becoming a professional DJ. Although the past years have been very difficult for artists, Paralich managed to start her own label and party series called Dead End which is one of the most popular events in the Budapest underground electronic music scene, and also build her own career as Paralich. She plays Groovy, Funky TRance, but she also like to mix it with old school music from the 90’s, her sets are even trancy or have Gabber vibes. She makes a show when behind the decks, and although she likes to mix different music you surely can recognize the unique Paralich style.

Grammy-Award winning band, Twenty One Pilots, have shifted music and culture as an incomparable creative force and with an ever-evolving vision. The Columbus, OH duo—Tyler Joseph and Josh Dun— have tallied over 33 billion global streams and counting, sold north of three million tickets worldwide, notched dozens of multi-Platinum certifications, and even claimed a spot in the Guinness® Book of World Records. In historic fashion, their quadruple-Platinum breakout LP, Blurryface, took flight as “the first album to notch a RIAA Gold or Platinum certification for every one of its songs, while Vessel followed suit and achieved the same distinction. They elevated to rarified air as “one of only 18 artists to earn multiple RIAA Diamond certifications,” going Diamond with “Stressed Out” and “Heathens.” 2018’s Platinum-certified Trench extended the ambitious concept laid out in Blurryface and delivered the multi-Platinum and Platinum singles: “Chlorine,” “My Blood” and the GRAMMY® Award-nominated “Jumpsuit.” They followed Trench with their Gold-certified LP Scaled And Icy, achieving “the biggest opening week for a rock album in 2021” by capturing #1 on the Billboard Top Rock Albums and Top Alternative Albums charts and crashing the Top 3 of the Billboard 200. Beyond rapturous headline shows at arenas and festivals worldwide, Twenty One Pilots have notably architected an immersive world without comparison, originating a multi-album conceptual arc across Blurryface, Trench, Scaled And Icy, and Trench. In 2024, the band released their seventh full-length offering, Clancy [Fueled By Ramen], which shattered records as the biggest rock debut AND biggest rock album overall of 2024. Led by the single “Overcompensate,” the LP signals the dawn of another era for Twenty One Pilots and alternative rock music at large. The band closed out the year with “The Line,” an original track for Netflix’s Arcane Season 2 that has already seen massive growth on streaming platforms. Just weeks after wrapping their massive Clancy World Tour, Twenty One Pilots announced their latest record, Breach, which marks the long-awaited conclusion to the story first introduced a decade ago on Blurryface. The first single off the record, “The Contract,” marked the biggest song debut of the band’s career and reached #1 on the Alternative Airplay chart, their 12th time accomplishing this feat. Following the album’s release on September 12, the band kicks off THE CLANCY TOUR: BREACH 2025, which will hit stadiums and amphitheatres across North America, closing with two nights at BMO Stadium in Los Angeles.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker

description: Melina was born into a family where the oral transmission of traditional music holds a central place. Of Greek origin, she carries this heritage through her voice, rich in melismatic ornamentation and emotional depth.She trained extensively in singing and oud at the Conservatory of Oriental Music in Gennevilliers, and continued studying traditional music in Greece.After this period of research and learning, Melina launched her own musical project: a poetic, urban, and magical universe, where traditional music blends with pop influences. She surrounds herself with virtuoso musicians to bring to life a unique, sensitive, and powerful aesthetic.Her debut EP, scheduled for June, is its first expression.

Chet Faker first captured global attention with his haunting 2011 cover of Blackstreet’s “No Diggity,” followed by the acclaimed Lockjaw EP with Flume and his platinum-selling debut Built On Glass, earning multiple ARIA Awards. Since then, he has released a critically praised discography, including 2021’s Hotel Surrender and work as Nick Murphy, while touring worldwide and selling out headline shows. His new album A Love For Strangers arrives 13 February 2026.

Metha (Mátyás Végh) has been an influential figure in the Hungarian electronic music scene for more than two decades. Guided by the philosophy that “good music matters more than genres,” his productions have been played by artists such as Solomun, Richie Hawtin, Joseph Capriati and Egbert, while his releases regularly appear on Beatport charts.In recent years his international presence has grown significantly, sharing line-ups with artists like Paul Kalkbrenner, Stephan Bodzin, Adriatique, Mind Against and Dubfire, while performing across Europe at renowned clubs and festivals.Metha is also the founder of the Be Massive and Be Massive Horizon event series, two of Hungary’s most respected underground electronic music platforms, bringing internationally acclaimed DJs to unique locations and audiences for nearly two decades.As a DJ, producer and curator, Metha continues to shape the future of Hungary’s electronic music culture.

Swimming Paul is a French DJ and producer from Paris whose musical journey began in London. Emerging in 2023, his early singles, including Fading, earned BBC Radio 1 support from Pete Tong, Danny Howard, and Jess Iszatt. He steadily built a devoted fanbase, releasing music every 4–6 weeks and debuting his album Smiling Through The Pain in June 2024. Known for high-energy, emotional sets, he collaborated with Tiësto on the 2024 club anthem VHS RAVE and sold out shows of up to 2,000 people, establishing himself as a rising global electronic talent.

artist: Stacey Clare and Keri Gold ELSC Productions CIC
description: Do you have a problem? Don't know where to turn? Come and share your load with two unshockable, world-weary strippers, who've seen and heard it all. Stacey Clare and Keri Gold are on a quest to bring empathy, compassion and understanding out of the strip club and onto the stage. These hardened therapists in thigh-highs hold space for their audience, offering shrewd insights and razor-sharp intuition – after all they’ve been giving free therapy to men in strip clubs for years. So if you are dealing with a personal dilemma or just want to experience candid and hilarious life advice, don’t miss out - laughter, wisdom and sage advice guaranteed.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Kispál és a Borz keeps charging ahead in 2026! One of the most influential alternative bands of the past decades announced their reunion in 2022, and in 2023 Lovasi and his bandmates released a brand-new album titled Beszorult mondat. Their highly successful nationwide and Western European tour in 2024 was followed by a spectacular arena show: the band closed the year with a massive “house party” at the MVM Dome.In 2025, they launched a 25-date, sold-out concert series titled ETETÉS 2025, filling Budapest’s Kobuci Garden nine times along the way. In 2026, the band will perform at venues where they have either never played before or haven’t appeared in many years.This year, Kispál és a Borz performs in the now well-established lineup:- András Lovasi – vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar- András Kispál – guitar- D. Ákos Dióssy – keyboards- Ferenc Bajkai – drums- Hunor G. Szabó – drums, guitar- Bence Babcsán – brass instruments

YT has been making music since the age of 14, steadily building a loyal fanbase over the past nine years. His breakthrough came in 2023 with the SoundCloud tape #SWAGRENAISSANCE, where he introduced his signature sound built on energetic jerk beats with a distinct British flair. Known for catchy autotune melodies, witty punchlines, and playful lyricism, YT quickly became a standout name in the underground scene. In 2024 his viral track “Black and Tan”with Lancey Foux surpassed 12 million streams, followed by hits like “MVP,” “Prada,” and “Celine.” With his highly anticipated tape OI! and upcoming EU and UK tour, YT is set for his biggest year yet.

Zsófia Helmeczi is a Budapest-based visual artist, motion designer and VJ whose work explores the intersection of emotion, technology and immersive storytelling. Come Closer is an audiovisual installation inspired by the idea that emotions may be the one language we all understand. Through generative visuals, light and sound, the project invites visitors to move closer to themselves and one another. Rather than telling a single story, it creates space for reflection, exploring the invisible emotional landscapes that connect us. Come Closer invites us to recognise that beneath our different lives, backgrounds and stories, many of our deepest feelings are remarkably similar.

KKEVIN (Kevin Kövesi) is one of the leading names in Hungary’s rap and new wave rap scene. He broke through in 2020 with his hit “Chivas” and has since built a strong presence through nationwide tours, major festival appearances, and increasingly large headline shows. Known for his honest and personal lyrics, KKEVIN has cultivated a loyal fanbase while collaborating with artists such as ValMar, Bruno x Spacc, T. Danny, Desh, and Young Fly. His 2025 EP PRIORITÁS marked a new chapter in his career, followed by sold-out shows at Akvárium Klub and two successful headline concerts at Budapest Park, including one attended by nearly 10,000 fans. His digital success is equally impressive: “Csavargó” with L.L. Junior has surpassed 43 million YouTube views, while KKEVIN attracts over 500,000 monthly listeners on Spotify.

Cheeky, sassy, ​​and party-loving – that's how Ikkimel from Tempelhof presents herself, the exaggerated personification of the bad company the Roman Catholic Church has always warned against. As West Berlin's "best horse in the stable," she rides through the capital's nightlife with a big mouth, skimpy outfits, and a sore nose, behaving like Pippi Longstocking on party drugs. Her single "KETA & KRAWALL," released on September 29, 2023, and celebrated on TikTok, is her sex-positive, hedonistic manifesto, an ode to the carefree life amidst strobe lights, beer taps, and yellow cards. Ikkimel isn't afraid of dirty jokes or boorish behavior and is the perfect companion for both a relaxed evening at the local pub and furious techno parties at Zwanglos II.

Tripolism, a Danish trio from Copenhagen, blend house, disco, and techno into a distinct, immersive sound. They broke through in 2023 with Dope Dance, crowned Pete Tong’s Essential New Tune and later a Top 5 track of the year. Their debut album Absolute Dope (2024, Ultra Records) cemented their rising international profile, while official remixes like Lola’s Theme (#1 on Beatport) and collaborations such as Sunrise and Groove On showcase their evolving style. With a relentless creative drive, Tripolism continue shaping modern dance music and expanding their global reach.

Ashnikko (Ashton Nicole Casey) is an American rapper, singer-songwriter, and producer currently based in London. She grew up in Greensboro, North Carolina, then moved with her family to Estonia and later to Riga, Latvia during her teenage years. She released her first track, KROKODIL, in 2016, followed by her debut EP Sass Pancakes in 2017. Her next EPs, Unlikeable (2018) and Hi It’s Me (2019), continued to build her audience. In 2019, her single Stupid went viral on TikTok and became her breakthrough hit. Her first mixtape, DEMIDEVIL, arrived in 2021, featuring viral songs like Daisy and Slumber Party. In 2023, she released her debut studio album WEEDKILLER. She also wrote a diss track about a classmate and co-wrote Boss Bitch with Doja Cat for the Birds of Prey soundtrack.

BELANO is one of the fastest-rising new artists on the Hungarian pop scene. With his distinctive sound, honest songwriting, and unique blend of Hungarian and German influences, he has quickly built a strong following. He currently has over 355,000 monthly listeners on Spotify, with standout tracks including “STARBOY”, “SHAKE DAT” with VINI, and “BULLSHIT” with BSW. Combining modern pop with infectious energy and a recognizable artistic identity, BELANO has established himself as one of the most exciting voices of Hungary’s new generation of artists.

SveTec's musical journey began in the musical primary school, where he developed his musical skills by learning the music rules and various instruments. His interest in electronic music ignited in 1996, and by the age of 12, he realized he wanted to become a DJ. In 2000, he fully immersed himself in electronic music production, dedicating almost all of his free time to this passion.By 2005, he had gained international recognition for his exceptional work, with his music being played by renowned artists such as DJ Rush, PetDuo, O.B.I., and many others.As a celebrated hard techno artist for over two decades, SveTec has performed in numerous countries all around the globe. He has graced the stages most of the iconic events (Awakenings, NatureOne, Verknipt, Blackworks, Sziget, Bonusz) alongside many of the legendary figures in the techno and hard techno genres. His numerous productions established him as a key figure in the hard techno scene, making him both a pioneer and reformer of the genre's sound.In his sets, he strives to stand out from the monotony of crowded beats with his top productions and unique mixing skills.In 2016, he launched his record label, Mad Made, which serves as an ideal platform for both emerging talents and established hard techno legends.

Tiga is far more than a DJ or producer — he’s a restless creative force driven by ambition, wit, and a refusal to stand still. For over two decades, he has shaped global electronic music while balancing the roles of performer, label head (Turbo Recordings), and cultural tastemaker.From early inspirations like Bowie and Detroit techno pioneers to founding his own label and collaborating with artists such as Duke Dumont, Depeche Mode, Moby, Pusha T, and The Martinez Brothers, Tiga has consistently evolved his sound. His career is defined by constant reinvention, curiosity, and a deep connection to club culture.Rather than relying on past success, Tiga continues to push forward — chasing the same creative spark that first drew him to music, and inspiring new generations on dancefloors worldwide.

DJ Shocca, born Matteo Bernacchi in 1979, is one of the true veterans of Italian hip-hop. Since the release of his landmark debut album 60 HZ in 2004, he has become a defining figure in the scene, collaborating with major Italian rap artists including Guè, Emis Killa, Jake La Furia, Ghemon, Inoki, and many more. Known for his signature drums, refined production style, and powerful stage presence, DJ Shocca helped raise the standard of Italian hip-hop production to an international level. His influence reached beyond Italy, with Boston rap group Special Teamz selecting one of his beats for their album alongside legends like Pete Rock and DJ Premier. In 2023, he returned with Sacrosanto, followed by 60 HZ II in 2025 — a modern continuation of the classic album that cemented his legacy. After a successful sold-out tour, DJ Shocca continues bringing pure hip-hop energy to stages with the 60 HZ II Club Tour 2026.

The Joker himself hosts a late-night circus cabaret where anything can happen. Magician, fakir, sword swallower, hair hanger and ghost of the venue, he guides audiences through a series of explosive circus acts: acrobatics, comedy, sexy juggling, fake magic, real magic, flying bicycles, punk clowns, muscular aerialists and hairy men with big pink balls. High-energy, surprising, grotesque and wildly entertaining — with a different line-up every night.

Jazzbois is a jazz-hiphop fusion trio from Budapest, Hungary. Their studio albums and live shows are all equally heavily rooted in improvisation and momentary self expression, each performance is absolutely unique and daring. The debut album "Jazzbois Goes Blunt" had a strong impact on both the jazz and hip-hop scene and had countless air plays on stations like Soulection Radio, KCRW, BBC 2, BBC 6, Worldwide FM… Their latest album 'Still Blunted' came after performing at the legendary Montreux Jazz Festival last summer. The trio then sold out venues around Europe (including the Jazz Cafe London) on their last headline tour in the autumn of 2024. Their 2025 agenda included festivals like the Montreal Jazz Festival and Cross the Tracks Festival in London. Their 2025 EU tour, named “Tour of Hope” has had them headlining London’s cultic venue, The Village Underground amongst shows in FR, BE, NL, DE, PL, ES, AT, RO, RS, HU…

description: WhoMadeWho, the Danish trio of Tomas Høffding, Tomas Barfod, and Jeppe Kjellberg, blend rock, jazz, and electronic music into a distinctive, emotionally charged sound. With eight albums, singles, and remixes for Kompakt, Innervisions, and Life & Death, they’ve forged a unique creative identity. 2024 saw Kiss & Forget, Beatport’s DJ Award, and headline shows in Copenhagen, Berlin, and Paris, cementing their global electronic music influence.

Me Siento Extraña (MSE) is a Barcelona-based collective creating safer spaces for FLINTA* identities through music, art, and community. Founded in 2021 by Maia Jenkinson (ES) and Verushka Sirit (VE), it emerged as a response to the lack of visibility and cultural spaces. With a sharp curatorial vision, MSE blends underground club nights with cultural gatherings that amplify dissident voices. Beyond its impact on Barcelona’s club scene, the collective collaborates with festivals and cultural spaces while hosting weekly gatherings, creating an irreplaceable space for the community.

Versatility barely describes Japanese DJ ¥ØU$UK€ ¥UK1MAT$U, your favourite DJ’s favourite DJ. Raised in Osaka, he refined his craft while working construction. A 2014 invite to DJ Nobu’s Future Terror changed everything. In 2016 he launched Zone Unknown and, after a brain cancer diagnosis and surgery, went full-time. Tokyo-based since 2020, his CDJ mastery fuses any genre seamlessly, earning global acclaim, Berghain sets, the Midnight is Comin’ compilation, and viral Hör Berlin and Boiler Room performances.

Charlie Sparks az „ENERGY SELECTA”. Intenzív, magával ragadó hangzásáról ismert, amelyben az acid, az industrial, a rave és a psytrance elemeit ötvözi. Ezek tudatos használatával képes megteremteni azt a könyörtelen lendületet, ami mind a zenéiben, mind a fellépéseiben jelen van. Egyedi, „veszélyes” zenei identitása gyorsan elterjedt világszerte. Mindez az építészeti tanulmányai alatt kezdődött, amikor elmerült a sötét, kemény techno világában, és felismerte a két alkotói terület közötti erős kapcsolatot. Akárcsak az építészetben, zenéjének minden eleme tudatosan van felépítve, hogy meghatározott érzelmeket keltsen és irányítsa a hangulatot, teljesen magával ragadva a hallgatót. Ennek eredményeként Charlie kialakította energikus, ritmikusan lüktető védjegyhangzását, amely világszerte felpezsdíti a tánctereket.

TOMORA, the new duo featuring The Chemical Brothers’ Tom Rowlands and AURORA, have released their debut single “RING THE ALARM,” out now via Capitol Records. It arrives alongside a BBC Radio 1 premiere with Jack Saunders and an official music video directed by Adam Smith, a visual that compliments the track’s fun and chaotic nature. Until now, TOMORA’s identity was unknown, with their presence on next year’s festival lineups for Coachella, NOS Alive, Colours of Ostrava, Øya and Down The Rabbit Hole sparking online speculation on Reddit, Discord, and more as to who the mysterious act may be. But today, all is revealed. TOMORA is two entities - TOM and ORA - as one. And by way of an introduction to their world, they have unleashed “RING THE ALARM” ; a glorious, mechanized sound of alien contact, alive with chaos, mischief and release. It's a record that slips across eras, and a sharp reminder of what 33 revolutions per minute can do. Of the single, the duo say: “We wanted TOMORA to be a band, not two individuals. It’s our musical feeling come to life.” TOMORA is the result of two unique and pioneering artists’ worlds colliding, inevitably. As one half of The Chemical Brothers, Tom Rowlands has defined the sound of British electronic music, and AURORA has established herself one of pop music’s most distinctive voices. Their orbits began to converge, and before long AURORA featured on The Chemical Brothers’ GRAMMY® Award-winning 2019 album No Geography - a favor returned when Tom produced some of her acclaimed 2024 album What Happened To The Heart?. The natural chemistry between the two artists, and alchemy that came from their collaboration, has led us to this point: “RING THE ALARM.”

Argy stands as a singular force in modern electronic music, where sound, image, and identity merge into one iconic vision. Born in Rhodes and trained in London, he first shaped minimal techno with 2005’s Love Dose, later redefining his path through Ketuvim and the viral Tataki. His cinematic New World universe and NEWORLD II expanded his reach beyond genre, amassing hundreds of millions of streams and Gold records. Today, NEWORLD lives on as a global audiovisual concept, cementing Argy’s status as a truly boundary-breaking artist.

HAAi is known for her dynamic, tempo-shifting DJ sets. In 2024 HAAi played over 100 shows across five continents, 30 countries, and 91 cities. She took to the biggest stages at festivals, such as Glastonbury, Sonar, and EDC Las Vegas, while also delivering sets at local parties including Japan’s Rainbow Disco Club, Berlin’s RSO and Paris’ Iconic Rex Club, where she performed a year-long residency. In-between, HAAi was playing b2b’s with friends like KI/KI, JenniferCardini, The Blessed Madonna and Solomun.2024 also saw the launch of UNiSON, her community focused party brand that featured surprise back-to-back sets with Boys Noize, DJ Boring and Romy, alongside a room programmed with emerging artists discovered via HAAi’s Submit to Play platform. UNiSON has become a platform for HAAi to uplift rising talent while creating an inclusive and boundary-pushing space for club culture.From her beginnings as a singer-songwriter in Western Australia to her rise as a globally renowned producer, songwriter and DJ, HAAi continues to push boundaries and redefine the possibilities of electronic music.
Budapest based DJ passionate about hard techno and industrial sounds. I create intense, driving atmospheres on the dancefloor and also organize events for the underground community.

Are you washed from last night? Or are you looking for a place with good vibes? Játszóház Projekt is here for you, with tuff new-wave board games and with slayy game masters. Just chill and dive into collecting shiny crystals, building churches or terraforming Mars. Let it be either a Dixit party or a brain-twisting board game, you don’t even have to read the rules, as we are gonna explain them to you.

Stone Sober is a Hungarian psychedelic garage rock drum and guitar duo founded in 2021. The duo's unique sound is reflected in their raw and straight to the point approach, riff-driven heavy grooves, freaky vocal sounds both male and female, and occasionally unusual time signatures. Their flared trousers and extraordinary outfits really reflect the 70’s vibe and atmosphere. With three LPs already released the duo still writes their music with boundless pursuit and creativity. And this drive is well awarded in the past years with opportunities such as being the support band for Australia’s Wolfmother, Canada’s Mother Mother, and the Brant Bjork Trio from the USA. Stone Sober got also invitations for the major Hungarian festivals, like Sziget or Campus. The duo regularly performs not only in Hungary but also in the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, and the Czech Republic. Recognized for their export potential, they were selected to perform at Waves Vienna Showcase Festival in 2025.

Kapela is a professional house dancer, DJ, and true pioneer of the culture. He brings his unique concept, Break Down the House, to Sziget, combining competition, music, and authentic house dance energy. Beyond the battle, he will also lead a house workshop and perform B2B at the House Daytime Party.

Figuring Age is a transgenerational, immersive and haunting performance-installation set at the liminal space between film, dance and theater. In a fictional ghost séance visitors encounter three elderly dancers: Éva, Irén and Ágnes –aged between 90 and 101– were once part of the development of modern dance in Hungary in the 1930s. Based on recordings of the dancers filmed in their private homes, the artist duo has sculpted a meticulous choreography of embodiment that lets their protagonists return on stage through Börcsök’s body and voice. The artists explore how resilience, silence and trauma are inscribed in the body and in the movement.

Little Pieces of Marmalade is a rock duo blending noise-pop and psychedelic-stoner, active since 2014. The lineup consists of DD (vocals and drums) and Frankie (guitar and wah): Daniele Ciuffreda and Francesco Antinori, respectively.After winning the Homeless Rock Fest, they released their first EP. In 2018, they worked in studio with Giacomo Fiorenza to record their debut album titled L.P.O.M., released after their participation in X Factor 2020, where they placed second, and distributed by Sony.In 2022, they released Ologenesi, produced by Manuel Agnelli for Vertigo, this is their first album in Italian.In 2025, Little Pieces of Marmalade released two self-produced albums for Astral Music: Mexican Sugar Dance (in English) and 404DEI (Errore degli Dei) (in Italian).Live they perform as a duo, pushing the impact to the maximum: a compact, dynamic and high- intensity performance, which exaggerates the sounds of the album and transforms them into a physical and memorable set.

NEON BEIGE is a choreographic stagework by choreographer Alen Nsambu and the working group, which braids memories, dreams, and desires into a solo that reimagines visibility, identity, and representation. By exploring the notion of simultaneously being hypervisible and invisible within the societal structures, the work flows through states of transformation – unfolding into something that disrupts, reimagines, and creates space for the yet unknown. ARTIST BIO Alen Nsambu (b. 1998) is a Helsinki-based choreographer and performer who graduated with a BFA in dance and choreography from Den Danske Scenekunstskolen in Copenhagen in 2022. He has worked internationally with artists such as Sonya Lindfors, Marie Topp, WAUHAUS and Alma Söderberg, and has performed in productions of the Finnish National Theatre, Helsinki City Theatre and Turku City Theatre. Nsambu’s artistic practice centers on identity, optics, and the ways different bodies are granted varying degrees of visibility, opacity, and transparency in society. He works with aesthetics of concealment and revelation, creating performative worlds where marginalized bodies can transform and push against dominant norms and narratives. His work moves between choreography and performance, making space for multiple performative registers. His works have been presented at Zodiak – Center for New Dance, Amos Rex Art Museum, The Watermill Center, the Finnish National Theatre, the Finnish Museum of Photography, Dansehallerne, Konträr and INKONST, among others. He was selected as a GENERATION2023 artist for the triennial exhibitions at Amos Rex art museum as well as a danceWEB scholarship recipient for ImPulsTanz 2025. Alen Nsambu is one the of Aerowaves Twenty25 artists with his debut solo “NEON BEIGE” Performer, choreographer: Alen Nsambu Dramaturge: Susi Siriya Orenius Costume design: Angel Emmanuel Sound design: Nori Kin Lighting design: Titus Torniainen Spatial design: Aino Kontinen & Titus Torniainen Participating in the process: Ritni Ráste Pieski Production: Zodiak – Center for New Dance, Alen Nsambu, Ehkä-tuotanto Residency: Ehkä-tuotanto

The Milanese band, with its joyful and engaging gypsy jazz, creates a contrast between the desire to escape everyday life and the harsh realities faced while pursuing their musical dream. Their song “CARAVAN,” featured on X Factor Mixtape 2024, is a cry for freedom—an invitation to take control of one’s life without fear of living on the margins, if necessary.The caravan represents a refuge, a symbol of resistance to dominant culture, but also a vehicle of hope and dreams that refuse to be denied. Through their music and message, I Patagarri seem to demonstrate that true wealth is not economic, but rather the wealth of passion, creativity, and the desire to live without compromise.

artist: Emese Pongrácz, Dominik Gazdag: Minorities within the LGBTQ minority
description: Our workshop is led by Emese Pongrácz, psychologist and PhD student at the ELTE Doctoral School of Psychology, and Dominik Gazdag, psychology student. In both our work and interests, intersectionality and the diverse experiences within LGBTQ+ communities play a central role. Through interactive activities and collective reflection, our workshop explores how factors such as social class, ethnicity, religion, gender identity, or disability can shape the everyday experiences of queer people in very different ways.

Originally hailing from Ashbourne, Derbyshire, Paris Paloma channels the experience of womanhood into her songwriting, speaking to the female experience, grief, love, death, and power. Her songwriting reads like poetry, drawing inspiration from figures throughout mythology, art history and the Romantics. Ranging from the tender and heartbreaking to the sublimely aggressive and vengeful. Her ethereal sound takes influences from dark pop, folk, and indie genres; creating a magical discography that evokes something primal and innately feminine.

Secret Factory BiographyWith a career spanning nearly three decades, Secret Factory stand among the mostambitious and deeply rooted acts in Hungarian electronic music. Their uncompromisingvision, experimental sound, and constant drive for innovationhave made them one of thescene’s most compelling and distinctive productions.This eclectic approach is what allows Secret Factory to connect with a wide spectrum of thetechno subculture. It has also made them a natural fit both as warm-up artists for majorinternational names and as the ones to deliver a powerful closing statement at the end of anight. As a result, they have become a staple of Hungary’s biggest clubs and festivals, withregular appearances at events such as Sziget Festival, B my Lake, and Balaton Sound.The collaboration between Andris and Balázs extends far beyond performing. Together theyalso created Secret Fusion, their own club night, which for 25 years has been an integral partof Hungary’s club culture, consistently reflecting thespirit of the times while introducingsomething fresh to audiences.After many years of groundwork, Secret Fusion Records was launched in 2019 and hassince grown into one of the scene’s respected labels. Alongside their own imprint, they havealso released successfully on renowned labels including Diynamic, Multinotes, Buttress,MoBlack, and Metrica Records.The past few years have been especially remarkable in terms of releases, with SecretFactory appearing on acclaimed labels such as Frau Blau, FeinesTier, Isolate, and thelegendary Crosstown Rebels / Rebellion led by Damian Lazarus.

Lil 404 is one of the freshest — and arguably loudest — new voices in Hungarian hip-hop. In 2025, he quickly established himself on the local music scene by winning major talent competitions including Jägermeister Hangadó and Fülesbagoly Beat, while also being selected for Kikeltető and the Hangfoglaló support program. He has already performed at leading Hungarian festivals such as Fishing on Orfű and Strand Festival, as well as iconic venues including Akvárium, Turbina, Kobuci, and Dürer Kert. Live, Lil 404 delivers a raw, intense, and entertaining atmosphere. His lyrics are sharp, humorous, and honest, balancing vulnerability with high energy that keeps audiences locked in from start to finish. In December 2025, he joined the bergtalents roster.

What is happening to gender in a world where traditional gender roles are shifting even within the most mainstream and conservative cultures? As fashion, media, and everyday life become increasingly open toward self-expression, identities such as agender, genderfluid, and non-binary are no longer unfamiliar concepts. For younger generations, gender often carries fewer restrictions and entirely different meanings than it did before. But what future awaits gender, and how will we define ourselves in an increasingly fluid world?

Oskar Haag is one of Austria’s most compelling new indie-pop artist. At just 20 years old, he has already played some of Europe’s most renowned showcase festivals — including Eurosonic Noorderslag, The Great Escape, and Waves Vienna — and opened for international acts like Birdy and AVEC. With his haunting voice, poetic songwriting, and emotionally disarming stage presence, Haag crafts deeply intimate performances that resonate across generations. No wonder Chris Martin is a big fan…

Few contemporary bands reinvent themselves as consistently as Black Country, New Road. From their Mercury Prize-nominated debut For the First Time to the chart-topping Ants From Up There, the band has continuously explored new musical territory. After vocalist Isaac Wood departed, they returned with a new set of songs captured on Live at Bush Hall. On their third studio album, the band once again rebuilds its sound, with vocal and songwriting duties shared by Tyler Hyde, Georgia Ellery and May Kershaw. Blending folk, prog, baroque pop and alt-rock influences, the record marks another bold transformation while retaining the distinctive sound that has made BC,NR one of the most unique bands of their generation.

A voyage through uplifting melodies and hypnotic grooves, Julya's music tells what words cannot... Emerging from the pulse of Brooklyn’s underground, Julya Karma has quickly established herself as a force that refuses to be defined. Known for her dynamic selections and infectious energy behind the decks, she has been invited to dancefloors worldwide, including Coachella, Cercle, Lost Village, Innervisions, The Brooklyn Mirage, DGTL, Time Warp, Audio Obscura, Afterlife, and Mayan Warrior, appearing alongside legends like Adriatique, Laurent Garnier, Dixon, Ame, Rüfüs du Sol, and Sven Väth.Julya's influences stem from learning classical piano at the age of 6, and from her early exposure to indie and psychedelic rock, jazz, and traditional Middle Eastern music. These diverse influences combined with her music curating obsession translate into her captivating DJ sets. Inspired by music’s ability to transport us beyond the ordinary, Julya creates experiences that awaken something primal, connecting us to the beautiful complexity of existence.

Max Baby is a self-taught multi-instrumentalist and producer who creates instinct-driven, genre-blurring music. Raised near Bourges, he began making music at a young age, learning through experimentation rather than formal training. Experiencing synesthesia, he perceives sound as colour and texture, shaping immersive, atmospheric compositions.His debut EP OUT OF CONTROL, INTO THE WALL introduced a raw, instrument-focused sound, while BREAK expanded into a darker blend of indie, alternative rock, and electronics. Alongside collaborations with artists like Weyes Blood and Sega Bodega, his co-production of “melodrama” by Disiz and Theodora reached No.1 in France. Max Baby’s music is unpolished, emotional, and uniquely his own.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Named after a character by Leo Tolstoy, the Budapest-based band was formed in 2016. In Hungary, they have played sold-out shows at venues such as Akvárium, Müpa and A38, while internationally they have performed at festivals including Roadburn, Reeperbahn, Eurosonic and Liverpool Sound City. Their debut album, For Her (2017), placed the band on the international map, and their songs have since been streamed millions of times worldwide. With their second album, Atoms (2020), they moved away from their earlier acoustic sound toward a louder, more expansive sonic direction. The record explores the search for one’s innermost self and the questioning of everything—at times falling inward, at times drifting away from who we are. This spiral continued with their 2022 album Partért kiáltó (“Calling for the Shore”), which observes humanity through the eyes of water, mountains and forests, wandering further around the core of existence. In 2022, Partért kiáltó was named critics’ favorite album of the year according to Artisjus, received a Fonogram Award, and was listed among the 100 most important Hungarian albums of all time in a large-scale survey conducted by Telex. The band’s Hungarian lyrics have even become literature exam topics in several high schools. Their latest full-length album, Napkötöző, was released in May 2025 and was once again ranked as the most important album in Hungary by critics that year.

Pace out is an investigation on what will happen if we reach out, and get past, the limit of the human possibilities over productivity. When our days tend to look like a list of unnecessary and time consuming duties, it is difficult not to get lost. In between technology and humanity, our urge to do more with less, as a predictable and dictating voice, create in this piece an unsteady, over stimulating and productivity oriented world, where time controls action.

With a unique sound drawing inspiration from the 70’s and from todays’ alternative scenes, the Hungarian band Waiting Room captures a sound that is classic but also modern. They can be full of energy with distorted riffs, and also lean into more melancholic, emotional melodies. Loud, exciting, and unmistakably unique, Waiting Room delivers music that hits hard while staying deeply expressive.

Faux Subject explores the human experience at the intersection of body, consciousness, and intelligence. The solo follows the abstract evolution of a humanoid figure: from an undefined physical mass to a sensing, autonomous body, and finally towards a form expressing identity and self-awareness. Through distorted movement, transformation, and lip sync, the figure evolves in a state that remains unnerving and never fully natural. Balancing body horror, absurdity, and humor, the work examines how identity is shaped through the body, sensation, and performativity.

Loyle Carner’s fourth album, hopefully !, marks a bold evolution shaped by fatherhood, artistic growth, and collaboration with a live band. Following a breakthrough in spring 2024, he embraced singing alongside rap, creating emotionally honest, genre-fluid songs. Influenced by his family and collaborators—including Benjamin Zephaniah—the record blends intimacy, optimism, and experimentation, showcasing Carner fully as a singer, rapper, poet, and writer.

Don't Forget to Breathe! is a contemporary circus performance that explores the relationship between breathing, awareness, and connection. The piece evolves in, on and around a geodesic dome and serves as a gentle reminder: pause for a moment, turn your attention inward, give yourself time—but also look around and try to connect with the people surrounding you. The acrobatic spectacle is a celebration of the air that moves through all of us, reminding us that, no matter what happens, in the end, we all share the same breath. Concept, performers: Sophie Zoletnik Mentor: Darragh McLoughlin Outside eye: Gábor Goda Choreographic advisor: Jenna Jalonen

Unpredictable, loud and heartbreakingly beautiful instrumental music from Eastern Europe that takes you places. “JAZZ FOR METALHEADS” - this is how they describe their own music, which they perform on stage with elemental energy, traversing the most extreme moods from aggressive heaviness to sentimental ballads and epic openings. After their formation in 2014, they quickly achieved domestic and international success: they played on European stages, won A38’s talent contest, the Talentométer, toured Central Europe, and performed as support for international acts such as Shigeto, La Dispute, and Elektro Guzzi. After a sudden breakup and a six-year hiatus, the band returned in 2023 with sold-out concerts in Budapest - including a show at the House of Hungarian Music. In 2024 they began performing again in Hungary, and in 2025 they relaunched their international concert series at the Eurosonic NL and Ment Ljubljana festivals, then completed their first LP, makrohang, in March.

Natascha Polké is a Swiss musician and producer known for blending indie songwriting with emotional, melodic house. Based in Zurich, she has built an international presence with releases on labels like Anjunadeep, PIAS, and Universal Music. Her live shows have taken her across Europe, North America, and Asia — from supporting Kiasmos and Christian Löffler on tour to playing festivals like Fusion, Zürich Openair, ADE, and a standout Cercle show in LA. 2025 will ultimately see Natascha embarking on her very first headline tour across European metropolitan cities. She lived in London from 2013 to 2017, where she studied songwriting, worked in a studio, and held a residency at the iconic Roundhouse. After returning to Zurich, she immersed herself in the city’s club scene — organizing events at Hive and DJing extensively. During this phase, her current artist project began to take shape. After completing her Master’s in music, she transitioned from DJing to performing fully live — and the project really took off. Her live show merges raw, intimate songwriting with atmospheric, melodic house.Her upcoming EP - aimed to be released in November - with the first single 'Ghost' releasing June 20 via Universal Music CH and capping the year off in December with a release for Cercle Records, will certainly open a new chapter. With her mix of emotion and groove, she gets people dancing — and maybe even crying a little.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Kolibri is the stage name of András Bognár, a rising force in the Hungarian pop and festival scene. Blending alternative/indie with electronic textures, his introspective Hungarian-language songs create intimate, melancholic worlds. His 2023 debut Nagyon Jó, Nagyon Rossz, Nagyon Jó earned critical acclaim and sold-out shows, followed by collaborations with Hundred Sinsel, the Wavy collective, and the 2024 Ballagás EP. Now a three-piece band, Kolibri released their second album Rúnák in 2025, supported by a nationwide headline tour. Members: Bandi Bognár – vocals, guitar, trumpet; Geri Háló – synth, guitar, bass; Máté Halász – drums.

Washington DC’s Teen Mortgage climbed from the city’s primordial punk soup in 2017 after guitarist/vocalist James Guile relocated to the nation's capital from Liverpool, UK and by a stroke of luck was quickly able to find hard hitting drummer Ed Barkauskas via a desperate craigslist post. As a two piece they stood out - crossbreeding east coast hardcore aggression and garage/surf sleaze with a focus on pop sensibility. This sonic blend perfectly set the scene for vocalist and guitarist James Guile to illustrate what he describes as “the absurdity of living in the era of late stage capitalism and tech feudalism”. He adds, “it’s even woven into our name, like Mortgage in latin means ‘death pledge’”Teen Mortgage’s acerbic intensity was noticed by Brooklyn, NY label King Pizza Records, who released the duo’s 2019 EP Life/Death and 2021’s Smoked. Songs from the EPs earned Teen Mortgage placements with Shameless, Vans Park Series, and Evil Bikes and support slots with notable bands like The Chats, Mike Krol, Bass Drum Of Death, Jeff The Brotherhood, etc. Known for their rowdy live shows, Teen Mortgage detonates a sonic bomb that leaves no room for apathy, let alone time to breathe. Guile's caustic riffs and sneer paired with Barakauskas's brawn have fostered a new established meeting ground for those looking for a place to mosh. Their DIY headline national tours have seen crowd members become rabid as soon as the pair kick in the first riff of the set, like a pack of coyotes chasing down their prey. The group's infectious fuzz bonded with Jello Biafra and George Carlin inspired lyrics ignite audiences into a primal frenzy, sweating out the drudgery of living through, once again in Guile's words, "the era of late stage capitalism and tech feudalism".“These guys have got it going on” - Iggy Pop, BBC6’s The Confidential Show

Bashar Murad is a Palestinian Pop artist, singer/songwriter, and filmmaker producing globally influenced pop music rooted in Palestinian spirit. His musical sounds span pop, electronica and modal inflections rooted in his expansive and creative sonic world, accompanied by powerful visuals that reflect his infectious drive for freeing oneself and society from all forms of oppression, drawing on his environment in Jerusalem, and travel meanderings through his artistic practice.Bashar Murad, Renaud Satre

artist: Rebecka Vilhonen, Dan Zerin, Pablo Lechuga, Nadine Froughi
description: Come and experience the funniest comedians in Europe at Sziget Festival!  Comedians Rebecka Vilhonen (FIN), Dan Zerin (US), Pablo Lechuga (ESP) and Nadine Froughi (US/IR/NL) will entertain you for an hour filled with energy, laughs and a good time.

TrueSchool’s 60-minute Open Jam workshop welcomes everyone with a live DJ set featuring Hip Hop, House and Funk music. The main focus is sharing the community power of street and club dance styles – no matter your age or experience, anyone can join in. Through guided and improvisational exercises, participants will explore playful dance tools and social movement concepts they can freely use later during the festival parties. The goal is simple: connection, self-expression and having fun.Teachers : Péter Katona “Soldier P” Róbert Fazekas “Pizsy” DJ: Noren

The band Jules War grew out of singer-songwriter Eszter Lovasi’s unique musical project. The band’s signature enchanting dream pop and introspective lyrics came together on their full-length album, The Greatest Climber on Earth, released in late 2024. The band’s name is derived from the singer’s nickname, Juliska, while War refers to the inner struggles one's have. This theme even runs through the band’s last two releases (Berlin; Not for the Thrill). Alongside the singer, the band features Domonkos Szilágyi on drums, Balázs Bajnok on guitar, and Márton Lévai on keyboards. Despite its short history, the recently formed Jules War has already garnered numerous accolades: they performed at one of Europe’s largest showcase festivals, ESNS, and have also played at Poland’s Next Fest and BuSH. Soon, their guaranteed-to-give-you-goosebumps songs will be heard at Waves Vienna. In addition to Budapest Park, the general public can catch them at the country’s most significant festivals and at Germany’s Superbloom.

Azerbaijan born Netherlands based Alizade is one of the most distinctive voices to emerge from Turkey’s new wave of rap artists. She transforms her personal stories into anthems of self-expression and rebellion through blending sharp lyricism with bold visuals. Since her breakout with viral tracks like strong following for her unapologetic attitude and visual storytelling that pushes boundaries. Alizade represents a new generation redefining femininity, fame, and freedom in contemporary Turkish music scene. Each performance, video, and collaboration expands her ever-evolving narrative, creating a daring world. Alizade embraces womanhood in her own unique way, expressing strength, confidence, and individuality through her music. Drawing inspiration from her personal experiences, she encourages women to be Uapologetically themselves and to stand proudly in their power.

Global superstar Lewis Capaldi returns with ‘Almost’ - a soaring, full-band anthem marking his third new single since his comeback. The track arrives ahead of his newly announced EP Survive - out November 14th. Arriving hot on the heels of a critically-lauded return to touring after almost 2 years away, and latest success ‘Something In The Heavens’, his tenth UK Top 10 single, ‘Almost’ is a raw and intimate exploration of what it means to move on - or at least try to. Honest and understated, the song captures the struggle to let go. “I swear to God I’m almost alright, I only think about you all the time,” Lewis admits, showcasing yet again his extraordinary gift for finding truth and emotion in the most nuanced of details.

Olympe is an Italian-born DJ and producer whose hypnotic sets fuse deep melodies with driving energy across Dance, Garage, Tech-House, Techno, and House. A classically trained pianist, she has earned residencies in Milan and performed at top international clubs. With releases on labels like Just This and Tomorrowland Music, her 2024 EP The Voice of the Night and 2025 single I Can Never Stop showcase her evolving sound, cementing her as one of electronic music’s most exciting rising talents.

fcukers’ explosive ascendance began downtown in New York City, and in just three years the band amassed millions of streams while performing at major festivals including Glastonbury, Primavera, Lollapalooza and Coachella, as well as arena shows supporting LCD Soundsystem and Tame Impala. Formed by Shanny Wise and Jackson Walker Lewis, the project blends a wide range of influences, collaging dub, UK garage, trip hop and 2000s hip hop with modern electronic sounds. Their debut album “Ö” plays like a DJ set, taking the listener on a wild metaphorical night out while capturing the party-like intensity and hypnotic energy that define the band’s electrifying live shows.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: With his relentless honesty and visceral on-stage genius, Co Lee has, over the past few years, become one of the most essential and influential figures of the Hungarian music scene. Each concert translates his exceptionally diverse discography into a unique live experience defined by unparalleled musicality. His innovative linguistic, musical, and production choices—for instance, presenting his latest album, Gadara,  while standing atop a mountain built inside Müpa’s Grand Hall—continually expand the horizons of Hungarian performing arts. His band, composed of some of the most outstanding figures in Hungarian music—Ádi Klausz, András Kálmán, Dani Varga, Matyi Doór, Aminon, and Indigo—grew even further in the summer of 2025. On the Sziget Festival’s Revolut stage, their Big Band formation introduced an ethereal sound featuring a London-based vocal trio and Austrian Hammond organ phenomenon Raphael Wressnig. As one of the highest-quality live acts in the country, the Co Lee Live Band has repeatedly provento attract and captivate audiences at Hungary’s most prestigious festivals and largest stages. In 2023, Co Lee’s first Hungarian-language album, Cirque de L'Homme, featuring Beton.Hofi, Kolibri, and gyuris, became an instant gold record upon release. This was followed in spring 2024 by PROGRAM, co-written with Matyi Doór. His third Hungarian-language LP, La Promenade—created in collaboration with Blaize—was released in September 2024 to widespread critical acclaim, quickly achieving gold record status as well. The album and its unique concert-show debuted with a sold-out double album release at Akvárium’s main hall.In 2025, La Promenade won the Fonogram – Hungarian Music Award for Best Domestic Rap/Hip-Hop Album or Recording of the Year, and also received the WMMD Digital Music Award for “Release Strategy Best Practice.” He is currently working on the Hungarian-language continuation of his English lo-fi hip-hop album Air, expected to be released in spring 2026.

bongor has been active in the experimental rap scene since 2017. His lyrics are often socially critical and frequently reflect on deeper existential questions as well as mental health.Thanks to their striking, cinematic visual style, his music videos have won awards at the Hungarian Music Video Awards three times. Over the years, he has become a defining figure of the Hungarian festival and club scene. His concerts combine rap, DJ performance and trombone, recently expanded with live drums, while his theatrical stage persona and unique ideas make every show a distinctive experience.For the past two years, he has also served as the host and presenter of the Budapest Open Mic, a rap/hip-hop talent competition. His album EXTÁZIS, released at the end of 2025, explores important social themes and brought him a true breakthrough, reaching a wider audience. The record has been widely praised by critics and media, often cited as one of the best albums of the year. Within its first month of release, the album surpassed 15 million streams across digital platforms. He celebrated the release with two sold-out album launch concerts at Dürer Kert, and this year he is preparing for his first headline show at Budapest Park.

ENTIAL is an intriguing DJ and producer from Budapest. He entered the world of drum and bass around 2004, gravitating toward the futuristic and forward-thinking side of the genre from the very beginning.He joined Cybershot in 2007 and remained on the podium of broken beats until 2019, performing over 200 DJ gigs across five different countries.After that, he began developing his own sound, which led to his first official releases on Surveillance Music, Genome Records, and Wonk#ay Records. These tracks received support from artists such as Tom Finster, The Upbeats, Billain, Nickbee, Was A Be, Synth Ethics, Yoshuu, Redpill, Evol Intent, DJ Aphrodite, Noisia, and more, and were also featured on the legendary VISION Radio.ENTIAL is a recurring presence at The Hive Budapest events, where he was also a resident performer during the final years of Cybershot. His live performances are defined by conscious, high-energy mixing, with a sound inspired by experimental and tech-driven influences.

LEAP is a whirlwind of rock and roll extremes, blending heavy riffs, beats, electronica, and anthemic pop with Jacky’s distinctive vocals, exploring London’s underbelly and personal struggles with mental health. Over the past two years, the band sold 50,000+ tickets across the UK and Europe, with debut USA headline dates set for March 2026. Backed by strong editorial support and a passionate international fanbase, LEAP is building toward their debut album Entropy, releasing October 3rd.

To be honest we didn’t want to do a play, we just wanted to dance around and go crazy. We could have made other decisions, been different people and worked in something else, but we liked it too much. So much that we crossed the threshold of knowing if we’ve wasted our time or if what we are doing is actually worth something... Hearts, desires, rubber bands, pain, smoke, techno, gunshots, nightlife and malice. PERDÓN (sorry) is a declaration of love and hate for dance. A play that explores the boundaries: of artistic creation; of dancing; of the actor’s freedom on stage and their relationship with the audience; of discomfort and also of elastic bands.Boundaries as an artistic manifesto or as a privileged space for wonder and provocation, where what is beautiful can become grotesque or a demonstration of vulnerability. Without victimhood or moralism, without opinions on what is good, bad, beautiful or boring, we lay our heart on the table and say: This is who we are: this is proof that you can dance with an ‘s’, with humour and spelling mistakes. (And if this is another synopsis that makes no sense to you, we are sorry).

ANNA (Ana Miranda) is a Brazilian DJ and producer who has undergone a profound spiritual transformation in recent years. Alongside her music career, she has embraced sound healing and collective experiences, exploring the power of frequency and shared energy. After more than a decade of performing at top clubs and festivals worldwide and achieving major success as a producer, she now follows a more conscious creative path. Today, her work goes beyond entertainment, using music as a tool for healing, connection, and serving a higher purpose.

Dub Personal has been an active force in Budapest’s electronic music scene since 2009, bringing a deep and powerful blend of drum & bass and dubstep to the city’s soundscape.He began his journey as a producer, carefully shaping his own sonic identity, before stepping behind the decks in 2010 and translating that energy into dynamic DJ sets.His productions have been released on a range of respected international and underground labels, including Invisible, Delta9, Silent Motion, and Dubstar, reflecting both his versatility and his commitment to quality bass music.Driven by a passion for dark, immersive rhythms and a strong connection to the dancefloor, Dub Personal continues to push his sound while remaining deeply rooted in the bass-driven culture that defines him.

Florence Welch - also known as Florence + The Machine - has released her sixth studio album Everybody Scream. The album’s title track Everybody Scream was written and produced by Florence Welch over the past two years with a close-knit circle of collaborators including Mark Bowen of IDLES, who appears in the video for the single, Aaron Dessner and Mitski.  After needing lifesaving surgery on the Dance Fever Tour, Florence’s recovery took her down the path of spiritual mysticism, witchcraft and folk horror as she felt the limits of her body and explored what it means to be “healed”. The album treads through womanhood, partnership, aging and dying; exposing the murky in the mundane. Across five albums - 2009’s Lungs, 2011’s Ceremonials, 2015’s How Big, How Blue, How Beautiful, 2018’s High As Hope and 2022’s Dance Fever - Florence has become one of the most monumental artists of a generation, with multiple US and UK #1 albums and countless awards. Known for her earth-shattering live show and singular, iconic voice, Florence has sold out shows and headlined festivals the entire world over. She has collaborated and shared stages with icons - The Rolling Stones, Lady Gaga and Taylor Swift among them - and published a book of lyrics, poetry and drawings, Useless Magic.
