stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Alex and his band, ByeAlex és a Slepp (Márta Alex, Dávid Schnellbach, Balázs Fekete, Zoltán G. Tóth, András Poór), sold out the Budapest Arena in 2024 after already conquering the main stages of most major festivals and filling Budapest Park multiple times. Their latest releases have already reached millions of views: the uniquely atmospheric Csokko, the beautifully melancholic Vajon (Hogy halok meg?), as well as Valamiben and Széltoló, both faithfully reflecting Alex’s artistic credo, instantly found their audience. The band has numerous hits to their name, including Rossz esték with Manuel; songs from the 2020 album Rehab; Így hagysz el, Merülök, and Emlékszem (vagy…); and the still fan-favorite Még mindig, which was released in 2015, the year ByeAlex és a Slepp was formed. At their concerts, they continue to perform ByeAlex classics such as Fekete and Az én rózsám to great acclaim. Remaining true to themselves and enjoying unbroken popularity, the band will hit the road again this spring to perform concerts across the country.

John Coffey, made up of David Achter de Molen, Alfred van Luttikhuizen, Christoffer van Teijlingen, Richard van Luttikhuizen, and Carsten Brunsveld, are a Dutch punk-rock powerhouse known for high-octane energy on stage. After pausing in 2016, they returned in 2023 with new songs, sold-out shows, a comeback album, and their own festival, Coffey Fest. Fierce, urgent, and socially engaged, John Coffey channels chaos, community, and activism both on and off the stage, continually evolving while staying true to their uncompromising DIY spirit.

Andrea Lane is a new-generation DJ and producer coming from Hungary, based in Ibiza. Launching her solo career in 2016, she has steadily building a name in the house music scene. Despite her young age, she has already performed alongside icons such as Fatboy Slim, Claptone, Purple Disco Machine, Hugel, Meduza and more with appearances at major festivals and clubs including SZIGET Festival, Balaton Sound’s main stage, Miami Music Week, ADE, Club Chinois, Lío or Playa Soleil Ibiza. She has worked together with well-known brands such as Maybelline New York, Zenith and others at high-end events as well. As a producer, Andrea blends house and tech house often with Latin and Afro influences as well, creating energetic grooves that stand out on labels like Toolroom Records, Golden Recordings by Claptone, Wh0 Plays, her own imprint and more. Her track ‘Gorongosa’ opened Gorgon City’s set at Ushuaïa Ibiza and has been played by Fedde Le Grand, Claptone, Roger Sanchez and more at venues from Pacha Ibiza to Daytrip LA. Her music has also reached top radio stations with guest mixes and premieres on BBC Radio 1 or KISS FM, in 2025 Andrea Lane was ranked in the official 1001Tracklists Top 100 Most Played House Tracks chart with her release ‘You Can’t Stop’, while her Toolroom release What Goes Around earned strong streaming numbers and plays from Dom Dolla and Mau P. In 2025, she was invited to perform at the Beatport Miller Mix, streamed worldwide on Beatport’s global platforms, marking another step in her fast-rising career.

Raise Spirit was founded by Gergő Varga and Richárd Gödöllei in the spring of 2012. They went to the same school, but only met during a party which was hosted by Gergő. They were both into the same kind of music, so they became friends very quickly. Richárd was more experienced in DJing, while Gergő had 6 years of experience in producing, although in a very different genre. After one year, they decided to team up in April 2012 and started producing and had bookings as Raise Spirit.

Pushing the boundaries of modern music with relentless energy and a distinctive sound, Deki Alem fuses raw intensity with rich, playful soundscapes. Blending drum and bass, dance, trip-hop, and rap into a style uniquely their own, they deliver an experience that is as unpredictable as it is powerful.Their recently released album Forget In Mass has been met with critical acclaim, praised by voices like Anthony Fantano – “they're bringing back, again, a classic sound with a lot of fire and a lot of precision”, and earning recognition from platforms such as BBC Radio 6 and Clash Magazine, the latter awarding the record 9/10. Rooted in Stockholm’s underground scene, Deki Alem has built a dedicated community fueled by raw expression and unfiltered energy. Their guerrilla spirit runs through everything they do, from DIY culture to bold street activations, turning each release into more than just music, but a movement.Following a summer lighting up major festivals like Glastonbury and Electric Castle, and currently on a headline tour with several dates sold out, the twins are set to continuously carry that same unruly force and tight knit connection to stages across Europe.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Majka (Péter Majoros) is a Fonogram Award-winning Hungarian rapper, songwriter, and television host. With his band, he has filled the country’s largest arenas and concert venues on numerous occasions. For many years, he has been a headlining performer at major summer music festivals. According to Forbes’ latest ranking, he is Hungary’s most valuable celebrity. In 2026, Majka returns to Sziget with a spectacular live show!

First time in Hungary? The five young veterans of the Lactation Alt-Comedy Club (Tejfakasztó Klub) – Ádám Fekete, László Göndör, Dávid Hajmási, Péter Hajmási and Kornél Laboda – are proud to invite you to their very special and chaotic Country Branding Variety Show!  In this one-hour late-night demonstration these comedic rascals – known for shocking audiences with their deadpan, edgy, self-critical and taboo-defying cabaret and theatre acts – are about to showcase the many colours of Hungarian jest and cheerfulness, joined by invited star guests, daredevils and hidden treasure of native humorousness.  Expect the unexpected!

Despite his young age, VINI—aka Vincent Németh—has already made his mark on the history of Hungarian hip-hop and rap, and he has no intention of slowing down. After several years of writing music and producing, he turned a new page in 2024, continuing his career with professional management. His album VINNER, which debuted in 2026, was highly anticipated even before its release, and after it came out, the tracks dominated the top spots on the charts for months. The album features collaborations with artists such as KKevin, Burai, Mollywood, Peti Marics, Sofi, and BELANO. Millions of streams and views, a sold-out Akvárium, and performances on stages across the country: the sky’s the limit. VINI is the voice of today’s youth, but his style resonates not only with Gen Z but with everyone who believes in the outspokenness, honesty, and timelessness of hip-hop and rap.

Ghent-based artist Sylvie Kreusch is rapidly rising as one of the most impressive and electrifying performers in Europe. `Her trail-blazing music and visuals already turned many heads in the fields of music, film and fashion. Kreusch is known for her brutal, expressive lyricism and keen ear for both experimental and pop stylistics. During the past decade, Kreusch made her first waves playing in Belgium with art rockers Soldier’s Heart and Warhaus, the solo-project of Balthazar’s Maarten Devoldere. After releasing her debut EP BADA BING! BADA BOOM!, her artistic vision prospered fully in 2021 on her riveting critically acclaimed full-lengthdebut album, Montbray. On her breakthrough album Montbray, Sylvie Kreusch illustrated heartbreak with the suspense and thrill of a spy thriller. To say the Belgian artist has a flair for the dramatics would be a severe understatement. Wherever Sylvie sets foot, superlatives tend to chase her like a trail of fire. During her tenure touring Montbray, she prowled on stage like a crimson-clad international woman of mystery, a being of pure celluloid who somehow found passageway into our tangible world. But once upon a time… there was a girl dreaming in her grandmother’s attic, herstarry eyes fully immersed in a collection of vintage comic books. These bright, fantastical tales were a younger Sylvie’s gateway to a magical place, far from the daily toils of reality. Each turn of the page stirred her with pure wonder, possibility andexcitement. It’s these big bold emotions that serve as the main conductor for Sylvie Kreusch’s adventurous upcoming new album. She abandons her lofty tenure as Belgium’s specter of the night, trading in her raging red locks for a dashing blonde. Finally in the driver’s seat with her lover sitting shotgun, she embarks on a horizon-chasing voyage where all fruits of life are savored and surveyed with wide eyes and luscious lips.

One of the most unique and exciting bass music outfits to emerge in recent times, Koven is the production alias of Writer / Producer Max Rowat and fronted live by Writer / DJ / Vocalist Katie Boyle. Spotted as one of the pioneering artists to back cinematic bass music Koven have been collating millions of online streams as well as a string of high profile music placements in Film / TV / Advertising and Games.

JAMBACK is one of the most exciting names to emerge from the new wave of minimal and tech-house. His breakout track “Positive” made history on Circoloco Records, reaching #1 on Beatport and becoming the longest-running Beatport number one ever, overtaking Fisher’s Losing It and cementing Jamback’s place in modern club culture. Recognised for his impact and momentum, Jamback has been nominated as DJ Mag’s One To Watch for 2026. His rise has been fuelled by standout performances across Ibiza with key platforms including Circoloco at DC10, Solid Grooves, Amnesia, UNVRS, and more, where his sound has consistently resonated with both crowds and tastemakers. On the production front, releases such as “Can’t Resist” on Rossi.’s Homegrown have sent waves through the scene, further elevating his reputation. His music has also earned the respect of artists he admires, most notably Saoirse, who delivered a celebrated remix of “Metronomic”, reinforcing Jamback’s credibility within the underground. Over time, Jamback has built deep-rooted relationships across the minimal tech-house world through consistent DJ support, trusted label partnerships, and a sound that balances groove, tension, and personality. As we step into 2026, these accolades mark a defining chapter: Jamback is expanding into the US market, touring globally, and selling out shows as his profile continues to soar. History made. Momentum locked. Jamback is just getting started. The lid is off.

Formed in Byron Bay, Australia, in 2014, Parcels now split their time between Australia and Berlin. The band—Louie Swain (keys), Patrick Hetherington (keys/guitar), Noah Hill (bass), Anatole “Toto” Serret (drums), and Jules Crommelin (guitar)—has surpassed a billion streams. Their third album, LOVED (2025), featuring tracks like “Yougotmefeeling” and “Sorry,” received critical acclaim, and their globally praised live shows sold out arenas across Europe, North America, and Australia. Parcels continue to expand their unique live sound into 2026.

Bruno X Spacc are one of the most influential and trendsetting duos in the Hungarian rap and trap scene. They broke into the mainstream with their hit “Budán vagy Pesten” and quickly established themselves among the leading names of Hungary’s new generation of hip-hop artists. Their 2022 EP “NEMELVAGYUNK?” further strengthened their position, showcasing a distinctive sound and uncompromising attitude that helped define the direction of modern Hungarian trap. Tracks such as “Vakmeleg” amassed tens of millions of views on YouTube, while “Aha-Aha” surpassed 30 million streams across platforms, highlighting the duo’s exceptional reach and popularity. Collaborations with major artists including KKevin, T. Danny, and ValMar expanded their audience even further, while they consistently maintained their bold, authentic, and unmistakable artistic identity. With hundreds of thousands of monthly Spotify listeners and tens of millions of YouTube views, Bruno X Spacc have become one of the most important organically built acts in Hungarian trap. In 2025, they reached new milestones by performing at Sziget Festival and later headlining Budapest Park, proving that their large-scale live show and crowd-moving energy place them firmly among the country’s top-tier performers.

These are not numbers, but letters. And it’s no longer just an MC, but a full band. 6363 now takes over the stage יחד with his musical accomplices, delivering not only a rhetorical experience but a rich musical one for fans of his underground hits. Driving 4/4 rhythms, ear-soothing melancholic moments, wild jumping, and spoken word all come together in one powerful package.

The Joker himself hosts a late-night circus cabaret where anything can happen. Magician, fakir, sword swallower, hair hanger and ghost of the venue, he guides audiences through a series of explosive circus acts: acrobatics, comedy, sexy juggling, fake magic, real magic, flying bicycles, punk clowns, muscular aerialists and hairy men with big pink balls. High-energy, surprising, grotesque and wildly entertaining — with a different line-up every night.

Joris Voorn is a leading Dutch DJ and producer, known for his genre-blending house and techno, acclaimed albums, and global performances. He runs the Green and Rejected labels and showcases his wide musical spectrum through his Spectrum radio show and events.

K-OSZ DISCO is the high-energy DJ duo of Marci Miskovits and Kristóf Kovács, bringing one of Hungary’s most entertaining touring party shows to audiences across the country. Combining back-to-back DJ sets with constant MCing and dynamic show elements, they deliver unforgettable party experiences. After proving themselves over the past seasons, the duo returns to Sziget Festival this summer for another explosive performance.

Night Tapes’ debut album portals//polarities is a deeply immersive, genre-blurring journey shaped by place and emotion. Created by London trio Iiris Vesik, Max Doohan, and Sam Richards, the album weaves global field recordings—from Estonian swamps to Mexican mountains—into dreamy, electronic soundscapes. Originally recording quietly in a shared house, the group embraced their constraints, crafting music that became time capsules of their surroundings. Their process blends traditional instruments with laptop production, drawing from synth-pop, shoegaze, trip-hop, and ambient music. Songs often shift unpredictably, blurring the line between band and studio project. Much of the album was made on the road, in Airbnbs and hotels between gigs, emphasizing creativity within limitation. Their use of tapes and spontaneous sampling adds raw, human imperfections that digital methods lack. For Vesik, the album explores inner dualities and personal freedom, with emotional depth conveyed more through sound than lyrics. portals//polarities is a bold debut—personal, political, and vibrantly alive. The band’s previous releases have been supported by DIY, Clash, NME, Future Music, Gorilla vs Bear, BBC Radio 1, BBC 6 Music and many more.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: The biggest house party in Hungary! This isn’t heartfelt nostalgia — this is NECC, where true experts of the genre meticulously dig through the musical trash bins of the ’90s, 2000s, and 2010s to create the ultimate guilty-pleasure dancefloor experience. Together, we dance on the edge: classic or tragic, cool or cringe, iconic or embarrassing, absolute banger or ultimate cheese? At NECC, every hit gets its moment.

Rossi. is one of London’s most exciting DJs and producers, making waves on the global tech-house scene with his distinctive sound and high-energy performances. He has played major venues and parties including Hï Ibiza, Space Miami, The Warehouse Project, Circoloco and Music On. Alongside his DJ career, he runs the ROSSI.HOME//GRXWN brand, record label and party series, which has grown into a sold-out movement across the UK, Ibiza and Miami. With standout releases like “High On Me” and a rapidly expanding world tour schedule, Rossi. continues to rise as one of dance music’s most talked-about new names.

Palánta Crew is a Budapest based DJ collective with 4 music enthusiasts coming from the freestyle dance community.András Huszár, Klaudia Csollák, Tünde Stadler, Lilla Vásárhelyi Mirjam Veres, Lilla Pethő, Emese Herczeg, Ilma Luca Perger, Andrea Döme, Ana Bali, Brigitta Szabó

Elipsa is a multi-talented artist working as a singer, songwriter, DJ, MC, and host, known for blending soulful vocals with high-energy drum & bass. Since emerging in 2020, she has collaborated with artists such as Grafix, Kanine, Goddard, Enei, and Mollie Collins, while becoming the first female artist to release an EP on UKF with her debut Divine. Her breakout hit “Shut It Down” with Mollie Collins surpassed 5 million Spotify streams, followed by successful releases like “Night Rides”, “VIP”, and “Overrated”. Known for her infectious stage presence, Elipsa has performed at major festivals and events including ADE, Hospitality on the Beach, Liquicity, and Rhythm & Vines. With millions of streams, award recognition, and a growing international reputation, Elipsa is quickly becoming one of the most exciting rising names in electronic music.

Manchester-based poet, writer, and producer Antony Szmierek today delights fans with the digital deluxe release of his critically acclaimed debut album, Service Station at the End of the Universe. Originally released earlier this year to a wave of five-star reviews, the expanded edition features fan-favourite singles ‘The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Fallacy,’ ‘The Great Pyramid of Stockport,’ ‘Yoga Teacher,’ and ‘Angie’s Wedding,’ alongside two new tracks: ‘That Face You Make When It’s Raining’ and ‘Girlypops.’

Richie Hawtin is a pioneering electronic musician, DJ, and innovator whose work spans music, technology, and contemporary art. Born in the UK and raised in Canada, he co-founded Plus 8 Records, MINUS Records, and Beatport, and is renowned as Plastikman for shaping techno and minimal electronic music since the early 1990s. Known for immersive experiences like ENTER. in Ibiza and collaborations with artists from Anish Kapoor to Raf Simons, Hawtin continually pushes conceptual and technical boundaries while mentoring new talent and exploring crossovers in art, architecture, and performance.

New Zealand-born DJ, producer and MC Fuckoff has come a long way since arriving in Berlin with nothing but a dream and a backpack. From tearing up warehouse raves to turning streams into full-on dance-offs, her relentless positive energy and effortlessly bold style have earned her a loyal following and growing hype.Breaking through during lockdown after a viral HÖR debut, her productions quickly gained attention. With provocative lyrics, high-speed energy and explosive twists, tracks like “B.I.M.B.” and her contribution to “Trick” became DJ favourites, landing on labels such as International Chrome and none / such.Known for her fast-paced, genre-blending sets across the hardcore spectrum, as well as intense live performances, she consistently ignites dancefloors. Rooted in early exposure to electronic music through her upbringing, she combines deep knowledge with a fearless, boundary-pushing approach that challenges genres, norms and expectations.

Being one of the keystones of the Dutch drum & bass scene and the Liquicity Records family, NCT, formed by Jeroen Nai Chung Tong (DJ/Producer) & Alexander Witschge (DJ), have been enriching the scene with quality music and class A DJ-sets for almost 10 years. The Dutch duo is well known for putting a smile on people’s faces on and off the stage. Their DJ sets are highly energetic and carry a strong sense of euphoria and pure joy, and in addition, they aren’t afraid to get a little filthy behind the decks with their great selection and representation of the underground drum & bass sound. The variety of styles in their set is what makes them stand out, their chemistry and energy is what makes them unique. After years of coming up in the drum & bass scene, they reached the point of releasing their debut album on their home record label, Liquicity. With support and credits coming from all over the dnb scene, they also gained traction with listeners from outside of drum & bass. It seems as though they've taken the momentum of their album to cross genres even more than they did before, and they're expected to release several different styles of dance music besides their usual cup of tea in the future.

Grammy nominated DJ, producer & songwriter, DOM DOLLA, is experiencing a meteoric rise, his signature style of house music is connecting with global audiences, and he is recognised as one of the most exciting producers in electronic music. Dom discovered house music when his Mother handed him a copy of Basement Jaxx’ 2001 album ‘Rooty". In his late teen’s Dom spent weekends hosting pub‐discos & djing at parties whilst working as a graphic‐designer during the week. In 2015 Dom was encouraged to quit his day job to pursue his obsession with music and production. Dom emerged with a string of critically acclaimed club hits; Define, You, Be Randy, Take It, San Frandisco, Pump The Breaks, Moving Blind and Strangers ft. Mansionair. In 2022 Dom released ‘Miracle Maker’ ft. Clementine Douglas which was named BBC Radio 1’s Hottest Record In The World, propelling Dom into his global break‐out moment with a run of hit singles, Rhyme Dust w/ MK, Eat Your Man w/ Nelly Furtado, Saving Up, girl$, CAVE w/ Tove Lo, Dreamin ft. Daya, and Forever (with Kid Cudi) which saw Dom’s catalog surpass 1 BILLION streams. In 2025, Dom made his cinematic debut with the single “No Room For A Saint” w/ Nathan Nicholson, released as part of the ‘F1: The Movie’ soundtrack. Dom received a GRAMMY nomination for his remix of ‘New Gold’ by Gorillaz feat. Tame Impala & Bootie Brown, and has won the ARIA award for best ‘Dance / Electronic Release’ three times. His dedication & craft has been recognised by GQ’s ‘Solo Artist of the Year’, labeled Billboard Dance’s ‘One To Watch’, awarded Dancing Astronaut’s ‘Artist Of The Year’’, and was celebrated on the cover of DJ Mag and Rolling Stone Australia.

Pan-Pot, the Berlin techno duo of Tassilo Ippenberger and Thomas Benedix, are known for their dark, minimal, and experimental sound. Since their 2007 debut Pan-O-Rama, they’ve released multiple albums, founded the label Second State, and toured major festivals worldwide. Their 2023 album FORTE and its 2024 remix project showcase their evolving style. Beyond music, they influence fashion and remain leading figures in electronic music.

BOYS NOIZE (Alex Ridha) is a German-Iraqi DJ, producer, and innovator who has pushed techno, house, and electro beyond convention while staying rooted in underground culture. His genre-spanning career includes collaborations with A$AP Rocky, Lady Gaga, Frank Ocean, and Skrillex, film scoring alongside Trent Reznor, and remixes for Daft Punk and Depeche Mode. Known for high-energy 140+ bpm productions and relentless creativity, he continues to shape electronic music globally. In 2025, he launches ONES and ZEROS, a concept label uniting music, physical art, and community.

Hungary's heavyweight drum & bass export, KISHDEAD, is a rising force with a serious legacy behind him. For nearly a decade, he performed under the name Klay, tearing up stages across Europe, earning plays on Noisia Radio, and securing major bookings at events like Rampage. That period helped cement his reputation as a technically skilled, high-energy DJ with a keen ear for cutting-edge sounds.Now performing as KISHDEAD, he has refined his style into a fusion of high-impact jump-up, and crowd-focused dancefloor energy. His sets are loaded with bold bootlegs, unreleased edits, and fresh sounds designed to hit hard and keep the floor moving. While the name may be new, the pedigree is undeniable — KISHDEAD continues to push the boundaries of drum & bass, delivering performances that are as dynamic and fearless as his past achievements suggest. With a career built on intensity, skill, and innovation, the future for KISHDEAD is looking loud.

Aktive has been captivating audiences with his innovative sounds and energetic performances. Hailing from Luton, United Kingdom, Aktive has swiftly risen to prominence since the explosion of ‘Higer’ in 2021, establishing himself as a versatile and dynamic Drum & Bass producer / DJ. From the outset, Aktive's music has been characterized by its high-octane beats, intricate basslines, and a relentless drive. His unique ability to blend melodic elements with hard-hitting rhythms has set him apart in a genre known for its complexity and intensity. Aktive's journey into music began at an early age, influenced by the eclectic sounds of Breakbeat & Dubstep, which spurred his passion for electronic music. His dedication to his craft led to the release of several standout tracks and EPs on notable labels such as UKF, RCA / Sony, Crucast, Deadbeats, Liquicity, Device, Viper (+ many more), earning him a reputation for consistently pushing the boundaries of Drum & Bass. Aktive has graced the stages of major festivals and clubs around the world, delivering unforgettable performances that resonate with both longtime fans and new listeners. His ability to connect with his audience, combined with his technical prowess behind the decks, has made him a sought-after name in the global Drum & Bass community.

MC Fava began his career in 2001 in Freiburg, Germany, quickly becoming known for his versatile vocal style across all forms of drum & bass. Most at home with melodic sounds, he effortlessly blends rap, singing, and crowd-hyping into dynamic live performances. Widely recognized as one of the scene’s leading MCs, Fava became the first non-British MC to perform at London’s legendary Fabric club and remains one of the few German MCs regularly touring the UK. Since 2015, he has been exclusively represented by Clinic Talent, the agency behind Hospital Records. He has performed at major festivals worldwide, including Let It Roll, Liquicity, Outlook, Balaton Sound, and Sun and Bass, while also featuring on around 100 tracks released by labels such as Hospital Records, V Recordings, Spearhead, and Fokuz. In 2023, he released his long-awaited debut album LIFETRACKS on SUNandBASS Recordings.

Evolving from a retro-inspired sound toward more refined and diverse sonic landscapes, Martini Police blend electro-funk, kraut-rock, and alt-pop into a moody, genre-bending mix. Known for their high-energy performances, they’ve played clubs and festivals across Italy, often in high-profile settings alongside international acts. After making their mark with the EP Vibre Delivery Service (2022) and the single Vibe Check (NUDA, 2023), the Brianza-based band now takes a sharp turn toward bold, electronic, and contemporary sounds with the new, explosive debut album GLASS BREAKERS due out in 2026 via Bellezza Records.

B-Girl Carlota, also known as Señorita Carlota, is an Olympian from France who represented her country in breaking at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games. Known for her creativity, precision, and dynamic movement, she brings originality and confidence to every round. On June 14, Carlota will lead a workshop alongside Nebz (USA). She will also compete in the All Stars Battle, Break Down the House, and selected Cypher Town battles- bringing her Olympic-level presence and signature style to the event.

Nebz is a breaker from New York, the birthplace of Hip-Hop, representing the respected East Coast crew X-Fenz. With more than 10 years in the scene, he has built a reputation as a fresh and charismatic voice in breaking worldwide. A member of the Sziget family since 2023, Nebz returns to The Cypher as one of the MCs, bringing energy, connection, and real Hip-Hop spirit to the crowd.

VAEVA are a five-piece band from the Brianza area, formed in 2022 by musicians born in 2005. Starting out as street performers in Milan, they quickly built a growing fanbase with their raw, direct sound. After releasing several singles and an EP, the track “C’era il temporale” marked a turning point in their artistic identity. In 2025, they continued their momentum with new releases including “Acchiappasogni” and “(non) mi piace”, culminating in their EP Preda dei venti. Blending honest lyrics with emotional intensity, VAEVA create music rooted in real experiences—balancing chaos, dreams, and youthful energy.

artist: Andrea Costanzo Martini: Life in Lycra
description: A dance duel between a ballerina and a choreographer. Wearing nothing but outrageously tight Lycra costumes, two characters battle for the audience’s attention. Through a mix of sharp words, bold gestures, and the assistance of Artificial Intelligence, they embark on a journey through the twists and turns of contemporary dance—revealing just how silly it can be to take things too seriously. Beneath its apparent lightness, the work raises questions about power dynamics and control within the world of performance. Choreographer ANDREA COSTANZO MARTINI Performers  AVIGAIL SHAFRIR ANDREA COSTANZO MARTINI Dramaturgy YAEL VENEZIA Music LOSCIL  A. BRANDUARDI Lighting Design YOAV BAREL

artist: Mazorra: ENG I wanted to be a faggot but I was born latino
description: Mazorra offers a contemporary cabaret in which they explore migration, sexuality and discrimination with an irreverent and provocative tone. Through an array of raw monologues and a music landscape that mixes cumbia, electronic sounds and mariachi, Mazorra opens up a window to their life, scarred by the tension between their Mexican heritage and void European promises of progress. This is a show about the contradictions of a queer identity travelling from their country of origin, where they face discrimination for their sexuality, to Barcelona, an LGBTQAI+ capital, where they discover new forms of exclusion because of their migrant identity.

Le Patin Libre is a little figure skating revolution.Its virtuosic skaters have ditched sparkles and medals to experiment with an urban, contemporary, and sometimes acrobatic approach of their passion for glide. In Wheels & Cello, they switch their skates for wheels and strings. First developed for street performances, this dynamic show brims with joyfulness and emancipated pride while never abandoning the grace of skating. Choreographers: Le Patin Libre (Alexandre Hamel, Pascal Jodoin, Samory Ba, Taylor Dilley) Performers: Alexandre Hamel, Pascale Jodoin, Samory Ba, Kristýna Mikulášová Composer and cellist: Jasmin Boivin

Karen Dió is a rising force in alternative music, making waves with her high-energy performances and fearless sound. Fresh off sold-out headline shows in London and Brighton, she’s captivated audiences with raw intensity and undeniable stage presence. Karen has already shared stages with heavyweights like Limp Bizkit, Sum 41 and Wargasm, proving she can hold her own alongside rock’s biggest names. With an explosive live show and a growing fanbase, she’s gearing up to hit the road all summer ahead of a series of shows with Avenged Sevenfold this fall, solidifying her place in the next generation of rock. Karen Dió is not just arriving—she’s here to take over.

Syndanz collective’s two defining figures, Jáky Chan and Eliézer, have formed a tight-knit b2b duo since crossing paths in 2024. Their sets seamlessly blend the 90s progressive trance aesthetic with modern groovy techno, dominated by acid-driven sounds and layered transitions. They bring a deep creative synergy and raw energy to the Colosseum arena.

...And Nobody Else explores the search for an ever-evolving identity, a quest for a "self" that longs to be free within a body that feels too confined. Ahmed Ayed, alongside dancer Hamza Damra and drummer-singer Tim Clijsters, delves into questions of identity, examining the freedom to be oneself beyond the masks we wear or those imposed upon us. The performance highlights the tension between this pursuit of authenticity and the roles we play, the invisible compromises that shape our existence. Through movement, the transformation of the body and space, and the raw pulse of live drumming, ...And Nobody Else takes the audience on an initiatory journey where multiple versions of the self emerge, collide, and unravel. A performance charged with rock energy, where plural identities are embodied and deconstructed. Detto is a fresh and exciting new female voice in the Hungarian hip-hop underground, blending classic rap and boom bap foundations with more modern sounds. Her lyrics draw from personal experiences, while her stage presence is striking, energetic, and natural despite her young age. Following music videos with hundreds of thousands of views, she released her debut album in 2026 and already proved herself in front of more than 100,000 people at the major concert held on Heroes’ Square on April 10.

Drag has been constantly reinventing itself for centuries — but are we now standing at another major turning point? Questions of humor, politics, gender, and self-expression have taken on entirely new meanings in an era where drag exists both as underground culture and mainstream spectacle. What do we preserve from drag history, and what is being permanently transformed by social media and younger generations? A conversation about how drag continues to reinvent itself as one of queer culture’s most powerful forms of expression.

Sodakill is what happens when four unrelated sisters go bananas with your eccentric neighbour’s wonky spice rack. Since their start in 2023 Sodakill’s special blend of spicecore has been spreading all over Europe and the US, breathing new life into jaded rock hearts and recruiting lost youth wherever they go. They released their self-titled debut album in 2024, breaking the world record of downstrokes, rallying cries, and crushing guitar solos all at once. With their sophomore release due in 2026, Sodakill is just getting started, and the new record is set to smash into the global scene. You're about to get steamrolled.

Nation of Language’s fourth album, Dance Called Memory, blends synth-driven sounds with raw human emotion, exploring grief, loss, and the fragility of relationships. Frontman Ian Richard Devaney channels personal experiences—like his godfather’s death and the struggles of caretaking—into deeply empathetic songs. Collaborating again with producer Nick Millhiser, the band experiments with textures from My Bloody Valentine-style drum samples to early-2000s electronic percussion, creating a warm, unvarnished synthpop sound. At its core, the album balances vulnerability and humanity, transforming personal despair into collective empathy.

Gently Da Spittah is a 19-year-old rapper bringing the spirit of ’90s hip-hop to his music. His boom bap sound often incorporates musical elements from soul and jazz, adding depth and groove to his tracks. He released his first music video in 2021, quickly gaining recognition within Hungary’s underground hip-hop scene. Music has always been part of Gently’s life: he has played piano since the age of 3 or 4, and besides hip-hop, he is also deeply connected to jazz. Since 2022, he has performed at venues such as Akvárium, A38, Instant Fogas, Dürer Kert alongside Tha Patkányz, and Budapest Park supporting Sisi and Hundred Sins. He raps with the same energy — if not even more — in both English and Hungarian, giving international hip-hop heads the chance to connect with the youthful spirit he represents. In the 2024/25 season, he was selected as one of the winners of the NKA Hangfoglaló Program for emerging artists, giving new momentum to the development of his career.

Fab Mayday is the resident DJ at Urban Club in Perugia, Italy. He has played across Europe, blending disco, rock’n’roll, indie, rare gems, his own edits, and electronic music. For over 18 years he has curated and hosted his long-running night “Friday I’m in Rock”, sharing the decks with numerous international artists such as Andrew Weatherall, Erol Alkan, and Optimo, and organizing hundreds of gigs. Over the past seven years, Fab has been a regular guest at Sziget Festival in Budapest. He is also a producer, with releases on several international labels under various monikers.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Budapest based three-piece LAZARVS carve out their unique tones of heavy riffs alongside charismatic vocals fronted by guitarist and songwriter Aron Andras. Serving authentically aggressive and raw energetic live shows, LAZARVS have built a formidable name for themselves in the Hungarian music scene not only appearing at almost every rock music festival in the country but also drawing over 3000 punters to their headline album release hometown show at Budapest Park in September 2023. No stranger to the European and UK touring circuit, LAZARVS toured with and supported legendary metal acts such as Saint Vitus, Crowbar, Dopethrone, Weedater, Bongripper, Primitive Man and more over the past years, with appearances at Desertfest London, Pol’and’Rock, and Sziget Festival’s main stage amongst many others. In August 2023, LAZARVS released their highly anticipated 5th studio album, ’Blackest’, displaying their darkest lyrics and strongest songwriting guitar work to date.

YARIMA is one of the most distinctive new voices in the Ukrainian R&B and neo-soul scene. Her music blends soulful vocals with sleek R&B production, exploring themes of introspection, vulnerability, and self-discovery.She first gained attention after winning Pepsi Music Star in 2020, initially working with THE HARDKISS as producers before developing her own artistic identity and moving toward a deeper, more emotional R&B sound. Her debut EP Цикл (Cycle), released in 2023, received critical acclaim and nominations at the MEGOGO Music Awards.In 2024 she followed with her first full-length album Вояж (Voyage), a conceptual and introspective record featuring collaborations with artists such as OTOY. YARIMA has performed at major festivals including Atlas Weekend and won the New Wave of Alternative Music at the MEGOGO Music Awards and New Blood at the Jägermeister Music Awards in 2024.In 2025 she presented her first solo concert show — a three-act conceptual performance that elevated her live artistry and immersed audiences in the world of her music.

FRANKO (Zsombor Bartha) has been an active presence in the Hungarian music scene since 2023. Drawing inspiration from UK grime and electronic music, his tracks combine high-energy production with deeply honest lyrics, creating a strong connection with his growing audience. As both a member of the WAVY collective and a solo artist, he regularly performs at festivals and packed club venues across Hungary. In 2026, he released his second studio album, nem lesz ez így jó.

Hiro 10 is a professional breaker from Japan and one of the most exciting power movers in the world. He represented Japan at the 2024 Olympic Games and is known for signature moves such as the Rocket 1.5. At The Cypher, he will join the battles and lead a breaking workshop together with Stefani.

Kristóf7S is a world champion loop station artist who delivers the flow and pacing of a headlining DJ set with fully live-produced music. Blending Drum & Bass, UK garage, house, techno, and multi-instrumental performance, he builds each track in real time, layer by layer. At The Cypher, he will bring his unique loop station techniques and beats to make the Silverback x Cypher Town battles even more dynamic and colorful.

Mighty Jimm is a professional breaker from Belgium, known for blending explosive power moves with distinctive style and musicality. After appearing at Sziget last year, he returns following a memorable battle against Les Twins—one of the standout moments of the cypher.

artist: Silverback x Cypher Town Power Move battle

description: Norwegian pop star, Sigrid released her third studio album, There’s Always More That I Could Say, on 24 October 2025 via Island / EMI. The record explores the highs and lows of love with raw honesty, combining Sigrid’s powerful vocals with soaring pop choruses.Recent singles include “Two Years,” “Fort Knox,” and “Jellyfish,” marking a creative reset after she stepped back from the pressures of “content culture” in 2024. Time spent traveling through Norway and performing at festivals helped reignite her songwriting.Since breaking through with the feminist anthem “Don’t Kill My Vibe,” Sigrid has built a global pop catalogue with hits like “Strangers” and “Mirror.” In 2026 she will join Ed Sheeran’s “Loop” tour across North America after performing with him in Oslo in front of 28,000 fans.

Raisha Cosima is one of the leading figures of the Spanish Ballroom scene. A dancer, model and actress, she has brought her art to stages across Europe and New York, earning multiple awards within the Ballroom community. She is a member of the House of Miyake-Mugler and the Kiki House of Versace, two internationally respected houses within Ballroom culture. Throughout her career, she has collaborated on projects with acclaimed artists such as Kylie Minogue, Young Miko, Aitana and Chanel, combining technical excellence, stage presence and a magnetic personality. Throughout the festival, she will lead daily voguing workshops and present a special performance at the Magic Mirror, celebrating freedom, identity and self-expression through movement. Raisha Cosima  Assistant Nieves Cardoso

CRB is a French DJ based in Budapest, with over ten years of presence in the international electronic music scene. His sound blends Hardgroove, Trance, Techno and Oldschool influences, delivered through dynamic sets that move fluidly across genres.He has performed in key venues such as RSO and Club Ost in Berlin, Nexus in Paris, Das Werk and Sass in Vienna, alongside appearances in cities including Madrid, Tbilisi, Antalya and many more.CRB has shared the stage with renowned artists like Amelie Lens, DVS1, Klangkuenstler, Charlie Sparks, and Ben Sims, and has been featured on lineups for Boiler Room, BCCO, Teletech, Gegen, Nechto, Synoid, Sziget, among others.Beyond the booth, he is the founder of EDR, a long-running Budapest party series supporting emerging talent, a core member of Times New Romance - a collective at the intersection of  arts and music -, and a resident of Kink, a collective celebrating queer and underground culture in Hungary.

Rose Gray’s debut album Louder, Please captures the feeling of one perfect night out—euphoric, emotional, and transformative. Blending maximalist club music with heartfelt pop, the London-based singer, songwriter, and DJ tells stories of love, loss, freedom, and self-discovery, inspired by icons like Robyn, Kylie Minogue, and Madonna. Shaped by her journey through London’s club culture and years in the pop industry, the album balances hedonistic highs with vulnerable moments, presenting Gray as a powerful bridge between underground dance music and emotionally rich pop.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Formed in 2006 as a high school band, AWS has become one of Hungary’s most popular modern metal acts. The original lineup of high school friends—Bence Brucker, Dániel Kökényes, Örs Siklósi and Áron Veress—was joined in 2016 by Soma Schiszler on bass. In 2018, the band gained international attention after winning Hungary’s national selection show A Dal and representing the country at the Eurovision Song Contest in Lisbon. Their rapid rise was halted by the 2020 pandemic and the illness diagnosed in their lead singer and songwriter, Örs Siklósi, during that time. Örs passed away unexpectedly in February 2021. In September 2021, the band bid farewell to their friend and bandmate with a large-scale tribute concert at Budapest Park, joined by nearly 40 guest musicians. They also released two songs that Örs had written and recorded in preparation for the upcoming album. Their first countryside club tour after returning was completely sold out, followed by a comeback show at Budapest Park at the end of May, where they introduced their latest single. In 2023, AWS returned to major festival main stages and began working on their fifth studio album. Three years after the tragic loss of Örs Siklósi, the band released their first full-length album with the current lineup—now joined by Tamás Stefán—in spring 2024. Titled Innen szép nyerni, the album was presented at a major concert at Budapest Park and went on to win the 2025 Fonogram Award for “Best Hungarian Hard Rock or Metal Album or Recording of the Year.” In autumn 2025, AWS returned to the theatre stage, performing an acoustic concert at the Vígszínház in November as part of the Madách concert series. Tickets for both shows sold out in less than 20 minutes, resulting in two sold-out evenings rewarded with standing ovations from the audience.

gyuris is one of the most distinctive voices of the Hungarian underground scene. With his unique flow, dark yet playful lyrical world, and uncompromising attitude, he has become an essential figure in the local hip-hop/trap landscape over the past years. Active on the Hungarian music scene since 2015, he opened a new chapter in 2026 with his album “gyógyító frekvenciák” (“healing frequencies”), which he presented through sold-out shows across the country. On stage, the new tracks and old bangers come alive with live piano and guitar accompaniment — a setup that will also shape his summer festival performances, with a few extra surprises added in.

Luke Black merges theatricality and melancholy into bold, genre-bending art-pop. Born in Serbia and based in London, he builds immersive sonic worlds where cinematic scale collides with industrial pop grit and electronic intensity. His debut album Chainsaws in Paradise (May 2024) introduced a surreal, emotionally charged vision and drew international attention following his breakout as Serbia’s representative at Eurovision 2023, earning coverage from NME, BBC, and The New York Times.In 2025, Luke won the European Union Selection at EXIT Festival, securing appearances across major European festivals in 2026. He will launch a headline UK and EU tour in early 2026 alongside the vinyl release of Chainsaws in Paradise, reimagined as a physical bridge into his forthcoming album PARASITE coming March 2026. Onstage, Luke’s performances operate less like conventional concerts and more like digital operas, visually dense, emotionally exacting, and built around world-building and fan experiences rather than spectacle. Positioned at the edge of electronic pop and performance art, Luke Black continues to expand a singular artistic universe that is cinematic, confrontational, and unmistakably his own.

artist: Áron Molnár, Orsi Tapasztó, Nóra Rainer-Micsinyei
description: Hungary’s Favorite Morning Show Live at Sziget!  The team of Hungary’s Favorite Morning Show comments on the latest news with their signature humor! The performance will be in Hungarian language. Áron Molnár, Orsi Tapasztó, Nóra Rainer-Micsinyei  Editors: Dániel Beke, Dániel Praznovszky, Péter Bíró, Balázs Pataki

Roi Soleil (Sun King) makes ‘Frenglish pop with a dash of queer glitter’.  The Roi Soleil repertoires talks about (self)love, sexuality and identity and fluctuates between danceable electropop and epic pop anthems.  Roi Soleil is the superhero version of Matthijs, a small town boy with teenager trauma that he is trying to fix by putting a golden crown (made of tie-wraps) on his head. OUI, he is made of gold but he's here to let you know that everyone is. On his baroque wings he wants to enlighten his audience and will always be aiming for the Eurovision Song Contest.  Allez, let's go!

Táncra Fel! is a high-energy participatory dance jam where anyone can join—no experience needed. Led by professional dancers and powered by live DJ music, the session begins with simple guided moves and gradually builds into a shared groove. The format creates a relaxed space where strangers become a dancing community, letting go of inhibitions and rediscovering the joy of movement together.

Henri Gonzo és a Papírsárkányok is an alternative band formed in the aftermath of the pandemic by Cuban-Hungarian singer-songwriter Henri Gonzo. Blending literary influences with a timeless musical approach, the band performs in Hungarian and creates atmospheric, emotionally rich songs. Their debut EP was released on a limited-edition cassette in 2022, followed by their first full-length album in 2023, which was named among the year's best releases by We Love Budapest and Telex. They have since performed at major music and literary events, including MÜPA, Kolorádó Festival, and Margó Festival. Their second album, Vízszemű Gyík, was praised by both audiences and critics, earning a place among the most acclaimed Hungarian releases of the year.

Budapest-based duo dtnb. b2b LAU have been sharing the booth since 2019, crafting sets that move fluidly between house, techno, electro and breakbeats. Their connection goes back further — LAU's DJ workshop in 2018 was what first sparked dtnb.'s passion for DJing, giving their partnership a rare depth that comes through in every performance. Both rooted in classical music and seasoned on international stages: LAU across festivals and clubs from Berlin to Kazakhstan, dtnb. from Croatia to Vienna's Grelle Forelle, they bring a musicality to the booth that goes beyond genre. Together, their sets balance hypnotic rhythms, intricate melodies and fearless genre exploration into one cohesive dancefloor experience.

One of the most important influences in the global rap scene, multi award-winning artist Skepta has established himself as a multifaceted force, leaving an indelible mark on the worlds of business, film, fashion, and music. Through his journey, he has not only defined the sound of a generation but also become one of the most influential figures in contemporary music.Skepta's early recordings established him as a force to be reckoned with, and his albums earned him acclaim, including the Mercury Prize, becoming defining moments in British rap. As he continues to evolve, Skepta remains an emblematic figure, embodying the fusion of artistic expression, entrepreneurship, and cultural impact in the 21st century.In recognition of his impact, Skepta was honored with the Visionary Award at the 2024 Ivors. His most recent project, Más Tiempo, embodies his exploration of electronic music through releases and numerous sold out shows, including the fastest ever selling shows at both The Beams and Drumsheds London.Beyond music, Skepta’s creative endeavours also extend into fashion where he has collaborated with brands such as Puma and Burberry, plus launched his own brand, MAINS, blending his Nigerian and British influences into a distinctive identity. His debut painting was auctioned by Sotherbys in 2022 to high praise, with his debut film, ‘Tribal Mark,’ following suit in 2024.

Naïka is a fast-rising French-Haitian singer-songwriter whose music reflects her global upbringing across the Caribbean, South Pacific, Kenya, France, South Africa, and the USA. Identifying as a “Third Culture Kid,” she fuses world influences with pop, R&B, and soul. An independent artist with three EPs—Lost in Paradïse Pt. 1 (2020), Pt. 2 (2021), and TRANSITIONS (2022)—she has over 2 million fans and 165 million streams. Her breakout single Sauce featured in an Apple commercial, while tracks like 1+1 and 6:45 further showcased her genre-blending sound. Naïka has sold out a 23-show U.S. and Europe tour, played major festivals and venues worldwide, and made history as the only international performer at the MENA TikTok Awards. Beyond music, she collaborates with luxury brands and publications, including Christian Louboutin, Jimmy Choo, Fendi, and Elle, while championing education initiatives in Haiti through Fleur de Vie.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Bëlga was formed in 1998 and has been performing लगातार ever since. To date, they have released 14 studio albums, one live album, two remix albums, a karaoke DVD, and numerous music videos. The members of Bëlga are DJ Titusz, Még5, Bauxit, and Tokyo, joined by DJ Marvin and MC Fedora. Their music is for everyone from ages 0 to 100.Bëlga has performed on the main stages of all major festivals, including Sziget, Félsziget, VOLT, Balaton Sound, EFOTT, Fishing on Orfű, Campus, SZIN, MEN, Vibe, Pannonia, and Hegyalja. During the autumn and spring seasons, they regularly play sold-out club shows across the country. They have also given special performances at venues such as Müpa Budapest (Palace of Arts), Katona József Theatre, Trafó, and Millenáris Park, and have performed internationally in Romania, Slovakia, Serbia, France, Ireland, and Belgium.Two major documentary films (Propaganda and Partizán) have been made about the band’s history, and their work has been recognized with Fonogram, Viva Comet, and Hungarian Music Video Awards.

Baby Lasagna, Marko Purisic's musical project, was born out of songwriters need for artistic expression that will let him write and perform music without any strict genre limitations. With Baby Lasagna Marko has finally found a niche within which he can combine incompatible genres and create new audio sounds that are both fresh and exciting. The music was first presented publicly in late 2023. with singles "IG BOY" and "Dont hate yourself, but dont love yourself too much", and then absolutely exploded globally with "Rim Tim Tagi Dim" in the first half of 2024. The song won Croatian ESC contest Dora in February and went on to place second at Eurovision contest in Sweden in May, winning by far most public televotes from fans all over the globe. The song has now surpassed 35 millions streams on Spotity, and has spent some time at Top 40 official charts in territories such as UK, Germany, Austria etc. After a phenomenal ESC run, Baby Lasagna story took off super fast, with signing of a global record deal with Polydor / Universal Germany, selling out 3 stadium shows in Zagreb Croatian in one day, and selling out numerous shows across Croatia, Balkans and Europe. After a hugely successful first few live shows this spring and with over 60 shows booked until end of April 2025., the future really does look bright for Baby Lasagna at the moment. New music is also just around the corner, with next singles and videos coming end of June and then end of summer, with the debut album planned for next winter.

Since his breakthrough in 2020, Yssi SB has firmly established himself as one of the most promising artists in the Dutch music industry. With his distinctive style and talent for creating hits, he has built an impressive catalog that continues to resonate with audiences. His major breakthrough came in March 2020 with the release of “Paper Zien”, the first release on Quatro Vision, the label founded by legendary rapper Henkie T. The single reached an impressive 5th place on the Dutch Single Top 100, putting Yssi SB firmly on the map. In the years that followed, Yssi SB continued to innovate and collaborate with leading artists such as Ashafar, Lil Kleine, Jonna Fraser, and Ronnie Flex. His debut album Nooit Gedacht (2020) further confirmed his status as a hitmaker, quickly reaching #11 on the Dutch Album Top 100.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Pogány Induló is one of the defining figures of the Hungarian rap scene, often described as the raw voice of his generation and an artist who has successfully brought the glory of old-school rap back into the spotlight. He broke through in 2022 with Zártosztály, and since then, together with the ASAN Budapest label and his longtime collaborator Ótvar Pestis, he has been performing sold-out shows across the country and appearing on the main stages of most major Hungarian festivals.Marci’s solo album release concerts have filled some of Budapest’s largest venues, including Barba Negra, the MVM Dome, and in 2025 the Papp László Sportaréna. The Hungarian rapper, who has received both Fonogram and Artisjus awards, performed on the Main Stage of Sziget Festival last August. Later that year, an HBO documentary series about him was released, which went on to win an award at the 45th Hungarian Film Week.In February 2026, Pogány Induló took his career to the international stage with an eight-date European tour, performing in seven countries and delivering sold-out shows along the way.

Altın Gün are an Amsterdam-based psychedelic quintet at the forefront of the Turkish-inspired groove revival since 2018. Their sound blends Anatolian folk traditions with funk, psychedelia, and modern electronics. Their fifth album, Garip, pays heartfelt tribute to Neşet Ertaş, bringing their roots to the forefront. Their music feels both nostalgic and fresh, while their live performances channel a hypnotic, vibrant energy that bridges past and present.

BRIT award winning, Grammy-nominated, multi-platinum-selling group Bring Me The Horizon are one of the most successful rock bands on the planet, selling over 7.2 million albums globally to date. They have toured the world multiple times, playing sold-out shows in over 50 countries to over 3 million fans since 2021 alone. They are revered festival headliners across the globe, headlining Reading and Leeds in 2025 and 2022, Download in 2023 in the UK; Rock Am Ring and Rock in Park in Germany, Louder Than Life, Aftershock, When We Were Young and Sick New World in the US, Good Things in Australia, Summersonic in Japan amongst many more. They played to 140,000 fans in the UK & Ireland on their biggest UK arena tour to date, 70,000 on their 7 date Australian tour and performed their biggest headline show to date in Allianz Parque, São Paulo to 45,000.

Ski Aggu, the Berlin rapper with the distinctive ski goggles, has made a name for himself with his unique style, rousing tracks, and clever use of wordplay. He captivates listeners with songs that combine lightheartedness and depth, addressing everyday situations, party excesses, and pop culture topics, often with a wink. He currently reaches over 5 million monthly listeners on Spotify, which attests to his wide- reaching appeal. His successes to date speak for themselves: numerous gold and platinum awards, several #1 placements in the Official German Charts, and 1LIVE crowns for “Best Artist” and “Best Song” underscore his standing in the scene. Highlights in 2025 included a sold-out European tour through 11 countries, his first shows in the US, and appearances at the biggest festivals in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland, including Splash!, Open Air St. Gallen, and Deichbrand. Ski Aggu is no studio phenomenon: his live shows are engaging, interactive, and full of energy. With his distinctive style, he brings this very dynamic to festival stages in 2026, guaranteeing unforgettable moments for fans of all generations.

MPH is at the forefront of the new wave of UK Garage, rapidly becoming one of the scene’s most exciting and in-demand producers. With standout releases on influential labels such as Black Book Records, Atlantic Records, Sony and Nightbass, he's built an impressive discography that spans high-energy originals, chart-worthy collaborations, and remixes for global stars including Calvin Harris, Chris Lake, Foster The People, Anderson .Paak. Whether it’s bass-heavy club tracks or melodic rollers, MPH’s versatility continues to set him apart. He’s no stranger to the world’s biggest stages, with acclaimed performances at festivals like Glastonbury, Coachella, Boomtown, Parklife, EDC Las Vegas, EDC Thailand and more.Backed by heavyweights such as Fred Again, Skream, Sammy Virji, Disclosure, Floating Points, Chris Lorenzo, and Chris Lake, MPH’s rise shows no signs of slowing. With a loyal fanbase and growing international acclaim, MPH is poised to become a defining voice in the future of UKG - a genuine torchbearer for the genre’s next era.

LAMMER is an emerging force in the high-energy dance music scene, based in Rotterdam, Netherlands. His dynamic sound has quickly captured the attention of industry tastemakers such as Job Jobse, Benwal and Trym, placing him firmly on the radar.Renowned for his electrifying DJ sets, LAMMER has proven his ability to captivate audiences, whether in intimate underground venues or on grand festival stages. With a background in art and a deep dive into music production during his studies, his creative journey extends beyond music, shaping his vision for the visual elements surrounding his work.Following the success of his highly anticipated first original release ‘All Nightʼ, LAMMER is now focusing on his productions, determined to leave a lasting imprint on the scene in 2025. His sound, heavily inspired by 90s rave, trance and house music, is infused with a euphoric energy that creates a unforgettable experience for his listeners.With his captivating DJ performances and standout productions, LAMMER is quickly becoming a rising artist, gaining traction across Europe and captivating crowds with every set.
AmA Globetrotter. Born in Italy. Based between Italy & US.Eclectic, unconventional selector. No labels, just feeling.Few gigs. By choice.Dance. Sing. Love.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Beton.Hofi is a generational phenomenon. His genre-crossing sound and raw honesty have made him a symbol of contemporary Hungarian music. He has been one of the leading figures of Hungarian rap since 2021.

DJ Hruscsov has been involved in music since the age of six, studying clarinet and piano, and later working as a music teacher. He eventually transitioned from classical music to rock, performing in several bands and touring extensively during those years. In 1997, he discovered electronic music, and by 1999 he had become deeply involved in psytrance culture, representing the second generation of the Goa scene. Since 2000, his name has been associated with major events as a DJ, producer, and event organizer. With his own brand, Y-Production, he has been a leading figure in the scene for over 17 years. He has performed in almost every country in Europe, playing at numerous festivals and clubs, including Ozora Festival, S.U.N. Festival, Epochka Lake, Spirit Base, EFOTT Festival, A38, Dürer Kert, and Budapest Park. As a producer, in addition to his own live act (Y-East), he has collaborated with several artists such as Kalumet, Insector, and Sterbinszky. In 2023, Hruscsov became an artist of the internationally renowned Goa label Dacru Records, where he stands out as one of the most versatile musical personalities. His sound spans from progressive psytrance to full-on, from Anglo-Saxon psytrance to darker night psy, offering a wide yet refined musical spectrum.
