Matej is a loopstation artist based in Graz, Austria, creating fully live tracks using nothing but his voice. Starting out in the battle scene, he became a multiple loopstation battle champion before stepping away from competitions to focus entirely on creative freedom in his music. Blending singing, rap, and electronic influences, Matej delivers high-energy performances built for dancing crowds and good vibes from start to finish.

Since 2018, we have been performing on international stages — from major festivals to exclusive private events. Our strength lies not only in technical virtuosity, but in the interplay of groove, humor, and a genuine connection with the audience. There is no frontman in M.O.M. The crew and the shared moment take center stage — and the audience often becomes the fourth member.What began in the beatbox scene and with street performances has taken us to renowned stages across numerous countries. A key factor in our success is our strong sense of context: we deliberately adapt our programs to the setting and the audience. A battle stage, a children's concert, or a large festival each calls for its own musical language. Flexibility is a core principle for us.With just three microphones and our unmistakable sound, we move fluidly across genres — fromelectronic music to grooves from around the world. Our performances are less of a classic show and more of a shared moment: honest, playful, sometimes cheeky, and always in the groove.

A vagabond clown, with a red nose and expressive makeup, presents to us the sweet madness of an eternal lover who seeks to make music for the sheer pleasure of it. However, his violin case turns into a box of surprises, from which elements emerge that lead him to ramble about the world's problems and society. Amidst games, laughter, and moments of reflection, he invites us to reconsider the simplicity and beauty of life.

meOne is a Hungarian beatbox crew uniting four of the most skilled and accomplished beatboxers in the national scene. As 2nd place winners of the GBB 2024 World League, meOne is known for their unique contrast between the heaviness of bass-driven electronic music and the lightness of humor and pure entertainment.

Az Alem & Alexinho, közös nevükön Uniteam, világhírű beatbox duó, akik robbanékony fellépéseikről és páratlan zenei összhangjukról ismertek. Mindketten egyéni világbajnok beatboxerek, és közösen azért dolgoznak, hogy új szintre emeljék a vokális zene és az élő előadás határait. Stílusuk energikus, dinamikus és rendkívül táncolható, amelyben a technikai virtuozitás groove-központú ritmusokkal találkozik, világszerte magával ragadva a közönséget. Színpadon az Alem & Alexinho páros egy elektromos erejű élményt nyújt, ahol a precizitás nyers energiával párosul, minden koncertet intenzív zenei utazássá alakítva. Különleges kémiájukkal és folyamatos újító szemléletükkel az Alem & Alexinho továbbra is újradefiniálják a modern beatboxot, friss és vibráló hangzást hozva a nemzetközi színtérre.

TAS Visuals' Magic Forest is a curated voyage through the world of The Adventurous Spark. A deep, fantastic story told in light. Vivid, mystical, and hypnotic visuals in a unique and instantly recognisable style move between organic flow and precise geometry, building immersive worlds that breathe, pulse, and weave to the wonderful music of Maneesh de Moor.

ANNISOKAY are a pioneering force in modern European metalcore. Across five acclaimed albums and relentless touring, they’ve built a devoted global following. Having performed in over 20 countries—including the USA, Japan, Russia, and across mainland Europe and the UK—the band are known for their tireless work ethic. Following the momentum of their 2024 Bleed Out Tour with Within Temptation, ANNISOKAY will embark on their biggest European headline tour to date in 2025.

There has never been a figure in contemporary pop culture quite like Peggy Gou. The South Korean-born producer, DJ and creative force has become one of the most influential artists in electronic music, seamlessly balancing underground credibility with global mainstream reach. After studying at the London College of Fashion, she relocated to Berlin in 2014, where she developed her emotionally charged, dancefloor-driven sound. Her debut album I Hear You propelled her into a new era of international prominence, spawning the worldwide hit “(It Goes Like) Nanana,” one of 2023’s most recognisable dance records. By 2024, she had played to over one million fans globally and delivered her largest UK headline show to date, drawing 25,000 people. Beyond music, Peggy Gou is the founder of Gudu, her record label launched in 2019, and Peggy Goods, her lifestyle brand bridging music, fashion and culture. Through Gudu, she has overseen defining releases including “Starry Night,” while championing emerging global talent. Her influence extends into fashion with cover features for Vogue Korea, Vogue Germany, Vogue Netherlands, L’Officiel and Billboard, to name a few. Most recently, she closed the Australian Open 2026 to an audience of over 10,000, and in 2026 continues her global ascent with sold-out headline shows across London, New York and San Francisco, major South American tour dates including Lollapalooza, and the release of powerful new music—marking a bold new era in her career.

California native, DJ and producer, ONYVAA is one of Europe’s newest imports known for her driving melodic techno with Detroit influences and raw analog touches. Based in Paris, France, she is the founder/owner of vinyl and digital underground label, Passeport Records, which is distributed and pressed by Word and Sound in Hamburg, Germany. With a deep love for obscure field recording, she captures organic sounds from around the globe, encapsulating its ambiance into her original tracks. Supported by Laurent Garnier, Maya Jane Coles, Joris Voorn, Paco Osuna and many more, Passeport gives her creative autonomy to release her original productions.ONYVAA’s brand of no frills and movement provoking techno landed her on renowned stages like Rex Club, Café d’Anvers, D! Club Lausanne, Future Frequency Festival, Cercle at Musée de l'Air et de l'Espace and l’Institut du Monde Arabe alongside DJs like Pan-Pot, Luke Slater, Amelie Lens, Charlotte de Witte, ANNA and Bambounou. A growing sensation, ONYVAA plans to host her own “Passeport Night's” around the world in 2018, where she intends to captivate listeners with her energetic and emotive sets, from Africa, Asia and Australia to Europe, North America and South America. From 2019 she further releases racks on Plus 8 Records,Pushmast Plate X recordsng to name a few. 2023, ONYVAA is back in with a techno tour de force on her new EP Valley Of Fire, out via Charlotte de Witte / KNTXT’s sub-label RPM in spring

The Joker himself hosts a late-night circus cabaret where anything can happen. Magician, fakir, sword swallower, hair hanger and ghost of the venue, he guides audiences through a series of explosive circus acts: acrobatics, comedy, sexy juggling, fake magic, real magic, flying bicycles, punk clowns, muscular aerialists and hairy men with big pink balls. High-energy, surprising, grotesque and wildly entertaining — with a different line-up every night.

Bratři is an electronic live act formed by twin brothers Jiří and Ondřej from Prague. Their music blends the energy of dance electronics, hypnotic grooves, and melodic layers with elements of techno and ambient. On stage, they create a powerful symbiosis between live drums, played by Jiří, and analog and modular synthesizers, performed by Ondřej. The result is an intense, organic, and deeply emotional musical experience.Since their formation in 2016, Bratři have played dozens of shows not only across Europe and performed at showcase festivals such as Eurosonic Noorderslag 2025 (NL), Reeperbahn (DE), The Great Escape (UK), Tallinn Music Week (EE), MENT (SI), BUSH (HU), Nouvelle Prague (CZ), India International Music Week (India) and SHIP Music Festival (HR). Their performance at Tallinn Music Week 2019 was selected among the top ten live acts of the festival, and in 2021 they were nominated for the Music Moves Europe Talent Awards.ŰBeyond the showcase circuit, Bratři have appeared at major festivals including Sziget (HU), OZORA (HU), Colours of Ostrava (CZ), Rock for People (CZ), Cooltural Festival (ES), and Treeski Fest (EE), Europavox festival (LT).In 2024, they premiered a new audiovisual live show created within the European project Revelland, focused on multi-sensory accessibility and inclusion in live performances. The show was premiered on the second largest stage at Colours of Ostrava 2024 (CZ).Their second album ESCAPE (2024), produced in collaboration with renowned German producer Hannes Bieger, brought a more mature and emotionally charged sound and received a nomination for the Czech Music Awards Apollo 2024 for Album of the Year.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker

description: APE Soundsystem is the music project of APE Milano, built around a rotating crew of resident DJs and invited guests. For the Sziget session, the musical direction is curated by HotchPotch & Ritmo Posato, DJs, producers and founders of the project, + Sinister, also a great friend of the soundsystem. An exploration between house and disco, a unique way to make our body dance all the time. APE is a cultural association organizing events across Milan since 2012. Its mission is to create new ways for people to come together and enjoy the city’s public and outdoor spaces through music.

Whether we sing loudly in public, hum to ourselves or belt out songs in the car, singing is part of all our lives. Songs shape our memories and can instantly transport us back to defining moments. In Karaoke, the audience joins a karaoke party hosted by three performers sharing key moments from their lives through music. Guests are invited to sing along, choose their favourite songs or simply enjoy an evening of melodies, movement and memories. The live performance then transforms into a real karaoke party where everyone can continue singing and celebrating together.

Incident was originally a duo formed by Lorant and Gabor, that has had numerous released tracks, which include vinyl releases, on an impressive roster of labels that include Fokuz, Celsius, Lucky Devil and more. In the past years life set them on different paths, so Gabor started his solo career under the name. He became an exceptional DJ/artist and a resident of the legendary Bladerunnaz events. He had the chance to share the stage with Noisia, Spectrasoul, Alix Perez, Halogenix, Technimatic and more.Gabor gets the inspiration from various genres of music, like hiphop, soul and funk. Therefore he is a huge vinyl collector with over 2000 copies, and likes to use his collection for sampling.His favorite artists are Break, Calibre and Spectrasoul. The new Incident sounding is heavily affected by them.After a short hiatus, Gábor returned solo with musical appearances. In the first round, within the ranks of Britt Context Audio, he entered with a 3-song EP, indicating that he is still here and should not be forgotten. This was followed by a colorful 4-track EP on France's Hyperactivity Music, and his most recent release came courtesy of Ireland's inHabit Records, followed by remixes and material on multiple labels.  Gábor feels comfortable in all styles of drum and bass, but his true love is liquid funk and deep rollers. His music in the past and in the future also speaks of this. In addition to his upcoming solo music, he is also working on several collaborations with the young talent Ninive! He is inspired by his favorite artists, whose records he buys after each release: Break, Calibre, Spectrasoul, Alix Perez. In addition to the fact that Gábor is a lover of drum and bass, he is also obsessed with the 'Golden Age' hip hop of the 90s. He has already contributed to several Hungarian artists with scratch backing and accompanied complete record tours. He is a permanent member and contributor to the Bloose Broavaz band, due to his origin in Győr. A 2005-ben megalakult Incident duó tagainak közös múltja az évek során megszakadt, más-más utakon folytatták karrierjüket. A szétválást követően ne higgyük, hogy haszontalanul teltek az évek, Gábor a magyar drum and bass szintér egyik meghatározó alakjává nőtte ki magát. Aki még nem hallott volna Incident-ről: számos bakelit és digitális megjelenés halmozódott fel az évek során névvel fémjelezve, melyek nem éppen kis kiadók által jelentek meg: Fokuz, Citrus, Lucky Devil, Influenza Media, Disturbed, DSCI4.  Gábor DJ-ként a nagy múltú Bladerunnaz csapat és a Friday ikonikus sorozat állandó rezidense lett. Híres előadók mellett állt már a színpadon, mint pl: Noisia, The Upbeats, Lenzman, Spectrasoul, Alix Perez, Halogenix, Hybrid Minds, Alibi stb… Egy kisebb kihagyás után Gábor szólóban tért vissza zenei megjelenésekkel. Első körben a Britt Context Audio berkein belül egy 3 zenés EP-vel jelentkezett be, jelezve ezzel, hogy még itt van és nem érdemes Őt elfelejteni. Ezt a Francia Hyperactivity Music gondozásában egy színes 4 számos EP követte, legutóbbi megjelenése pedig az Ír inHabit Records jóvoltából látott napvilágot, amelyet remixek és soló anyagok követtek több kiadón.  Gábor a drum and bass minden stílusában jól érzi magát, de az igazi szerelme a liquid funk es a deep rollerek. Az utóbbi és a jövőben megjelenő zenéi is erről árulkodnak. Közelgő solo zenéi mellett több közreműködésen is dolgozik a fiatal tehetséggel, Ninive-vel! Inspirációját többek között kedvenc előadói nyújtják, akiknek lemezeit minden megjelenést követően megvásárolja: Break, Calibre, Spectrasoul, Alix Perez. Mindamellett, hogy Gábor a drum and bass szerelmese, a 90-es évek ‘Golden Age’ hip hop megszállottja is. Több hazai előadónak közreműködött már scratch aláfestésekkel és kísért végig komplett lemezturnékat. Győri származásából adódik, hogy a Bloose Broavaz banda állandó tagja és közreműködője.

Started collecting records in 2006 and organizing gigs with the group called Catch22 in 2008 hosting some of the most exciting upcoming foreign producers besides the best of the local scene. He began to pop up in the line-ups of Bladerunnaz events in 2010 and had the chance to perform on all major music festivals and club events in Hungary since then, before becoming resident of the party series called 'Different Drum' and 'Friday'. Through the years he also played a role in radio shows like 'Flipside' on Fúzió Rádió and 'Airbag' on Tilos Rádió. Harmonic selection and diversity is the key during his sets, but he doesn't mind a few cheeky combos and skill mixes every now and then. Although his favourites are laid-back liquids and minimalist rollers, he is ready to perform in any subgenre of dnb.

Monrroe is one of the leading names in modern drum & bass, known for blending deep emotion, atmosphere, and powerful production. After early releases on Liquicity, Galacy, and RAM Records, he joined Shogun Audio, where he created some of the scene’s standout tracks, including Out Of Time, Never Too Old, and Warsaw. Recognized for both his detailed studio work and energetic 4-deck DJ sets, Monrroe has built a reputation for his deep, dark, and tech-driven sound. Following his Best Alternative Act win at the Drum & Bass Awards, he continues to push boundaries with releases such as the IKEBANA EP on Shogun Audio.

Richárd Bense started to work with electronic music as a self-taught teenager. Over time, writing music turned from a hobby into a passion. He tried himself in several genres, but eventually his interest culminated in the broken rhythm world of drum & bass, with its more technical deep and neurofunk style. His debut EP was released on the belgian Midas Touch Recordings in 2022. His music has subsequently been released on labels such as Delta9 Recordings, Flexout Audio, Trust Audio and Chirs.SU's own label (FATE Recordings). At the same time as these releases, his DJing activity developed at Bladerunnaz team, where he played at a party with artists such as Noisia, The Upbeats, Break, Enei, Monrroe, Sub Focus, Lenzman, L-Side, Makoto, icicle. His DJ and producer profile started to become more sophisticated and sensual as he became a resident of one of the most popular Hungarian party series FRIDAY.  If you want to hear his young up-and-coming sets live, you should follow the Bladerunnaz events.

BUNT.’s journey is not a story of overnight success but one of persistence and dedication. For more than a decade he quietly developed his sound until January 2023, when his track Clouds became a global breakthrough. The song debuted on the Billboard Hot Electronic Songs Chart and has since amassed more than 275 million streams, establishing him as one of dance music’s most exciting new artists.Before his breakthrough, BUNT. worked with artists like Avicii and toured with Gryffin, but the pandemic forced him back to Germany where he supported himself with multiple jobs while continuing to produce music. During this time he shaped the sound that would later be known as Stutter House. Today, BUNT. is also redefining live electronic shows with his immersive “in the round” performances, bringing audiences closer and proving that dance music can thrive anywhere—from pop-up gigs in unusual locations to packed festival stages.

Since 2023, sim0ne has ascended from bedroom DJ/Producer to BBC Radio 1’s Future Star of 2024 and the face of TikTok’s #ElectronicMusic campaign 2025. The Edinburgh-born, London-based artist has won global support from peers like horsegiirL, Tohji and Two Shell, alongside widespread acclaim for her viral remixes—including her official remix of Lana Del Rey’s “Say Yes To Heaven”. Her high-energy blends of hard house, happy hardcore, techno and trance have landed her a Rinse FM residency, a BBC Radio 6 Music guest mix, as well as performances at Fabric, Glastonbury, ADE, Reading & Leeds, and more. Back in 2023, she launched her sold-out event series club zer0, which returns this Autumn in larger venues, with support from Warehouse Project and Broadwick Live. Most recently, sim0ne delivered a standout homecoming performance at Edinburgh Castle, and has appeared on a celebrated Mixmag live stream from Poland. With a relentless touring schedule that has also included Ibiza for Boiler Room and Pukkelpop, sim0ne continues to shape the sound of the dance floor on a global scale. Keep your eyes peeled for more in the coming weeks.

Berlin-based DJ, producer, label boss, radio show host, & Beatport curator Yulia Niko stands among the leading female tastemakers in modern electronic music. Known for her driving sound, she’s released on Crosstown Rebels, Three Six Zero, Siamese, Nevous, Get Physical, Sweat It Out, and her own imprint AXEPT, earning global acclaim and consistent support from top industry names. In 2025, Yulia’s touring calendar spans Coachella, Tomorrowland, Awakenings, Burning Man, X, and AXEPT showcases in Ibiza and Amsterdam, alongside headline dates worldwide. With two decades devoted to the craft, she continues to channel passion, humility, and artistic evolution into every performance, connecting dance floors across the globe through sound and spirit.

Owner of a brilliant artistic mind that has earned him recognition in Brazil and worldwide, driven by a personality infused with Brazilian groove, Paulo Vilela has carried the #produtonacional flag across five continents and 18 countries, performing at events such as Universo Paralello, Airbeat One, Rock in Rio, and Green Valley, among others. Since 2010, he has dedicated himself to music. With three albums released, he brought trance music to the stage of rhythmic gymnastics, composing soundtracks for the team’s gold-winning performances at Brazilian and Pan-American championships, as well as the Tokyo Olympics. Driven by emotion, soul, and passion, Vegas continues his artistic journey through his own label, Synk87, alongside Waio and Vitor Falabella.

Anfisa Letyago is a DJ, producer, and vocal talent based in Naples, Italy. Her musical journey began in the vibrant local club scene, evolving from clubber to disc selector in 2009. Anfisa’s sound is shaped by the city's dynamic energy and her strong connection to the sea, her primal influence as a Pisces. She gained recognition after a pivotal meeting with Carl Cox, leading to releases on his Intec Digital label, including her EPs “So Good” and “Hypnotic.” Since then, Anfisa has graced prominent labels such as Kompakt, Rekids, Deutsche Grammophon, and Hotflush. In 2021, she founded NSDA, her record label, embodying the mystical facets of electronic music and inspired by the fluidity of water and the island of Nisida. In collaboration with artists like Moby, Anfisa continues to explore her artistry, seamlessly blending her vocals into productions such as “You & Me” and solo tracks like “Rosso Profondo” and “Radar.” Her work reflects a commitment to expressing profound concepts through the hypnotic power of sound.

Based in Hungary, Botond is one of the most established representatives of progressive psytrance in the region. Active since the early 2000s, he has built his identity around the deeper, more melodic and atmospheric side of trance. A long-standing member of the goa.hu community and a label DJ of TesseracTstudio since 2018, he has performed at major festivals and events across Europe, including O.Z.O.R.A., EXIT Festival, Sonica Festival, Waha Festival, S.U.N. Festival and Daad Gathering. Known for his carefully curated selections and strong musical storytelling, Botond’s sets go beyond functional DJing, focusing on flow, emotional depth and the overall experience of the dancefloor. After many years behind the decks, he stepped into production in 2024, releasing music on TesseracTstudio (4 tracks) and Techsafari Records (1 track), further establishing his artistic identity.

Héctor Oaks is a multifaceted DJ known for his characteristic vinyl-only gigs and fiery unpredictability. His hypnotic ghetto-tech, acid scorchers, technopunk and gritty post-industrial tracks have ignited dancefloors from Bassiani to Miami - his “Fuego” detonates like a hand-grenade into the core of dancefloors awakening the spirit of raves.

Hiroko is a sonic architect who bends acid, industrial techno, electro, and Chicago house into pure kinetic energy. Every set is a showcase of her experience, knowledge and mastery. Supported by the new school, such as: Charlotte De Witte, Sara Landry & Eli Brown whilst also commanding the respect of dance musics alumni such as: Seth Troxler, DJ Bone, Amelie Lens and more.

szoliver and SLYM are the core of the Budapest-based label and organizer-team “techlab.bp”. Their releases, just like their events, cover many genres using the tools of hypnotic mass-entrancement and face-hitting psy-wisdom. Their vision and style expertly blends different styles, intergalactic synths, sharp twisted effects and oldschool goa melodies and deep textures.Known for their thematic approach and years of X-perience, they learnt how to find a unique way to put you in trance in every situation.

GLOWDRUMS is the manifestation of the harmonious union between music and mathematics, where drums and geometry dance in perfect synchrony.An invitation to illuminate our souls: let go of the limitation of our individual hearts to approach the collective resonance of our drums.“THE CONNECTION BETWEEN ART AND SCIENCE”

They say a spinning wheel never rusts. That it must be kept spinning, again and again. Always. But why? Out of fear of stillness? Of the void? Of nothingness? Out of fear of missing out? So, we seize it by the horns ! With its perpetual motion, the spinning wheel draws us into the heart of a dance of instability. At every moment, balance is threatened, movement becomes a necessity, a language, an art. Between physical performance and the poetry of vertigo, this show for a circus performer, a musician, a wheel, and its manipulator hypnotizes young and old alike with the virtuosity and grace of these circular gestures.Écriture et mise en scène Johanne Humblet Création musicale : Jean-Baptiste Fretray Acrobate Roue Giratoire : Marica Marinoni, Noa Aubry, Cassandre Schopfer Musicien : Jean-Baptiste Fretray, Pierre-Louis François Manipulateur Roue Giratoire : Maxime Bourdon, Claudio Ceresatto Régie générale : Claudio Ceresatto Costumes : Emma Assaud Construction Roue Giratoire : Sud Side – Antoine Gautron Teaser : Thomas Bailly Photos : Kalimba Administration : Sarah Harmach Production de tournée, logistique : Anne-Lise Mihelic Diffusion, production : Jean-François Pyka

Rolling contraption & musical instruments galore With his electric piano tricycle packed with quirky inventions – it smokes, it snows, it bubbles! – this mischievous mechanic roams the streets, weaving music as he goes and pinning his notes to the twists and turns of roads and pathways.Rock’n’roll, electro, jazz, metal, pop, musette, funk, blues, soul, rap, reggae… At the handlebars, a melody tinkerer who alternates between humorous sketches and an eclectic mix of musical pieces. On his bike-orchestra, built from recycled musical instruments compressed in the spirit of César, he will re-enchant your towns and villages! Author, director: Alain Benzoni Set design: Serge Yovovitch, Léa Dhordain and Simon Thorens Motorisation/sound: Pascal Dumerger Costume designer: Géraldine Clément Musician: Aimé Charmot

Break YOGA is a unique concept that connects basic breaking movements with authentic yoga poses. Hosted by Georgi every day from 11:00 AM, the sessions are designed to help you relax, recharge, and move your body in a new way. Beyond the energy boost, you will also learn some cool breaking-inspired movements to take with you from The Cypher.

During the Morning Dance sessions, we focus on waking up and aligning the body through coordination, mobility, and exercises inspired by contemporary dance. We develop spatial awareness, body usage, and connection to ourselves and others.The class is accompanied by a carefully curated playlist that supports our connection to rhythm and sense of timing, allowing movement to emerge more as a spontaneous, direct response.It offers practical movement tools for everyday clubbing, while opening space for releasing inhibitions and observing our own patterns.

artist: MÁTÉ MÉSZÁROS, ANDRÁS SZOMBATHY, PATRIK KERESZTES, ÁBRIS GRYLLUS
description: Pitch Black River invites the audience into a fictional space created through the encounter of movement, music, video projection and the world of video games. On stage, the “player self” appears in two forms: the conscious controller and its unconscious physical manifestation. Darkness and semi-darkness function not only as visual elements but also as perceptual states, creating uncertainty, transition and a destabilized sense of reality. Rather than following a traditional narrative structure, the performance offers an intense, multi-layered emotional and sensory experience.

Cassies is a young indie rock band from Vienna, blending elements from various styles into an energetic sound. Their music thrives on dynamics and strong contrasts, while their lyrics are honest, direct, and rooted in reality. Live, Cassies creates spaces where emotions can unfold and a sense of community becomes tangible.

TrueSchool’s new dance performance, Rhythm & Flow, is built around the HipHop, House, Popping, and Locking styles. The piece aims to present these four street and club dance styles through an artistic and conceptual approach, where the experience of rhythm and flow plays a central role both in movement and music. Kinga Ötvös is a Berlin-based vocalist, drag performer, and shapeshifter working between opera and experimental electronics. Born into the Hungarian minority of Romania, they fuse classical vocal technique with theatre, grunge mourning choirs, and raw after-club textures. Their live shows unfold as transformative collisions where voice bends, identities flicker and the stage becomes a ritual of fluid becoming. Moving between macho diva and other creatures, they turn performance into an intimate drag rite suspended between concert, opera and performance art.

A Newcastle-ben élő Melanie Baker őszinte, nyers dalokat ír fájdalomról, szerelemről és az ezek közti állapotokról. Zenéjében a ’90-es évek alternatív rock hangzása találkozik egy modern, queer nézőponttal: zajos katarzis és intimebb vallomás váltakozik, erőteljes gitárokkal és pontos szövegekkel. Világa a káosz és az érzékenység egyensúlya, ahol a humor és a sebezhetőség egyszerre van jelen. Élőben zenekarával személyes élményeit közösségi tapasztalássá formálja, elmosva a koncert és az érzelmi felszabadulás határát. Zenéje a megélt érzelmek zűrzavarából merít, és ezekben talál kapaszkodót, humort és kapcsolódást.

From the southernmost South, from Mar del Plata, Argentina, the manoAmano Circus Company tours around the world with its master piece of precision, vertigo and comedy. A duo of acrobats rests six meters high, fed by the most suffering tension, ready to break anything that may seem to be standing still. manoAmano Company exhibits how acrobatics takes a new shape when it is transferred from the floor that everybody steps on, to the air that everybody dreams of. This couple of tender characters put together simple situations sharing lots naughty sweet humor through powerful language of acrobatics. manoAmano does not fly, they know they never will, but they keep trying anyhow. Creation and Interpretation: Ana Clara Manera & Martín Umerez
SLOW BURNER is a choreographed jigsaw puzzle that invites the audience into a space of perceiving how human impulses, encounters and interrelationships shape the world we move through.

Following the success of Queendom, Szabó Veronika’s new performance brings together six male performers over the age of 60 — both professional and non-professional participants. Kingdom reflects on masculinity, the representation of the ageing male body, and the social codes inscribed into male identity. Rather than portraying characters, the performers experiment with their own identities and the stereotypes attached to them. The piece explores intimacy, emotional inaccessibility, fatherhood, and the ageing male body, while searching for the possibility of a more vulnerable and emotionally connected image of men. The performance begins as a live concert situation: when the audience enters, the performers are already playing music. Inspired by the rock and blues atmosphere of the 70s and 80s, the “old boys band” creates a festival-like mood from which performative situations gradually unfold. At Sziget Festival, Kingdom will be presented in a shorter, festival-adapted version. “The king rules over us, even if he is wise and understanding. But what happens if we look him in the eye? If the rigidity coded into masculinity softens and turns into touch? Why do so many of us feel that our fathers did not love us enough?” - Szabó Veronika

Budapest-based DJ and producer Daniel Moritz blends groovy techno, house, hard groove, raw techno and dark disco into a signature sound rooted in underground energy. His dynamic sets, characterized by vibrant rhythms and an unmistakable edge, have earned him recognition.Daniel has played in cities like Berlin, Helsinki, Stockholm, Vienna, and Wroclaw, as well as at renowned festivals such as Sziget Festival. In Budapest, he’s become a fixture on the scene, having graced the decks of every major club in the city.A resident and booking manager at Aether Club and part of the daytime series CityMatiné, Daniel is also one of the founders of the groovy techno series SOAKIN’. His performances continue to push the boundaries of electronic music, delivering unforgettable moments on the dance floor.

Sisi is one of today’s most successful performers in the Hungarian rap and hip-hop scene. She first drew the attention of both the audience and the industry with her self-made music videos and a lyrical style that brought a fresh new flavor, later earning the Artisjus Junior Songwriter Award and becoming an ambassador for Spotify’s EQUAL campaign. Sisi’s first track and DIY music video, titled “Yalla,” was released in 2022, followed by “Rappelj jobban,” the song that truly propelled her into the public spotlight. After an EP and several successful singles, her first full-length album, “SISTAHOOD,” was released in 2023. Her concerts are special and always offer something new thanks to her unique performance style and creative ideas. Over the past three years, she has progressed from clubs and festivals to headlining her own show at Budapest Park—an exceptional achievement for a female rapper in Hungary. Beyond her music, she speaks out only on topics that are personally important to her, whether it’s mental health, public affairs, faith, or the role of women in society.

Mulliville is a wildly imaginative outdoor circus set in a strange northern frontier-part dreamscape, part deserted homestead. In this offbeat wilderness, three eccentric settlers must clash and cooperate as they take on the ultimate challenge: a defiant mechanical bull with a will of its own. Inspired by the spirit of early cinema and the rugged charm of westerns, the show blends physical comedy, bold acrobatics, and razor-sharp ensemble timing into a fast-paced, family-friendly spectacle. At the heart of Mulliville are gritty stunts, absurd confrontations, and acid-tinged desert-country soundtrack that drives the action forward. Performers: Rauli Dahlberg, Lassi Tauriainen, Teemu Skön, Miro Mantere Director: Mika Formunen

AKE is a world-class Hip-Hop DJ from Italy, known for playing at major dance events such as Red Bull Dance Your Style Italy and Juste Debout in France. His selection brings the right mix of groove, energy, and battle-ready sound. At The Cypher, he will play at the daytime party and provide the beats for the ALL STARS battle.

artist: The New Era of Queer Revolution
description: The queer revolution has entered a new era: activism is no longer shaped only on the streets, but through podcasts, TikTok videos, and online communities. For younger generations, openly speaking about identity, sexuality, and personal boundaries has become second nature, while new labels, demands, and conversations continue to emerge within the community. From gender neutrality to asexuality, from polyamory to digital self-expression, the meaning of being queer is constantly being redefined. But how are social media and digital culture reshaping the revolution itself?

FAEDA are a four-piece indie rock band from Thurso, the northernmost town in the UK, deep in the Scottish Highlands. Fronted by Robbie McNicol, with Sam Cowan (drums), Cole Cummings (bass) and Jamie Mackay (guitar), the band delivers explosive live shows driven by raw energy and powerful melodies.They have quickly built a reputation for captivating crowds, sharing stages with artists such as Sam Fender, The View, The Lottery Winners, THE HARA, and The Luka State. Their rise has been powered by sold-out headline tours across Scotland, high-energy festival appearances, and a fiercely loyal fanbase. In 2025 they were nominated for Best Live Performers at the AIM Awards and were also highlighted by The Brighton Journal as one of the standout acts at The Great Escape Festival 2025.Festival highlights include Isle of Wight Festival, Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival, and Liverpool Sound City. In 2025 FAEDA will release their long-awaited debut singles, beginning with “Too Wild to Last, Too Rare to Die”, followed by “South Paw” and “Play with My Ego”, alongside a UK headline tour.

artist: Csaba Molnár ⇄ Nicole Clore: Lust Lab: Embodying Desire
description: Lust Lab: Embodying DesireA workshop for all bodies, all desires, all selves. Step into a space where bodies, alter egos, and desire collide. Move, play, and push your limits in a five-day immersive adventure with Csaba Molnár / Nicole Clore (HU/SK). Let your identity blur, instincts rise, and every gesture become a bold act of self-reinvention. Drop in for a single session or dive into the full experience—come as you are, become someone else, and discover the hidden, irresistible corners of yourself. Csaba Molnár, Nicole Clore

Cassia’s new album everyone, outside marks a major artistic step for the trio, created back in their hometown of Macclesfield after time spent in Berlin. Returning to the countryside studio they built themselves helped them reconnect with their roots and rediscover the joy of making music. The album reflects this homecoming—organic, warm, and true to who they are. Its title symbolizes being your most natural, unburdened self. Featuring singles like friends, heat, forever, and the eclectic title track everyone, outside, the record blends their signature indie-pop/rock energy with influences from afrobeat and Cuban music, showcasing new maturity and creative freedom. After the album’s release, Cassia toured the UK, Europe, the US and Mexico with a reimagined live show full of instrumental dynamism and new percussive and electronic elements. These updated arrangements appear on the deluxe edition, which also includes the nostalgic new single Follow the Sun.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Celebrating their 20th anniversary in 2026, Esti Kornél has released seven studio albums to date, as well as a compilation album featuring re-orchestrated songs accompanied by a one-hour film. Alongside their sold-out concerts in Budapest, they are regular performers at clubs across the country and at major festivals. In 2021, they marked their 15th anniversary with two shows at the Akvárium Klub’s NagyHall. In spring 2022, they released their sixth album, Nyitva hagytam, followed in June 2025 by their studio album titled Elég. Throughout the year, the band celebrates together with their community in the way that suits them best: in their favorite, breathe-together, lose-yourself-together clubs and at their most beloved festivals. There will be no laser shows or confetti on these nights. Instead, audiences can expect a series of special themed concerts, embracing every era of the band’s 20-year history.

cmqmartina is a singer-songwriter from Monza (1999), blending Italian songwriting with club culture into a unique, evolving mix of electronic, experimental, and pop sounds. She debuted in 2019 with “lasciami andare!”, followed by her first album Disco (2020) and an appearance on X Factor. Signed to Sony Music Italy, she released Disco2 (2021), Vergogna (2022), and Brianzola Issues (2025), collaborating with artists like Lo Stato Sociale and Myss Keta. With over 100 live shows across Italy, her energetic Nu-Dance sound defines her performances. Her music has also featured in TV (RAI’s Shake), and in 2025 she competed at Sanremo Giovani. Her latest single, “sei solo tu”, arrived in March 2026.

Mood swings, slowed reflexes, dizziness: the various physical and psychological symptoms of burnout infiltrate unnoticed into everyday life. What can an artist do with this enervated state in a world where work makes existence tangible? In this climate, it can seem as if continuous production, the accumulation of projects, is the key to satisfaction, while all this points the way to burnout. In his solo, Viktor Szeri does not hide his apathy, but draws on his personal experiences and builds his choreography on fatigue, on wanting nothing. He explores the creative process, the limits and tolerance of his own body through the filter of burnout, while also experimenting with how the audience can relate to this sedated vision.Created and performed by: Viktor SzeriMusic: András MolnárVideo: Tamás PállLight: Ferenc Payer Production partner: Katlan Group supported by: NKA Imre Zoltán Program, KIM, SÍN

artist: LaCerda: El Baile de la Zurda
description: LaCerda takes the vital impulse that moves all the bodies that dance to the rhythm of the music, to investigate the nature of dance as movement, but also as a festive meeting space and a paradigm of collectivity. They have  created a looping choreographic composition system that focuses on the relationship of the feet with the pelvis, on space, rhythm and the group, is inspired by danceable marathons and Latin American musical rhythms. El Baile de la Zurda is a tribute to dance, to the desire to live dancing despite everything, a tribute also to the Latin American roots of LaCerda’s artistic directors, source of their passion for dance. Creation and production: LaCerda Direction and choreography: Edward Tamayo Performers: Valentina Azzati, Johann Perez, Edward Tamayo, Aina Lanas  Original music: Alejandro Dutra Conceptualization: Júlia Vernet Gaudes

Soudeni is a Tunisian artist based between Paris and Tunis, known for her captivating blend of pop, disco, funk, electronic music, and Arabic sounds. Since her 2021 debutwith the single Madhabiya, she has released her debut EP in 2026 and nine singles, steadily establishing her presence in the music scene. Soudeni grew up inside two languages of feeling: music and cinema. The music conservatory shaped her ear; the screen shaped her eye. That combination is notincidental to her work. It's the architecture oft. She doesn't write songs so much as she builds worlds with very precise emotional coordinates, then populates them with her voice.

At the beginning of his breaking journey, Djibril was afraid to step into the cypher. Today, he is known as a b-boy who dances with confidence, freedom, and a huge smile on his face.A true freestyler, Djibril moves in complete connection with the music, letting the energy guide every round. He is also famous for his signature “diamond wrists” - his unique ability to spin and hit upside-down freezes on the back of his wrists.His message is simple: always believe in your dreams and objectives, and enjoy what you do.Djibril will be joining the battle at The Cypher stage.

Kid Mario is a young, talented breaker from France, representing Melting Force. Known for his explosive and unexpected power-move combinations, he has already shocked audiences around the world. At The Cypher, he brings raw talent, creativity, and serious battle energy to the stage.

Lion is a professional breaker from Venezuela, known for his never-ending power-move sets and incredible stamina. His style brings explosive energy, control, and serious battle presence to the floor. At The Cypher, he will join the battles and represent the power and spirit of Venezuelan breaking.

Mighty Jake is a world-class power mover from Venezuela. He has represented his country on some of the biggest stages in breaking, including the Red Bull BC One World Final, and has won major titles worldwide. After amazing the Sziget crowd years ago at dropYard, he now returns to the island as a champion-level performer at The Cypher.
Representing ILL-Abilities, Perninha is a world-class dancer joining us for the ALL STARS battle and hosting a workshop at Cypher Town.
Samuka is representing ILL-Abilities. Samuka is an internationally recognized world-class dancer and a winner of major competitions around the globe. He will be joining the ALL STARS battle.

AUTOFLOWER channels the energy of ‘90s House with a trancy edge while moving fluently between peak-time intensity and late-night depth. His shows have taken him across Europe, the USA, Australia and beyond - with appearances at KitKatClub, Virgo New York, ÆDEN, BUT Madrid, and Smolna - to name a few. With major support by various leading artists AUTOFLOWER continues to leave his progressive footprint in the underground circuit.

Hailed by Rolling Stone as “A Viral Pioneer”, bbno$ is no stranger to producing addictive hooks, having released the first ever TikTok thit, ‘Lalala’ with Y2K in 2019, which has gone 10x Platinum across the globe. Unlike a lot of his counterparts who's fame stemmed from a "TikTok hit", bbno$'s fame was no "flash in the pan" and his artistry quickly came to be respected in 2021 when he recreated his virality with his next hyper-successful hit "Edamame" which has gone 8x Platinum globally. He had opportunities flow in from his success with a performance at the JUNO’s, guest appearance during Coachella, a Late Night TV performance on Jimmy Kimmel, amongst many others. Over the years, bbno$ has become a case study in how to succeed as an independent artist. The sheer success accumulated by the young artist is evidenced by the fact that he has been featured in Billboard, Flaunt, tmrw, Rolling Stone, NME, Lady Gunn, SPIN, Euphoria, i-D, Ones to Watch and many other publications. His work as an artist and songwriter has received praise and support from the likes of both Capital FM and BBC R1’s Jack Saunders, and Triple J. In 2023 bbno$ released his 3rd album with Yung Gravy, Baby Gravy 3 and immediately went on to sell 3-5K cap rooms on the Baby Gravy tour across North America, Australia & NZ. 2024 has seen the massive success of bbno$'s singles "lil freak", "it boy", and "two" driving a staggering 750M views across 1.4M UGC videos while attaining roughly 140M streams across DSPs on those 3 singles alone. Off the success of “lil freak”, "it boy" and "two", bbno$ has grown by more than 2.5M followers across socials in just the past 8 months. In 2025 he will continue releasing singles at the top of the year leading into his ninth studio album slated to drop in October while also embarking on a world tour - a sold out 1.5-3.5K cap North American headline run (first time back solo since 2021), a sold out 1500-3K cap EU/UK, 3-5K cap in AU/NZ, and an unannounced 1-2K cap in SEA and Central/South America. You won't have to look far to keep your eye on him as he implements viral stunts across the globe and continues to collaborate with creators and people of influence across the internet.

artist: Fabla Collective: Do Birds Dream of Flying?
description: Do Birds Dream of Flying? is a performance in which two artists explore themes of balance, freedom, and limitation through movement and an originally designed set piece. A rotating and swinging ladder opens up an aerial space usually inaccessible to the human body. Their interaction with the ladder, which demands precision, coordination, and a keen sense of balance, creates a poetic dialogue between risk and responsibility, while reflecting on how to navigate curiosity and care for the world around us. Production: Fabla Collective Concept, choreography and performance: Inan Sven Du Swami, Mojca Špik Set design: Inan Sven Du Swami, Mojca Špik, Anže Bizjak Set construction: Anže Bizjak Music: Martin Vogrin

Zimmer90 is an alternative-pop band from Germany, consisting of Finn and Josch. The name Zimmer90 (which means “room90” in German) reflects their creative project, where they combine their interests in music, design, and art. They create a soft yet danceable sound, featuring soothing synth pads, disco-esque basslines, and percussion-heavy dance beats, along with Josch’s soft and distinct voice. In 2023, they played 28 sold-out headline shows and over 40 festivals in Germany, Switzerland, and Austria. The following year, they went on their first EU Tour (sold out) including London, Paris and Amsterdam followed by their first US Tour and a very successful gig at the Corona Capital in Mexico City and played over 50 shows in 2024 in total. Their unique sound has gained a lot of international attention: the single “What Love Is” became the soundtrack for millions of recap videos on social media. In 2025, Zimmer90 will go on their biggest tour yet, playing shows across GSA and Europe, and appearing at several festivals throughout the summer. In September, they’ll release their debut album, followed by three tastemaker shows in the U.S. and Mexico (New York, Los Angeles, Mexico City). Looking ahead to 2026, Zimmer90 will continue with the release of their second album and a world tour to further establish their global reach. What sets them apart is their tasteful aesthetic, which is evident in their music, lyrics, and social media presence.

UJAÏ originates from a passion for music, and the name of a yogic breathing technique. She considers electronic music to be nowadays sacred music and she dived into it during lockdown and ever since never stopped expanding her music collection. Through her sets, she takes us on an ethnic journey featuring afro-latin and tropical sounds, bringing house, techno, and percussion together to lead the crowd into dance, trance, and so much more.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Formed in the 1980s, Pál Utcai Fiúk is one of Hungary’s longest-running alternative rock bands. They began as a garage band, teaching themselves to play, and following the political changes of the early 1990s, they started touring regularly and releasing albums one after another. Their most recent record, Igazán ez minden, was released in 2019, with a new album planned for 2026. Their enduring popularity is largely due to their continuous live activity: having played more than 1,500 concerts since their formation, they remain driven by the desire to meet their audience as often as possible.

Jelle Denturck is the singer and frontman of DIRK., a popular Belgian indie band that – in his ownwords – ‘has been making a fair amount of noise these past few years’. But in fact he thinks he’s a real softie, with a record collection full of melancholic indie pop and rock music: Bowie, Beatles, Lou Reed, Elton John, Nina Simone, Anohni & The Johnsons, Sufjan Stevens, Perfume Genius, Wilco, Tobias Tesso Jr. ... clearly there’s a side to Denturck that doesn’t easily reveal itself in DIRK.’s music. It's about time, Denturck feels. As Dressed Like Boys he wanted to write songs and make a record all of his own. Not to turn it into an ego trip, but by way of self examination. Denturck sings about the search for personal freedom, about his dearest friends, his homosexuality and relationship, but doesn’t shy away from uncomfortable topics like gay bashing either. It doesn’t get more personal and fragile than this. Musically the influence of Denturck’s record collection is inevitable, and Dressed Like Boys’ sound mainly echoes that of the 70s. Denturck takes it into the 21st century with tape recorders (real!) strings, Wurlitzers, Rhodes, biscuit tin like drum sounds and a wonderful reunion with the (grand) piano, the first ever instrument he learned to play as a child. For all the noise Denturck likes to make with DIRK., Dressed Like Boys allows him to turn the volume down a bit for an intimate look into his soul.

artist: YAV: MOVEMENTS OF SOUL (ALWAYS WRITTEN IN CAPSLOCK )
description: In "MOVEMENTS OF SOUL," YAV brings together the dynamic worlds of dance, music, and fashion to create a unique and immersive experience.   YAV has deliberately chosen not to describe his piece to question our preconceived notions and conditioning, as we often find ourselves entangled in the confusion of distinguishing the message from the messenger. YAV encourages viewers to explore and interpret the performance in their own way to spark conversations about how we perceive and understand art.   "MOVEMENTS OF SOUL" is an opportunity for a layered, individualised experience.   It's a reminder that art doesn't always need words to convey meaning—sometimes, the most profound conversations arise from the unspoken, the unscripted, and the beautifully ambiguous. Concept, Production, Choreography & Execution : YAV  Styling:  YAV  Music:  YAV & SAFA LIRON  Text: K Yav Mbwamb &  YAV  Produced by YAV  Thanks To: Simone Zeefuik , Bijlmer Parktheater, Cherish  Menzo, Nicole Geertruida, Courtney May Robertson, Brandon  Maceo & R.Dk

artist: Kitti Nagy, Carmen Chraim, Happeningfish, Amelia Jane Hunter
description: Come and experience the funniest comedians in Europe at Sziget Festival!  The line-up consists of: Kitti Nagy (HU), Carmen Chraim (LB), Happeningfish (FI/CA) and Amelia Jane Hunter (AU) Take a break from being insanely cool and come and listen to some funny people instead.Performers: Rebecka Vilhonen, Dan Zerin, Pablo Lechuga, Nadine Froughi Production: Rebecka Vilhonen and Kitti Nagy

cancel. is a rapper, producer, multimedia creator and self-proclaimed maniac. Named one of Hungary’s most exciting emerging artists by Telekom Electronic Beats in 2022, he has built a unique artistic identity that goes far beyond traditional rap. Blending alternative and lo-fi hip-hop, cancel. creates immersive audiovisual worlds where every song is part of a bigger story. His energetic live shows combine rapping, singing, and live instrumentation, while his meticulous attention to detail gives each release a deeper emotional and conceptual layer. On stage, cancel. performs with a full band: founder Kenny, alongside Dani (drums), Armand (synths), Ákos (guitar), and Atti (bass).

Killakikitt — AZA and Tirpa — represent the pure, no-frills essence of Hungarian rap. Straight-talking lyrics, razor-sharp rhymes, and head-nodding beats define their sound.Their digital streams reach hundreds of millions.The group is known for consistent international collaborations, having worked with artists such as Onyx, Slaine (La Coka Nostra), Snak The Ripper, Merkules, and the Snowgoons production collective.Over the years, Killakikitt has proven itself as a support act for legendary hip-hop icons including Wu-Tang Clan, Cypress Hill, Mobb Deep, Xzibit, M.O.P., Onyx, La Coka Nostra, Psycho Realm, The Alchemist, De La Soul, and Cali Agents.

Lucky Done Gone has steadily risen as a standout name in the DJ scene, known for his energetic sets, warm presence, and strong connection with audiences. Performing across Europe and Asia, he blends house, ’90s techno, ’00s trance and leftfield sounds into dynamic, emotional dancefloor journeys. As a producer, he has released music on DGTL Records and Paradiso Vinyl Club, alongside notable remixes. In recent years, he has played major festivals like Awakenings, Lowlands and Down the Rabbit Hole, while also launching his own platform, Modus, in Amsterdam — a space to showcase his broad musical vision.

Mikee Mykanic came from the future. You recognize his voice and his syllabic rhyme schemes—stretching from six to infinity—from the very first second, whether you like it or not. He’s a genre of his own, from another star system. His lyrics never exist on just one dimension; his sharp, layered punchlines hit like gamma radiation, knocking you out.

NKS, also known as Nem Közölt Sáv, is a legendary duo in the Hungarian underground rap scene. To this day, NKS remains a key reference point for the new generation of artists: the music of Turan Khan and Zenki Mefisto, as well as the Kriminal Beats label and the Idő Urai collective, have clearly inspired much of today’s Hungarian hip-hop scene.

Tom Cassani is an award winning performance artists from the UK. Tom Cassani swallows swords, regurgitates things, hangs from his hair, puts meathooks through his head, performs sleight of hand magic and talks to himself (ventriloquism).  In the daytime you can find Cassani conducting durational performances, interactive encounters, strange new magic and one to one circus sideshow stunts. At night find Tom (and Joey a 100 year old puppet) holding court at The Joker where sandwiched between world class circus acts he will share demonstrations of the weird, wonderful and definitely questionable skills he has spent a lifetime aquiring. Tom Cassani – Lead performer Joey – 100 year old Puppet

artist: GBA Style: GBA Style fashion show
description: GBA Style is a Hungarian fashion brand creating limited-edition, handcrafted statement pieces for festivals, stage performances and creative productions. Its distinctive designs are made using recycled textiles, plant-based vegan leather and reclaimed industrial metal elements. The brand regularly appears in music videos, television and stage productions, editorial photoshoots, fashion shows, as well as Hungarian and international festivals. GBA Style views respect for nature, conscious material use and self-expression as core values shaping contemporary festival culture.

Jorja Smith is a British singer-songwriter known for her soulful voice and emotionally rich songwriting. She broke through with “Blue Lights” and her 2018 debut album Lost & Found, earning a Mercury Prize nomination and the BRIT Critics’ Choice Award. Her music blends R&B, soul, and alternative influences, while her collaborations with artists like Stormzy, Kendrick Lamar, Burna Boy, Drake, and Childish Gambino highlight her versatility. In 2023, she released Falling or Flying, a critically acclaimed album marking a new chapter of self-reflection, growth, and confidence.

Tridiculous combines power, dynamism and a generous dose of humour. The three Berlin-based performers are masters of breakdance, acrobatics, slapstick, live music and comedy, blending their skills with infectious joy and mischievous playfulness. Their fast-paced show rocks, shakes and moves audiences with spectacular jumps, breathtaking artistry and touching live vocals. Why use canned music when you can play live? A vibrant, high-energy spectacle that fascinates, delights and inspires. SEMION BAZAVLOUK – artist, performer and wanderer between worldsROSTYSLAV HUBAYDULIN – acrobat and physical comedianIHOR YAKYMENKO – movement and music artist

Born in Montreal and based in Paris, Charlotte Cardin shines on the global stage with striking authenticity and emotional depth. Named Billboard’s Global Woman of the Year in 2025, the Canadian singer-songwriter has amassed over a billion streams worldwide and performed on renowned stages from Bonnaroo to Festival d’Été de Québec to Les Vieilles Charrues, earning praise from Harper’s BAZAAR, W Magazine, TF1, and Le Parisien. In late 2024, following a sold-out Zénith de Paris and a standout performance on Star Academy, she broke through with Feel Good, now the most-played francophone song on French radio with over 100 million streams worldwide. Her 2023 album 99 Nights expanded her international reach, earning JUNOs for Album and Pop Album of the Year. She first broke through with 2021’s Platinum-certified Phoenix, which won four JUNOs including Album of the Year and made her the first Canadian since Céline Dion to top the Canadian Billboard chart. In September 2025, Charlotte Cardin returns with a bold and undeniably addictive track : Tant pis pour elle. It’s the fantasy of flawless revenge. It’s patience meeting anger with grace, then setting it ablaze into something greater. Tant pis pour elle isn’t just a fiery follow-up to Feel Good : it shares its strength but carves out a new era, driven by fearless audacity and uncompromising authenticity — a statement track, crafted to define its moment and resonate far beyond its generation.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Now in their 12th year, Blahalouisiana started out as a club favorite and has since become a main stage act at Hungary’s biggest festivals. Blending beat-rock and soul-pop, the band was the most-played Hungarian act on MR2 Petőfi Radio in 2023. They received the Junior Artisjus Award in 2019 and won the Fonogram Award in 2022 in the “Modern Pop-Rock” category. Their fifth studio album, Sötét Villám, was released in April 2024 and was successfully presented at a major concert in Budapest Park. Following the nationwide Sötét Villám tour, the band returned in early 2025 with a brand-new single: the haunting “AMORE (but not with you),” marking the beginning of a new era for Blahalouisiana.

Evening Elephants is the creative partnership between North Carolina-born vocalist Sam Boggs and Southern California producer and drummer Brandon “B” Leslie. Blending irresistible pop hooks with punk-like intensity, the duo first met at a backyard party in Los Angeles in 2021 and quickly began creating music together. Their breakout releases—including the Evening Demos EP and singles like “Life Is Swell” and “Snow On The Bluff”—have collected over 20 million streams. Known for turning shows into wild community-driven parties, they’ve sold out venues across the U.S. and even shut down a New York street with a 1,000-person pop-up show. Now signed to Republic Records, Evening Elephants are preparing to release their debut album and tour Europe in 2025.

Raasa is a Budapest-based DJ with over a decade of experience, known for navigating the full spectrum of house music — from indie dance through minimal and deep tech to more driving, high-energy house — always with a strong focus on groove and atmosphere. Over the years, he has performed at many of Budapest’s key venues and underground spaces, including Turbina, Aether, Toldi, Palazzo Permanens, Heavy and Dugattyús. For nearly ten years, he has also been shaping the scene as an event organizer, founding and curating projects such as Kráter Festival, Botellón Budapest street parties, Lowpass mini festival and Funkyzeit disco nights. His international presence spans from French ski festivals to Transylvania, as well as global cities like New York and Shanghai. He is also a recurring artist at the Colosseum stage of the Sziget Festival. Beyond DJing, Raasa is the music curator of W Budapest hotel, artistic curator at Brain Bar, and co-owner of the Hello Wood architectural studio. His work — both in music and beyond — is driven by a strong sense of atmosphere, community, and carefully crafted experiences.

For its fifth creative production, Compagnie XY explored the outer confines of acrobatics, through analogy, by seeking out concepts of natural phenomena such as murmurings. That form of communication that can be felt in the flight of starlings : a choreography of hundreds of birds, so well-timed and so dense that it sometimes eclipses the sun, even just for an instant... The collective thus pursues its research on acrobatic language, this time by anchoring the circus act at the heart of continuous movement, a « continuum » that allows situations to reverse, upset and swing without having to oppose ones with others. The bare and immaculately white set presents like an infinite space that electrifyingly empties and fills, where the action is deployed like a chain reaction. A responsive and sensorial territory where neither nature, nor culture, nor body or spirit would be opposed. Veritable ode to the living, Möbius thus returns us to the absolute necessity of «creating together» as the basis for all forms of subsistence, perpetuation and invention.Artists on tour :  Airelle Caen, Antoine Thirion, Antonio Terrones y Hernandez, Arnau Povedano, Belar San Vincente, Consuelo Burgos Bustos, Florian Sontowski, Gwendal Beylier, Hamza Benlabied, Léo Ward, Lisandro Gallo, Löric Fouchereau, Pablo Monedero (Otto), Paula Wittib, Pedro Guerra, Peter Freeman, Raphaela Olivo, Tuco Hage Meany, Tuk Frederiksen. Artistic collaborations : Rachid Ouramdane, Jonathan Fitoussi, Clemens Hourrière Light designer : Vincent Millet Costumes designer : Nadia Léon  Acrobatic collaboration : Nordine Allal Production managers : Peggy Donck and Antoine Billaud Tour managers : Antoine Billaud and Johanna Autran Technical manager and Sound : Claire Thiebault Thanks to : Mayalen Otodon, Agalie Vandamme, Catherine Germain, Roser Lopez-Espinosa

artist: Oli Mathiesen with Lucy Lynch and Sharvon Mortimer
description: The award-winning endurance-based dance work to the booming techno album 'Nocturbulous Behaviour' by Suburban Knight is the atmosphere and culture of a 3-day rave condensed into an hour. Relentless movement, seamless without pause, detailed down to every beat. Exploring the movement used in techno and rave culture, witness the destruction of 3 humans. Indulge in the pain, the sweat; a display of pure endurance to achieve a goal. A spectacle of the human body as a victim to music, to passion, to our endless desire to achieve more. To win and win again. Creator, Choreographer, and Performer: Oli Mathiesen (Ngāti Manu, Ngāti Hine, Ngāpuhi) Choreographer and Performer: Lucy Lynch (Ngāti Kahungunu) Choreographer and Performer: Sharvon Mortimer (Ngāti Porou) Producer and Stage Manager: Gina Heidekruger Production Manager, Lighting Designer, and Operator: Shanell Bielawa (Te Ātihaunui-a-Pāpārangi) Music: Suburban Knight

Balázs V. Kiss., an illusionist and one of the most prominent figures in his field in Hungary, combines modern magic with stand-up comedy and theater. He has performed on stages across numerous countries, from England and Sweden to the United Arab Emirates. He was the illusionist at the Dubai World Expo and remains a regular performer at international Formula 1 races to this day. He has performed for audiences of thousands in stadiums and on the main stages of festivals, and has dazzled numerous domestic and international stars with his acts. In previous years, Balázs developed unique productions for several theater premieres and television shows. Currently, he tours both domestically and internationally with his own full-length theatrical performances. He has been honored with several professional awards for his craft. In recent years, he has also served as a judge at these competitions. According to him, his goal is to use his performances to transport his audience out of the monotony of everyday life and make that moment special for them. Furthermore, he makes no secret of the fact that, for a very long time now, the world of magic has been his life.

Csinszka is a Hungarian singer-songwriter of Transylvanian origin, blending pop, electronic music, and alternative R&B into a distinctive sound. Her debut album, Finally Opening Up (2023), introduced her introspective songwriting and atmospheric production, followed by collaborations with artists including DomBeats and Jazzbois. In 2025, she entered a new creative chapter with Hibrid, fusing traditional Hungarian folk music with electronic elements. Her breakthrough came with Felsütött a napsugára, which went viral on TikTok, while Airday reached #1 on Spotify Viral 50 Hungary. Later that year, she represented Hungary in Spotify’s global EQUAL campaign supporting female artists. Her second album, TRANSFORMANIA, further established her unique artistic vision and was introduced with a sold-out headline show. In 2026, Csinszka continues her momentum with another sold-out concert at Akvárium Klub, a support show for Manuel at Budapest Park, and a busy summer festival season, while working on new music.

Welcome to Carnivale Royale, A Queer Cabaret for all to enjoy, a sensual night full of surprises. This is an invitation to come together without prejudice, a celebration of who we truly are and a home for both artists and audiences to be unapologetically themselves. True to the House of Circus motto: Be who you want to be, wear what you want to wear, love who you want to love. Carnivale Royale unites a group of some of Europe’s best contemporary circus performers into a chosen family that delights its audience with kick ass artistry, aerial acrobatics, impossibilities and drag performers. “Sexy, soulful, daring and deeply human”

The takeaway of the moniker fix up is a smooth sound revival of the bouncy bass, bubbly harmony and arpeggio dynamo of the gilded age of the synthesizer - be that then or now.Scanning shores of italo and indie and overlooking iridescent blue skies of hedone dotted with leftfield edits and picks unearthed from Japan to Italy keep Adis ever busy. In the time remaining he goes by Andris Kuruz and works at keeping his birthplace locale in the global nexus. Residencies in PONTOON and Toldi, staples of clublife in Central Europe share his attention with curating the lineup at Kolorado festival and SANTSAT. This latter, co-created by him is one of the spiciest up-and-coming daytime event rarities of the area with emphasis on a fine-tuned synthesis of bookings, set design and specialty natural locations.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: More than three decades have passed since Quimby broke free from their rehearsal room in Dunaújváros, first conquering Budapest’s nightlife and then systematically captivating not only Hungary but the rest of Europe as well. The six-piece band — Tibor Kiss (vocals, guitar), Livius Varga (percussion, backing vocals), Szilárd Balanyi (keyboards, backing vocals), Dódi Kárpáti (trumpet, vocals), Ferenc Mikuli (bass guitar), and Ferenc Gerdesits (drums) — has left an indelible mark on Hungarian popular music with sixteen eclectic albums, all while developing their own unmistakable sound over the years. Their bone-chilling lyrics, a genre-defying musical universe ranging from reimagined chanson and guitar-driven hits to the wildest psychedelia, and explosive live performances built on the magic of the moment have all contributed to Quimby becoming Hungary’s number one live band by the mid-2010s. Alongside almost constant national and international touring, the band has filled the Papp László Budapest Sportaréna multiple times and famously transformed day zero of Sziget Festival in 2013 into “Wonderland.” Without ever consciously taking stock, Quimby has grown into its legacy. Now a fully matured band in every sense, they have been forged together by shared successes and challenges alike. And as they declared at the end of their sold-out Budapest Park concert in 2022: it looks like they’re here to stay.

The band was founded by high school friends who later connected with underground musicians from Budapest through encounters in the nightlife scene. Their music is genre-defying and uncompromising: influenced by their two Brazilian members and their Hungarian roots, their sound primarily draws from the musical axis between South America and the Balkans, while also incorporating elements from many other styles to create a unique sonic identity.They bring explosive energy to the stage every time with a punk attitude, which is why they are regularly invited back not only to Hungarian clubs and festivals, but also internationally—from France through Poland all the way to Turkey.

Elefánt launched in 2012 with an unchanged lineup and quickly became a defining force in the Hungarian alternative scene. Their albums — Vérkeringő, Gomoly, Minden, and EL — brought growing acclaim, sold-out shows, and major industry recognition, with EL achieving double platinum and becoming Hungary’s most popular album of 2022. Between 2021 and 2023 they released several successful singles and the Gázgyár Live Session, followed by the 2023 double vinyl IKSZ, celebrating their first decade — marked by nationwide sold-out tours.

Berlin-based, London born DJ fka.m4a has become a stalwart of underground music with a heady blend of Italo Disco, high NRG and leftfield techno. With several Boiler Room appearances under his belt - clocking up over half a million streams combined - plus shows everywhere from Timewarp to Awakenings, features in Mixmag and Electronic Beats, plus Peggy Gou in his corner as a mentor, his stock is firmly on the rise. Moving to Berlin in 2019, the pandemic quickly put a stop to his burgeoning DJ career before a switch to recording streams from his apartment during covid saw his profile blow up, leading to signing with an agency and bagging his first Panorama Bar set when lockdown lifted. “Itʼs important for me to make music that works in the club,ˮ he says. ‘But most importantly, itʼs about making something that comes straight from the heart. I think Iʼve achieved that on my first EP and I canʼt wait for people to connect with it.ˮ With an event series in the pipeline and a summer stacked with festival shows from Melt to Terminal V, fka.m4a has firmly cemented himself as one of the leading, up-and-coming artists in the underground space. fka.m4a isnʼt chasing trends — heʼs building something personal, creative, and wide open to anyone ready to dance.

From melancholy to bittersweet euphoria, TDJ's vaporous and acidulous universe is an incongruous amalgam between Geneviève Ryan-Martel’s years of composing guitar ballads and experimenting with electronic music production.The materialization of her first loves for techno, trance and eurodance; Geneviève takes from her nostalgia of the classics signed by Tiestö, Gamemaster, Signum or ATB, but also from her emo youth influenced by artists like Blink-182, From First To Last, and Taking Back Sunday.
