Their albums — Vérkeringő, Gomoly, Minden, and EL — brought growing acclaim, sold-out shows, and major industry recognition, with EL achieving double platinum and becoming Hungary’s most popular album of 2022. Between 2021 and 2023 they released several successful singles and the Gázgyár Live Session, followed by the 2023 double vinyl IKSZ, celebrating their first decade — marked by nationwide sold-out tours.

Dublic is a Hungarian DJ and producer duo of twin brothers, co-founders of Next Level and Next Level Music School, who have been a driving force in Budapest’s underground scene with their high-energy sets and productions blending trap, dubstep, riddim, future bass, hip-hop, and drum and bass - always believing in future music. They have performed at every major festival in Hungary and toured Europe in countries such as the UK, Germany, Belgium, Austria, Romania, Serbia and Slovakia. Their own music is released by, among others, London-based Circus Records alongside artists such as Flux Pavilion and Doctor P.

The chosen trio from the most colorful festival of Italy goes by the name of Chroma Sound System and is ready to blow up Alternativa Event's Light Stage. Mencarhell, Federiclyro & Ale T. ignite dancefloors for years with their thrilling rock music selection, that never misses electro incursions and essential classics.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Analog Balaton, formed by Aba Zsuffa and Ákos Vörös in Budapest in 2017, are among Hungary’s most exciting electronic acts. Blending acoustic guitars with dark, pulsating electronics, they built a following through sold-out shows before releasing music. Their 2021 debut Lent earned critical acclaim for its raw, lyrical intimacy. Followed by the Csússz le EP, major awards, and the album Repedés, the duo continue to evolve while selling out landmark venues nationwide.

Inspired by Herman Melville’s novel Moby Dick, The Whale Street is a roaming performance rooted in the street procession traditions of Southern Europe. The French company CPPP invites the audience to embark on the story of Captain Ahab, setting out in pursuit of the legendary whale.Drifting across Óbuda Island, his obsessive quest and thirst for revenge seem to lead him straight toward his downfall. As the end of his journey approaches, Moby Dick awakens…The different chapters of the story unfold to the rhythm of live music. Circus arts — aerial straps, Chinese pole, balancing acts and teeterboard — and dance — hip-hop and flamenco — intertwine to tell this epic tale.The encounter with the legendary creature, its pursuit and the final confrontation transform Budapest into the pages of this spectacular novel.Will you be part of the journey?

Megérkezés az ürességbe. Az Immerzum hang és vízió fúziójából születő szinesztetikus világ, atmoszférája felderíti a belső osvényt és kísér az úton. Életünk a rohanás rögeszmés vetületeként sodródik végtelen ingeráradat és adatfolyam tengerének stimulációjában. A modern életstílus levegőjében viszket a lélegzet. Az Immerzum lehetőséget ajánl egy a természetünkhöz közelebbi tudatállapothoz kacsolódni a túlcsorduló technológia helyett melyhez idomulni igyekszünk. Meditációs gyakorlat, a lelassulás élményén keresztül, a belső nyugalom tükrében felragyog a tudat s a tudatalatti. A vizuális esztétikát valós idejű generatív szintézis kelti életre. A két érzéki sík lágy kapcsolatán keresztül a befogadó a szabad asszociáció és belső utazás élményényében töltheti az időt. A hatás egészen mély nyugalmon át emelkedett pszichikai és fiziológiai jóllétet eredményezhet.

Liberty Love Rave is a large-scale, visually striking production in which contemporary circus, modern and street dance, and electronic music merge into a shared, pulsating stage universe. Around thirty dancers, 8–10 contemporary circus performers, and a DJ/MC come together to create a living, breathing organism. A monumental, pyramid- like staircase structure, immersive lighting design, a rave-inspired light installation, and both aerial and ground-based contemporary circus elements combine to build a world where DJ sets, ritual, and dreamlike visions intersect. The production becomes an immersive experience of freedom, connection, and collective rhythm.

Don't Stop The Queen is Hungary’s most versatile and internationally acclaimed Queen tribute band. In just four years, they have performed successful concerts across eight countries and two continents, bringing the timeless music of Queen to audiences around the world. Their ever-evolving setlist spans every era of Queen’s career, while their explosive live show captures the spirit of the original band without imitation or gimmicks. Led by vocalist Máté Takáts, every member of the band also contributes backing vocals, faithfully recreating Queen’s signature layered harmonies. Combined with meticulously crafted arrangements, this results in an authentic live experience that comes remarkably close to the sound of the original studio recordings. Members: Máté Takáts – vocalsLászló Móczár – guitar, backing vocalsLászló Károlyi – keyboards, backing vocalsGábor Mészáros – bass, backing vocalsAttila Brassói – drums, backing vocals

Hamdi has become one of the most exciting and versatile producers in global electronic music, blending a signature dubstep weight with genre‐bending productions that push the boundaries of modern dance music. Born in Oxford, Hamdi (real name Alexander Hamdi) has been producing electronic music for over a decade, first getting into DJing soon after his eighteenth birthday. He quickly established himself as one of the most in‐demand young producers in the UK scene through consistent EP releases and a run of well‐received free downloads on SoundCloud. During this period, he also earned a reputation as one of the most energetic DJs on the circuit, widely recognized for his rare ability to DJ and MC simultaneously.

u.r.trax is a Paris-born producer and DJ. Her work blurs the line between club culture and sound design, exploring the tension between chaos, fun, and beauty. Her DJ sets are unpredictable journeys where pleasure, spirit, and instinct meet — a living exchange between sound, space, and bodies. Moving freely across genres and energies, she curates music that feels both futuristic and timeless, constantly seeking surprise and emotional depth. As a producer, her releases on Nina Kraviz’s trip (2022) and her compositions for Coperni (2023-2025) reveal a singular sonic identity, balancing intensity and grace. After several years devoted to composition and experimentation, she will unveil her first live show at Primavera 2026.

SzikraShow is more than a fire performance – it’s a true artistic experience that unfolds dynamically, with fire dancers continuously engaging the audience. The mesmerizing movement of flaming props and the stunning pyrotechnics captivate viewers of all ages. The show culminates in a spectacular finale, where the stage becomes a breathtaking display of ground fireworks, leaving the audience in awe. All of this is done with full respect for wildlife and the natural environment.

Quest is a rare breed -  an artist whose name moves quietly but powerfully through the electronic underground. Influenced early on by Italy’s Alien Army and the precision of shadowboxing, his sets are driven by tension, dissonance, and a deep commitment to musical craft.Label owner of La Nota Del Diablo - a label named after the “Devil’s Interval,” a historically ominous tritone used to stir emotion through sound. That same dark, atmospheric energy runs through his selections, where unearthed, genre-defying gems span from outré techno to electro and EBM.Known for his low-key presence and high-impact sets, Quest has built his reputation beyond the noise of social media — from his early days in Italy to formative years at London’s Vinyl Pimp, Berlin’s rich scene, and now his Barcelona base. His unmistakable sonic signature has earned him slots at Berghain, Circoloco, Kappa Futur Festival, Time Warp, and more.

Soulwax is the electronic rock project led by Belgian brothers David and Stephen Dewaele, active since 1995 and widely regarded as one of the most innovative acts in alternative and electronic music. Known for constantly pushing genre boundaries, the band blends electronic production with live instrumentation and experimental sound design. Albums such as Nite Versions and the award-winning FROM DEEWEE marked important milestones in modern electronic music.Soulwax is also celebrated for its distinctive live shows, often featuring multiple drummers and extensive analog setups that create a powerful and immersive sound. Beyond their own releases, the Dewaele brothers are highly sought-after producers and remixers, collaborating with artists including Rosalía, Robyn, Tame Impala and The Rolling Stones. Soulwax continues to redefine the possibilities of electronic music on both stage and in the studio.

GORO is a boundary-pushing electronic artist reshaping the sound of the Balkan underground. His music fuses contemporary global club styles with the sonic language of Balkan mainstream culture, creating a raw, high-energy hybrid that feels both familiar and radically new. His career started in Berlin as part of the Deconstructed Club Music movement, which led him to playing CTM Festival in Berghain, a China tour and gigs all across Europe. His music has been supported by Skin On Skin, Ahadadream, VTSS, NAAFI, Jamz Supernova, and Bambounou. This rise has taken him to iconic stages including Berghain, alongside extensive international touring.

The Joker himself hosts a late-night circus cabaret where anything can happen. Magician, fakir, sword swallower, hair hanger and ghost of the venue, he guides audiences through a series of explosive circus acts: acrobatics, comedy, sexy juggling, fake magic, real magic, flying bicycles, punk clowns, muscular aerialists and hairy men with big pink balls. High-energy, surprising, grotesque and wildly entertaining — with a different line-up every night.

artist: SZIÁMI és a Vendégek & Ági és fiúk
stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Ági és fiúk was founded in 1986 as one of the successor bands to Kontroll Csoport. From the very first Diáksziget, they were regular performers at the iconic Bahia Stage. Since 1994, alternative diva Ági Bárdos Deák’s постоян songwriting partner has been guitarist Szilveszter Antal. Over the decades, the band has performed in numerous line-ups; the current formation features drummer Zsolt Neményi, bassist Gábor Horváth, and saxophonists Zsolt Varga and Balázs Balogh. Together, they perform the band’s evergreen hits as well as their latest songs. After many years away, they return to the Sziget Festival this year.Müller Péter Sziámi, lyricist and frontman of the band Sziámi, together with his friend Károly Gerendai—who was their publisher and manager—founded the Sziget Festival (originally called Diáksziget) in 1993. Even through times of change, they have consistently preserved the spirit of freedom that the festival has always stood for, summed up in its original message: “WE NEED A WEEK TO BE TOGETHER!” Over the years, SZIÁMI—performing in various line-ups—has opened for artists such as David Bowie and Nick Cave, and shared stages with Patti Smith, Iggy Pop, Slipknot and many other international stars. Their repertoire features the best songs from Müller Péter’s two earlier influential alternative bands (URH and Kontroll Csoport), alongside material from different Sziámi formations, complemented by powerful covers of Joy Division and Leonard Cohen classics. For many years now, joined each time by different surprise guests, they have performed the closing concert of the Sziget Festival.

Electrifying, genre-defying, and unapologetically bold, Patrick Mason is shaking the foundations of club culture and conjuring a global movement that merges sound, style, and performance art into one unstoppable force. With a presence as magnetic as his sets, Mason has quickly evolved from reshaping Berlin's underground circuit to commanding some of the world's biggest stages – from Coachella to Tomorrowland - mesmerizing audiences and confounding expectations along the way.Patrick’s sets fuse high-octane techno and deeply rhythmic house with the flair of the runway draped in a cunty spirit of rebellion: his performances are not just heard - they're experienced. And drawing on his background in design, visual arts and fashion, he continues to blur the line between club night and cultural moment, making every appearance a work of art.If dancing is like dreaming with your feet - then Patrick Mason is the weaver of dreams for the dancefloors of today.Patrick will be debuting the first of his new music and content under his A/V imprint MASONICS in 2026.

artist: Club Guy & Roni, Australasian Dance Collective, HIIIT & Boris Acket
description: The relationship between humans and nature is fundamental to our existence, yet in modern society we often feel disconnected from it. We seek peace in nature, while small inconveniences quickly irritate us. In Bad Nature, Club Guy & Roni, Australasian Dance Collective, HIIIT and artist Boris Acket explore this paradox. Acket’s immersive light and sound installations evoke natural forces that feel both artificial and deeply moving. Together, they create a universe where humans, nature and technology collide and intertwine.CHOREOGRAPHY: Amy Hollingsworth, Jack Lister, Roni Haver, Guy Weizman SET, LIGHT AND SOUND DESIGNER: Boris Acket  COSTUME DESIGNER: MAISON the FAUX  DRAMATURGY: Friederike Schubert  COLLABORATING LIGHT DESIGNER: Ben Hughes  COLLABORATING SOUND DESIGNERS: Frank Wienk, Louis Frère-Harvey DIRECTORS ASSISTENT: Sam Coren  CAST CLUB GUY & RONI: Adam Peterson, Angela Herenda, Igor Podsiadly, Camilo Chapela, Jésula Toussaint Visser, Nicky Daniels CAST AUSTRALASIAN DANCE COLLECTIVE: Georgia van Gils, Jack Lister, Lilly King, Lily Potger, Sam Hall, Taiga Kita-Leong  MUSICIANS HIIIT: Niels Meliefste, Max Frimout, Louis Frère-Harvey TECHNICAL CREW: Jonathan Hutter, Martijn van Nunen, Nick Dunsbergen, Nik Tenten, Peter Zwart, Siemen van der Werf  DRESSER: Esther Rada  PRODUCTION: Kaya Wessels, Stephie Kolman (HIIIT)  MARKETING: Hilrieke Mansholt (Club Guy & Roni), Madelyn Wise (Australasian Dance Collective), Max Majorana (HIIIT) COSTUME DEPARTMENT: Emma Vollebregt, Helga Richter, Margaret Tholen, Marloes Dadswell, Tania Ballve, Willem Roelfsma  INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS: Wim de Vries

Ballroom is a culture created by and for transfem BIPOC (black, indigenous & people of colour) as a space of resistance against the societal oppression of racism, colorism, misogynoir, queerphobia and transphobia that they were (and still to this day are) facing.  The ANYBODY WALKING is a ballroom function, where the local and the international ballroom scene come together to celebrate the culture and the community, while practicing walking different categories for balls. We are stepping out from the underground clubs to the stage of Magic Mirror to show you the Magic of Ballroom. Are you ready?  Hungarian Ballroom Scene, International Ballroom Scene, Raisha Cosima, Waacking Hungary

DJ MĂ-TA is shaking things up in Romania's music scene, impressing both online and underground crowds with her unexpected mixes that blend Balkan sounds with techno beats. Her DJing journey began unexpectedly with a gifted console, leading her to experiment with a fusion of Romanian tunes and techno rhythms. Now, she's diving into various techno styles, poised to carve out her own unique space in the music world.

2manydjs is the legendary DJ project of Belgian brothers David and Stephen Dewaele, known from the band Soulwax. The duo became world-renowned for their genre-blurring DJ sets that fuse rock ’n’ roll energy with electronic club culture. Their groundbreaking 2002 mix album As Heard on Radio Soulwax Pt.2 marked a new era for live DJ mixes and became a defining moment for mashup culture. Since then, 2manydjs have performed at major clubs and festivals around the world, gaining a reputation for electrifying, eclectic sets that have reshaped modern DJ culture.

Since releasing his first 12-inch in 2005 Shonky has cultivated a signature sound, a style all of his own that has been part of his continuing success. He is one of the key exponents from his hometown Paris, helping to re establish the city’s prominence on the global stage alongside his Apollonia co-dees, Dan Ghenacia and Dyed Soundorom. Shonky has traversed the globe, delivering his brand of groovy, techy house to club and festival audiences from Miami to Moscow and everywhere in between. Parallel to his DJ endeavours, he has been constantly refining his production skills delivering a stream of classic releases on labels such as Freak N’Chic, mobile, Contexterrior, Real Tone and his own Apollonia outlet.

C*NZÚRA is an electronic music party series connected to Hundred Sins, bringing different guest performers to every event. Frequent returning artists include Belial (Fehér Holló), Cursative, and Zorz, while Dögös Robi, Bittó Duó, Cs.Norbi, and Csinszka have also joined the lineup on various occasions. One of the party’s unique features is that the DJ booth is not placed in the usual spot, but instead right in the middle of the dance floor. Every live performance is also uploaded to the series’ YouTube channel. C*NZÚRA additionally has a weekly show on ParkFM. The mysterious Hundred Sins can best be described through the words experimental, bass-heavy, and trance-dubstep. Hidden behind a mask, the young producer’s raw electronic sound and punk-inspired attitude have made him an unavoidable figure of the new generation. He has collaborated with artists such as Beton.Hofi, AKC Misi, ajsa luna, Lil Frakk, and Azahriah, while also creating music for fashion brands, the Klipszemle festival, and the TV show Dalfutár. With tracks reaching millions of streams and performances alongside his live band, he has already conquered the stages of major clubs and festivals. As a DJ, he tears down crowds everywhere — from hardcore electronic music events to university parties. He is also the creator of the hugely successful and much-needed C*NZÚRA electronic music series.
ANETHA IS A FRENCH ARTIST, DJ, PRODUCER, LABEL MANAGER, TALENT AGENCY CO-FOUNDER AND A TRAINED ARCHITECT.

Zomboy, originally from a small village in England, transitioned from drumming in rock and metal bands to pioneering in the electronic music scene. A car accident settlement funded his home studio, leading to his role as an engineer for numerous bands and his intensive music studies at the ACM in London. His talent was recognized by SKisM, the founder of Never Say Die Records, after Zomboy uploaded two demo tracks to SoundCloud on a whim. Rapidly, he graced stages from London's Ministry Of Sound to EDC Las Vegas and saw his tracks like "Terror Squad" (2013) and “Like A Bitch” (2016) gain massive acclaim.With 750M streams and multiple placements in the Beatport Top 100, Zomboy is praised for his "cinematic violence" and meticulous approach to music. In 2022, he launched Rott N’ Roll Records, underscoring his significant industry influence. From his modest beginnings to leading the dubstep scene, Zomboy is both a dedicated artist and a relentless innovator.

The Hungarian duo known as SaberZ has been active on the international electronic music scene since 2014. With releases on renowned labels such as Armada Music (Rave Culture) and Revealed Recordings, they quickly gained worldwide recognition during the Big Room era. Their breakthrough hit Rhythm of the Night surpassed 14.5 million streams on Spotify, leading to performances alongside artists such as W&W, Hardwell, Tiësto, Armin van Buuren, and Blasterjaxx, as well as multiple tours across Asia and North America. In 2025, SaberZ entered a bold new chapter, completely reimagining both their sound and live performances as the duo shifted toward a forward-thinking hard techno direction. The transformation introduced a darker, more powerful sonic identity, an entirely renewed stage concept, and a wave of new releases and club-focused performances. Today, SaberZ represents uncompromising evolution — combining a decade of international experience with the raw intensity and progressive energy of modern hard techno.

stage: Budapest Park Stage by Johnnie Walker
description: Tüptürüp! Rusty will take you on a trip back in time to a place where only your favourite songs are playing. ☆

Co-founder of Circus Records and Dubstep pioneer. Flux Pavilion has produced some of the most successful tracks in electronic music history and launched the careers of scores of new talent in the process. From Glastonbury to Coachella, he has racked up performances at the world's greatest stages, headlining multiple world tours. Influenced by the likes of David Bowie, The Beatles and Frank Zappa in the early years iit was when he heard The Prodigy and The Chemical Brothers that Flux Pavilion knew he had found a musical direction he truly wanted to explore for himself. A deluge of musical projects followed, writing instrumental hip hop and dirty drum & bass, joining local bands and producing for other acts all while studying at university. But the major turning point for this unquestionably talented musician was a visit to London superclub Fabric: “I never went to clubs because I didn’t feel accepted into that scene; it felt too showy, too well-groomed. Then I saw Rusko play at Fabric and it changed my perception of everything. He was jumping around wearing a big cardboard hat shaped like a bird playing the most outrageous music I had ever heard. I loved it.” Since then Flux Pavilion has continued to develop his signature sound, retaining the all-important energy that The Prodigy and Rusko inspired him with in the early days and inspiring a generation of electronic music producers in the process. The multi-instrumentalist, singer-songwriter, record producer and label owner shows no sign of slowing down, releasing beautifully melodic genre-bending new music, collaborating with the likes of Excision, Zeds Dead, Wooli, Eliminate, Jessica Audiffred, Koven and Cyclops. Along with continuing to storm the live scene with his electrifying live shows, showcasing his talents with singing, multiple synths and electric guitars.
'Apollonia from northern Hungary'

Expect crazy doubles, absolutely face-melting drops, and the most energetic tracks at BELIAL aka Fehér Holló’s DJ sets. The bass rises straight from the depths of hell, shaking reality itself, while the tempo follows the pulse of the crowd. Riddim, drum and bass, hardcore techno, and EDM — wherever BELIAL steps behind the decks, there are no rules, only raw energy and devastating beats. Rather than simply attending a DJ set, the audience becomes part of a ritualistic experience in the kingdom of darkness, where bass reigns supreme and all you have to do is surrender to the overwhelming fusion of music and visuals.

Colombian-born, Berlin-based DJ and producer Funk Tribu has become a defining figure in modern electronic music, blending classic trance emotion with contemporary club energy. In 2025, he launched TRIBE, a label uniting music, identity, and creative vision, and celebrated a homecoming with two sold-out Bogotá arena shows and official City Council recognition. Known for heart-driven, groove-filled sets, Funk Tribu continues shaping the global dancefloor and refocuses on creation in 2026.

Shaymi (Bladerunnaz) I’ve been an active DJ and producer in the drum and bass scene since 2018. I mainly play dancefloor and neuro styles, but I also enjoy mixing harder, more energetic music. I live in the Budapest area, Hungary, but my music has been heard in Slovakia, the Czech Republic, Romania, Malta, Austria, and Portugal, where I’ve also had the opportunity to perform. I’ve played at numerous domestic and international festivals. I also had the opportunity to play at the first stop of the 2024 Mixmag tour in Budapest. As a member of the Bladerunnaz crew, I’ve had the privilege of performing at prestigious events such as Liquicity Night, as well as at Budapest Park, where I shared the stage with artists like Dimension and Sub Focus. Over the years, I’ve also performed alongside Chase & Status, Metrik, Andromedik, Koven, Hedex, Feint, Harrier Jaxx, Maduk, KMotionz, Hallucinator, and many other renowned DJs. Production is a core part of my artistic identity. I work on original tracks, bootlegs, and remixes, constantly shaping and refining my sound. In August 2025, my first official release came out on High Resistance, marking an important milestone in my career. My goal is to gain wider international recognition and perform in even more places, showcasing who I truly am as an artist. I am seeking the necessary support and professional opportunities to achieve this.

Syndanz collective’s two defining figures, Jáky Chan and Eliézer, have formed a tight-knit b2b duo since crossing paths in 2024. Their sets seamlessly blend the 90s progressive trance aesthetic with modern groovy techno, dominated by acid-driven sounds and layered transitions. They bring a deep creative synergy and raw energy to the Colosseum arena.

Hated first encountered the Drum & Bass genre in 2006 and was quickly captivated by its darkest beats. He started DJing in 2011 and began producing music in 2015. Today, he primarily dedicates himself to the realm of neurofunk, though his sets still feature harder tracks – and in the early morning hours, tempos exceeding 200 BPM are not unusual for him. His tracks have been released by several well-known European labels, including the Dutch Blackout Music, where he made his debut in December 2024 with Brute Force. This milestone marked a new chapter in his career and further solidified his presence on the international Drum & Bass scene. Hated's ambition remains unchanged: to make his mark among the biggest names in the genre while captivating audiences with every single set.

Jessica Audiffred is one of the most powerful forces in global bass music, known for her explosive, high-energy sets and genre-blending sound. Hailing from Mexico City, she has taken over major festivals like Tomorrowland, EDC, Ultra, and Lollapalooza with her raw, instinct-driven performances.Founder of A Records, she has built a platform spotlighting Latin American electronic talent, shaping a new wave of the scene. Her debut album Rave New World (2025) marked a defining moment in her career, earning critical acclaim and millions of streams. With global tours and new projects, Jessica continues to push boundaries and inspire a new generation.

Budapest-based duo dtnb. b2b LAU have been sharing the booth since 2019, crafting sets that move fluidly between house, techno, electro and breakbeats. Their connection goes back further — LAU's DJ workshop in 2018 was what first sparked dtnb.'s passion for DJing, giving their partnership a rare depth that comes through in every performance. Both rooted in classical music and seasoned on international stages: LAU across festivals and clubs from Berlin to Kazakhstan, dtnb. from Croatia to Vienna's Grelle Forelle, they bring a musicality to the booth that goes beyond genre. Together, their sets balance hypnotic rhythms, intricate melodies and fearless genre exploration into one cohesive dancefloor experience.

Lou Nour is a London-based DJ and emerging presenter whose work exists at the intersection of underground club culture and contemporary cultural storytelling.Of Moroccan heritage and shaped by UK soundsystem traditions, her approach to DJing extends beyond a single genre or tempo. While rooted in bass culture, her sets move fluidly across rhythm-driven club music, percussive textures, refined dance edits, and unexpected turns, always adapting to the time, space, and context.Whether delivering high-energy peak-time moments or more narrative-driven selections, Lou prioritises feeling, flow, and connection over fixed stylistic boundaries.

Austin duo MISSIO—Matthew Brue and David Butler—fearlessly break the rules as they fuse elements of rock, electronic, indie, and hip-hop into an unmatched and uncompromising hybrid. They tie seemingly disparate threads together with honest and heartfelt lyrics meant to both provoke and inspire. Following the 2023-2024 Cinco EP series, the pair present their most definitive and dynamic vision with their full-length double-album, I Am Cinco [Nettwerk]. It collates five moods—I Am Sad, I Am High, I Am Awesome, I Am Angry and I Am Crazy—into one.Since 2015, MISSIO have painted this picture with Loner [2017], The Darker the Weather // The Better the Man [2019], Can You Feel The Sun [2020], and VILLAIN [2022]. Tallying over 1 billion streams, their catalog has notably resonated with the Gold-certified “Everybody Gets High” Between packing houses on tour, they appeared at festivals like ACL and Lollapalooza and incited praise from Atwood, Billboard, Rolling Stone, New Noise and Substream.The music initially took shape in Austin only to be completed on a creative sojourn to Mexico City. Excited to share the music with the world, everything set the stage for them to finally release I Am Cinco.“We’ve been to multiple countries and had 10 different sessions to write and record these 28 songs,” David leaves off. “We’re not just here to check a box; we’re here to be prolific.”

Sephx is a Budapest-based drum & bass DJ and producer who has been an active force in the Hungarian electronic music scene for over seven years. As a resident of The Hive Budapest, he regularly performs at clubs and events across the city and beyond.His sound is driven by melodic rhythms layered with darker, more aggressive elements. Blending deep, weighty basslines with intense, propulsive percussion, Sephx aims to create a powerful, cinematic dancefloor experience—an approach that is equally central to his productions.Having dozens of performances both domestically and internationally for various promoters in front of large audiences, he consistently stands out for his meticulous attention to detail and forward-thinking sound design.

Pein moved to Budapest in 2015, where local DJs and promoters organizing smaller underground parties introduced him to the local drum & bass scene. Inspired by the pioneers of contemporary neurofunk such as Mefjus, Noisia, Phace, and Emperor, alongside the deep and minimal movement led by artists like Alix Perez, Skeptical, Amoss, DLR, and Signal, he quickly became deeply invested in the genre.Over the years, he has performed at numerous events across the country while shaping his own sound and collaborating with key figures of the Budapest dnb community, including MVRK, Dub Personal, Cronik, and the core of The Hive Budapest. In 2019, encouraged by MVRK, Pein co-produced Surge Tank, released on the UK-based Overview Music. The track was featured on Noisia Radio and later included in the label’s 2 Years of Overview compilation. Shortly after, he joined Hive Budapest as a resident, where he remains an active and dedicated member.

Dutch DJ and producer Sam Hofman is quickly rising as one of the most exciting new names in trance and hard house. In March 2025, he launched his own label with debut release Set Me Free, reaching over 1.5 million streams after passing half a million in its first month. That same night, his brand-new event Stuntrave sold out 2,100 tickets in just 20 minutes. Following a second release in July and a sold-out Stuntrave 2 in Groningen, Sam is set to close the year strong, with major bookings and festivals already confirmed for 2026.

London born, Budapest raised, Sonic Rain’s eclectic electronic style reflects the diversity of his homes and his sounds are set to continue spreading worldwide in 2026. To say that Sonic Rain’s musicality is diverse may be selling him short. Boris Garland trained as a contemporary drummer and classical pianist from a young age before delving into the world of electronic music - an evolution that helps shape his uplifting, musical sound. In his productions, you can hear elements of hardgroove techno, ‘90s rave, and breakbeat, all tied together in a unique package - done his way. Based in Budapest, Sonic Rain is poised to make a global impact with a packed international tour schedule and well-received sets on both Boiler Room and HÖR Berlin, alongside a standout opening set for Richie Hawtin in Budapest. With releases on Sweet Nothing, Transition and Selected, his momentum is undeniable. His music has gained international support from heavyweight DJs like FJAAK, Daria Kolosova, Nastia, Pegassi and Estella Boersma - proving the forecast calls for Sonic Rain.

Ivan is a true breaking icon and one of the most respected figures in the culture. With more than 30 years in the scene, he has travelled the world, represented Hip-Hop at the highest level, and inspired generations of dancers. At The Cypher, he joins as one of the MCs, representing Silverback and bringing deep knowledge, history, and presence to the stage.

Khanfu is a professional breaking DJ who has played on major stages around the world, including the Red Bull BC One World Final in Tokyo. As one of the main DJs of Cypher Town, he is already well known and loved by the Budapest breaking community. At The Cypher, he will provide the soundtrack for battles and daytime parties with his signature energy and selection.

B-Boy Damani is a professional breaker from France who seems to defy gravity every time he hits the floor. Known for his unexpected flips, explosive power moves, and relentless battle energy, Damani brings a high-flying style that makes every round unforgettable.
